raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, we believe a clear and reliable software experience matters for everyone interacting with the platform. We value people who communicate thoughtfully, pay attention to details, solve problems, and understand when an issue needs to be handled by a specialized team.

About the Role

We're looking for a Patient Experience Associate to support non-clinical patient interactions within Bask Health's telehealth platform, subject to the approved scope of our patient support operations.

This role is designed for someone who enjoys helping people, communicates clearly, and can work through software-related questions with patience and attention to detail.

You'll help patients navigate supported platform experiences, understand where to find information, and resolve routine non-clinical issues.

You'll provide clear, accurate assistance while recognizing when a question requires a licensed healthcare professional, pharmacy team, technical specialist, or other authorized contact.

Bask Health provides software that helps businesses launch and manage direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

The platform includes patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, account-related workflows, and connections to clinical and pharmacy operations.

You'll develop a working understanding of these software experiences so you can help users navigate them appropriately.

You'll assist with routine questions about accessing supported platform features and completing non-clinical steps.

You'll help identify situations where a patient is unable to proceed through an expected platform workflow.

You'll gather relevant details about reported software issues and document them accurately.

You'll troubleshoot basic navigation and access problems using approved procedures.

You'll avoid providing instructions that fall outside the responsibilities or authorization of the patient experience team.

You'll communicate with patients through approved support channels, which may include email, chat, or other systems selected by Bask Health.

You'll provide clear explanations without using unnecessary technical language.

You'll remain professional and patient when assisting people who may be frustrated or confused.

You'll take time to understand the issue before recommending an approved next step.

You'll help patients understand what information or action is needed to resolve a non-clinical platform problem.

You'll maintain accurate records of interactions, reported issues, and follow-up commitments.

You'll follow established procedures for documenting requests and escalating unresolved concerns.

You'll recognize when an issue cannot be resolved through standard troubleshooting.

You'll coordinate with technical support or engineering teams when a platform issue requires additional investigation.

You'll provide relevant information to technical teams so they can investigate problems efficiently.

You'll follow up on open issues according to approved service procedures.

You'll help ensure patients receive accurate updates when a non-clinical issue is being addressed.

You'll work with customer success or merchant support teams when an issue involves a merchant's platform configuration or account responsibilities.

You'll follow established ownership boundaries so requests are directed to the correct organization or team.

You'll recognize when a question concerns a prescription, medication, diagnosis, treatment decision, or other clinical matter.

You'll refer those questions to the appropriate licensed or authorized healthcare professional.

You'll recognize when a question involves medication preparation, dispensing, fulfillment, or pharmacy-specific decisions.

You'll route those matters to the appropriate pharmacy or authorized support channel.

You'll never provide medical advice, recommend medications, interpret clinical information, or make treatment decisions.

You'll avoid making promises about clinical approval, prescription outcomes, medication availability, or fulfillment timelines unless approved information explicitly supports the communication.

You'll follow appropriate privacy, security, and information-handling procedures.

You'll access and share only the information necessary and authorized for your responsibilities.

You'll follow approved identity verification procedures before discussing account-specific information.

You'll use designated systems and communication channels when handling sensitive information.

You'll report suspected privacy or security concerns through established internal procedures.

You'll help identify recurring platform issues that create confusion or prevent patients from completing expected steps.

You'll document common questions and share relevant patterns with the appropriate internal teams.

You'll contribute suggestions for improving patient-facing instructions and support resources.

You'll help maintain accurate internal knowledge articles and troubleshooting guidance.

You'll participate in training to understand new platform features and changes to approved support procedures.

You'll collaborate with customer support, product, and technical teams when appropriate.

You'll help identify unclear error messages, confusing navigation, or other usability issues.

You'll communicate these findings to the appropriate teams rather than making unauthorized changes.

You'll help maintain consistent service quality across assigned support requests.

You'll organize your work to manage multiple conversations and follow-up tasks.

You'll prioritize urgent issues according to established procedures and escalation guidelines.

You'll take responsibility for completing assigned tasks and communicating when additional help is needed.

You'll ask questions when procedures are unclear rather than guessing about sensitive matters.

You'll help create a supportive experience for people who may be unfamiliar with telehealth software.

You'll maintain a professional tone in written and verbal communication.

You'll be comfortable learning new tools and adapting as platform workflows evolve.

You'll work with team members across departments to make sure issues reach the right people.

You'll support continuous improvement by sharing feedback about recurring problems and inefficient processes.

You'll contribute to an environment that values accountability, accuracy, empathy, and clear communication.

We're looking for someone with customer-facing support experience, strong communication skills, and the ability to follow established procedures.

You don't need to be a medical professional for this proposed role, and you will not be responsible for providing clinical advice.

Experience with healthcare technology or patient services would be helpful, but strong customer support experience and the ability to learn software workflows are also valuable.

Success in this role means helping patients navigate approved non-clinical workflows, resolving routine issues accurately, escalating specialized concerns appropriately, and contributing to a consistent, reliable platform experience.

What You'll Do

  • Respond to assigned non-clinical patient support requests through approved channels.
  • Help patients navigate supported platform workflows.
  • Assist with routine account access and platform navigation questions.
  • Provide approved guidance for completing non-clinical questionnaire and checkout steps.
  • Identify and document reported software problems.
  • Troubleshoot basic platform issues using approved procedures.
  • Escalate unresolved technical problems to the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain accurate records of patient interactions and support requests.
  • Follow established procedures for tracking open issues and follow-up commitments.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with patients.
  • Help patients understand approved next steps for non-clinical issues.
  • Coordinate with merchant support teams when requests involve merchant-controlled workflows.
  • Route clinical questions to authorized healthcare professionals.

raw.title: Performance Modeling Engineer, AI Inference Deployments (Senior/Principal)
raw.excerpt: About Positron AI Positron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference.
raw.description:
About Positron AI

Positron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip-to-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. Our first-generation Atlas systems are already in production on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Asimov, our first custom ASIC, takes that architecture to silicon. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders.

Role Overview

As a Senior Performance Modeling Engineer, you will own the tools that tell customers how a model will run on Positron hardware at scale: how many chips it needs, what throughput and latency it will deliver, and how that compares with GPUs and other accelerators. You will work directly with customers, product, and our chip modeling team to turn deployment questions into quantified answers they can plan against.

The work spans analytical modeling, simulation, and real hardware measurements. You will build deployment-level models on top of our chip performance simulators, validate them against hardware, and package the results so customers can run them on their own. We are hiring two engineers for this work: one will take primary responsibility for the modeling architecture, and the other for per-model deployment studies and the customer-facing tool.

Key Responsibilities

Customer and Product Partnership

  • Partner with customers and product to turn deployment questions into focused studies with clear assumptions, options, metrics, and recommendations.
  • Run apples-to-apples comparisons of the same deployment on competitor hardware and explain what drives the difference.
  • Design and deliver a standalone performance-estimation tool that customers can run on their own workloads.

Deployment and System Modeling

  • Model deployment topologies for large-scale inference, including tensor, pipeline, expert, and data parallelism, batching, context length, and mixed Positron-plus-GPU configurations.
  • Model the network and system layer, including interconnect latency and bandwidth, redundancy, and how these bound throughput as chip count grows.
  • Develop and extend analytical and simulation-based deployment models that consume our chip performance simulator, so every estimate traces back to one shared hardware model.

Validation and Calibration

  • Validate projections against measured hardware runs and keep models calibrated as chips, software, and workloads evolve.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in performance modeling, capacity planning, or systems architecture for large-scale AI inference, HPC, or data-center systems.
  • Demonstrated experience building analytical or queueing performance models and calibrating them against measured systems.
  • Deep understanding of LLM inference at the systems level, including prefill versus decode, KV cache, parallelism strategies, mixture-of-experts routing, batching, time-to-first-token, and tokens per second.
  • A solid working knowledge of data-center networking (latency, bandwidth, and topology) and GPU performance characteristics.
  • Comfort working from incomplete information, stating assumptions explicitly, and delivering an answer with error bars rather than waiting for certainty.
  • Strong Rust skills, or expert-level C/C++ skills and a willingness to work in Rust day to day, along with proficiency in Python for analysis, experiments, and visualization.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain a sizing result, what drives it, and how much to trust it to both engineers and customers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience sizing or benchmarking inference deployments across many accelerators in production.
  • A track record of building customer-facing performance or TCO tools.

Leveling & Scope

While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire.

Why Join Us?

  • Your models will directly shape how customers size, plan, and buy frontier-scale inference deployments, and how Positron's hardware is positioned against GPUs and other accelerators.
  • You will work at the intersection of silicon, systems, and customers, with direct access to our chip simulators, real hardware measurements, and the engineers building Asimov and Titan.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role for Senior: $220,000 – $270,000, for Principal: $270,000-$350,000.

Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits.

At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact.

Benefits & Perks

We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.

Health and wellness

  • Fully company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • Company-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more
  • Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available

Time off and flexibility

  • Unlimited paid time off; we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge
  • 13 paid company holidays
  • Remote-first culture with a company-provided computer and home office setup

Compensation and future

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one

Visa Support

This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates.

Equal Opportunity Employer. If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Applied AI to lead the technical development of AI-powered capabilities across Bask Health's platform.

This role combines hands-on AI engineering, technical leadership, and product-focused problem-solving. You'll help define how artificial intelligence is integrated into Bask's applications, guide the architecture of production AI systems, and work closely with engineering and product teams to turn promising AI capabilities into reliable software.

You'll focus on practical applications of large language models, machine learning, intelligent automation, and AI-assisted workflows. Your work may involve merchant-facing AI tools, patient experience improvements, internal operational automation, search and discovery, and intelligent features that help users navigate complex workflows.

You'll be responsible for establishing strong engineering practices around model evaluation, reliability, performance, security, and observability. You'll also help the team make thoughtful decisions about model selection, infrastructure, system architecture, and when AI is the right solution for a problem.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a purely strategic or research-focused position. You'll contribute to architecture, review implementations, prototype new capabilities, and help engineers solve challenging technical problems while guiding the broader direction of applied AI development.

You'll collaborate with company leadership, product managers, engineers, and operational teams to identify high-value opportunities and prioritize AI initiatives based on their practical impact.

We're looking for someone who has successfully built and shipped AI-powered products, understands the challenges of operating AI systems in production, and can lead engineers while remaining deeply involved in technical execution.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the technical direction and development of applied AI capabilities across Bask Health's platform.
  • Define the architecture and engineering standards for production AI applications.
  • Guide the design and implementation of systems powered by large language models and machine learning.
  • Work closely with company leadership, product managers, and engineers to identify high-impact AI opportunities.
  • Translate product and business requirements into practical AI engineering initiatives.
  • Lead the development of merchant-facing AI features, intelligent assistants, and automation tools.

  • Guide the implementation of retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, and agentic workflows where appropriate.

  • Ensure AI systems are designed with appropriate privacy, security, and access controls.
  • Work with backend and platform engineers to integrate AI services into production architecture.
  • Define standards for monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and observability across AI applications.
  • Identify opportunities to improve model performance and reduce unnecessary inference costs.
  • Lead technical investigations into AI system failures, unreliable outputs, and integration challenges.
  • Contribute hands-on code, prototypes, and architectural improvements for complex AI initiatives.
  • Review technical designs and provide guidance on implementation decisions.
  • Mentor engineers working on AI applications, model integrations, and machine learning systems.
  • Help establish reusable AI infrastructure, services, and development patterns.
  • Collaborate with product teams to evaluate AI feature performance and user feedback.
  • Prioritize engineering investments that improve the reliability and scalability of AI capabilities.
  • Guide experimentation with emerging AI technologies while maintaining production engineering standards.
  • Support technical planning, project execution, and cross-functional coordination for AI initiatives.
  • Help build a culture of practical experimentation, technical ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Take responsibility for the technical quality and long-term maintainability of Bask's applied AI systems.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, AI engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams, major technical initiatives, or complex AI projects.
  • Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI-powered applications in production.
  • Strong understanding of large language models and practical LLM application development.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI models through APIs or model-serving infrastructure.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, or comparable production engineering languages.
  • Experience designing scalable backend services and distributed application architectures.
  • Strong understanding of retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, and AI workflow orchestration.
  • Experience evaluating model outputs and measuring AI system performance.
  • Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, and output validation.
  • Experience designing systems that balance model quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and production deployment practices.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, and system integrations.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards and reviewing complex technical designs.
  • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and incident investigation for production services.
  • Understanding of application security, data privacy, and responsible AI implementation.
  • Experience designing fallback behavior and safeguards for unreliable model outputs.
  • Ability to evaluate new AI technologies and make practical technical recommendations.
  • Experience collaborating with product managers and business stakeholders.
  • Strong technical leadership and engineering mentorship skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience prioritizing technical initiatives and balancing competing engineering requirements.
  • Willingness to remain hands-on with architecture, prototyping, and technical problem-solving.
  • Comfort leading initiatives in a fast-moving, remote engineering environment.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience as a Head of AI, Applied AI Lead, Staff AI Engineer, or Engineering Manager for AI systems.
  • Experience leading teams responsible for LLM-powered product development.
  • Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable model providers.
  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable AI orchestration frameworks.

  • Familiarity with model fine-tuning, distillation, or model adaptation techniques.
  • Experience with MLOps, model deployment, or machine learning infrastructure.
  • Experience with AWS and serverless or containerized application architectures.
  • Familiarity with event-driven systems and asynchronous processing.
  • Experience developing AI-powered SaaS applications.

  • Familiarity with e-commerce, subscription platforms, or merchant operations.

raw.description:
Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Sweden

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Sweden. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, we believe reliable communication and thoughtful problem-solving are important parts of a good software experience. We value people who take ownership, pay attention to details, communicate clearly, and understand how to coordinate with the right teams when an issue requires specialized assistance.

About the Role

We're looking for a Patient Services Specialist to support non-clinical patient service requests, coordinate administrative follow-ups, and help resolve more complex issues within Bask Health's telehealth platform.

This position is intended for someone with experience handling customer or patient concerns, managing service cases, and communicating clearly across multiple teams.

You'll help patients navigate supported software workflows, understand approved next steps, and receive appropriate assistance when an issue cannot be resolved through routine support procedures.

You'll take ownership of assigned service cases and coordinate with the appropriate teams until each matter is resolved or properly transferred.

Bask Health provides software that helps entrepreneurs, online businesses, and healthcare organizations launch and manage direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

Our platform brings together patient-facing experiences, merchant storefronts, questionnaires, checkout workflows, clinical processes, and pharmacy-related operations.

You'll develop a practical understanding of the non-clinical platform workflows relevant to your assigned responsibilities.

You'll assist with patient questions involving supported account, navigation, and administrative processes.

You'll provide approved guidance for completing non-clinical steps within the platform.

You'll help investigate issues that cannot be resolved through basic troubleshooting.

You'll gather relevant information to understand the nature of a reported problem.

You'll review available support records and prior communications when authorized.

You'll identify what actions have already been taken and what additional follow-up is needed.

You'll maintain accurate case notes and ensure important details are documented.

You'll manage assigned service cases through approved ticketing or case management systems.

You'll organize open requests according to established priorities and escalation procedures.

You'll help ensure unresolved cases have clear ownership and documented next steps.

You'll follow through on administrative requests that require coordination across multiple teams.

You'll communicate with patients through approved channels, which may include email, chat, or other designated systems.

You'll explain information clearly and avoid unnecessary technical or medical terminology.

You'll remain professional when handling sensitive, confusing, or frustrating situations.

You'll help patients understand what can be addressed through the support team and what requires assistance from another authorized party.

You'll communicate approved updates when a service case remains unresolved.

You'll avoid promising outcomes or resolution timelines that have not been confirmed.

You'll identify situations where a patient's concern involves multiple operational or technical issues.

You'll coordinate with the appropriate teams to clarify responsibilities and next steps.

You'll help prevent patients from being repeatedly transferred between teams without a clear reason.

You'll recognize when a request belongs to a merchant, licensed healthcare provider, pharmacy, or another authorized organization.

You'll follow established ownership boundaries when directing requests.

You'll work with merchant success or customer support teams when an issue involves a merchant-controlled workflow.

You'll collaborate with technical support and engineering teams when software functionality requires investigation.

You'll document technical symptoms, affected workflows, and troubleshooting steps accurately.

You'll help ensure technical teams receive sufficient information to investigate reported problems.

You'll track the progress of escalated cases and maintain appropriate follow-up.

You'll recognize when a question involves a diagnosis, treatment recommendation, prescription decision, or other clinical matter.

You'll refer clinical questions to the appropriate licensed or authorized healthcare professional.

You'll recognize when a request involves medication preparation, dispensing, fulfillment, or other pharmacy-specific activities.

You'll direct those matters to the appropriate pharmacy or authorized support contact.

You'll never provide medical advice, interpret clinical information, recommend medications, or make treatment decisions.

You'll avoid making statements about whether a patient will qualify for or be approved for treatment.

You'll avoid guaranteeing medication availability, prescription fulfillment, or delivery outcomes.

You'll follow approved privacy, security, and information-handling procedures.

You'll use established identity verification practices before discussing account-specific information.

You'll access only the information necessary and authorized for your assigned responsibilities.

You'll use approved systems when documenting or communicating sensitive information.

You'll recognize and report suspected privacy or security concerns.

You'll help identify recurring patient service issues that may indicate broader platform or process problems.

You'll support improvements to case tracking, documentation, and escalation processes.

You'll contribute to reports or summaries of recurring service issues when requested.

You'll help monitor relevant indicators such as case status, follow-up completion, recurring issues, and service quality.

You'll use support data and customer feedback to recommend practical improvements.

You'll manage multiple cases while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

You'll prioritize work according to approved guidelines and established escalation requirements.

You'll communicate proactively when a case is blocked or requires additional assistance.

You'll ask for guidance when a request falls outside your authority or established procedures.

You'll remain organized when coordinating with several teams or handling multiple unresolved requests.

You'll take responsibility for completing assigned follow-ups and documenting outcomes.

You'll support consistent communication between patient-facing support and internal operational teams.

You'll help ensure cases are appropriately resolved, escalated, or transferred rather than left without ownership.

You'll be comfortable learning new software tools and adapting to changing platform workflows.

You'll contribute to a team environment that values accountability, accuracy, clear communication, and continuous improvement.

We're looking for someone with experience in patient services, customer support, healthcare administration, or another customer-facing service environment.

Success in this role means resolving non-clinical service issues accurately, maintaining clear case documentation, coordinating effective handoffs, and ensuring patients receive reliable communication and appropriate assistance.

raw.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Luxembourg

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Luxembourg. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

  • Answer detailed questions from CMS related to models, calculations, and numbers included with Preprint submission. Both numbers that are part of the originals preprint form (i.e. table 2) and additional documents.

  • Train and communicate current program details to new team members or to on-board new employees. This includes communicated complicated calculations to non-Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and getting into the weeds with new SMEs.

Essential Functions

  • Create data requests tailored to project and client needs. Review received files for quality and completeness and provide feedback as necessary. Lead discussion on any concerns or feedback.

  • Serve as primary in cleaning, organization, and linking of multiple sources of data to establish a comprehensive source of client data. This can include data from the client as well as publicly available third-party data sources or government sources.

  • Assist in the sales lifecycle by participating in assessments, calculating high level financial estimates to guide early stages of project development

  • Serve as primary in the creation of dynamic financial models, utilizing client data to develop creative and effective solutions tailored to the client’s needs. Oversee the iterative process of model optimization, presenting model options to project team and clearly explaining the benefits and risks of each opportunity.

  • Proactively monitor CMS and state Medicaid policy and regulation development, providing interpretation of existing national, state, and local policies and payments to inform and direct financial modelling.

  • Advise on technical components of client deliverables, including PowerPoint presentations or one-page documents.

  • Assist in completion of preprint, waiver, and other required documentation. Collaborate with project team on CMS communications as necessary.

  • Prep Project Management teams for client engagements with in-depth demonstrations of data deliverables. Clearly communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience. Participate in, and lead as needed, project engagements.

  • Create and maintain firmwide resources that assist in the sales process such as national modelling and data request templates.

  • Assist in development of firmwide training opportunities covering a variety of healthcare finance topics to educate new and existing members of the firm (Medicaid Finance, GME, billing, Ambulance).

  • Other duties as assigned

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree in Public Policy, Public Administration, Public Health, Health Administration, business, economics, Mathematics, Accounting or MBA Statistics preferred. Master's degree in mathematics or accounting would be a plus.

  • CPA certification and/or advanced training in actuarial science is preferred.

  • 7-10 or more years of progressively responsible work experience in a technical capacity in health or human services policy research, consulting and/or in a healthcare service delivery environment, or 5+ years of post-graduate, progressively responsible work experience in consulting or operational experience in health care and/or health policy research/analysis. Experience should be primarily in a technical capacity such as data analytics, claims analysis, financial analysis, or similar.

  • Previous experience with SPAs and SDPs required.

  • Previous experience with financial modeling and analysis required.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Advanced Excel required.

  • Expertise with Medicaid preferred.

  • Advanced experience in federal or state government or private healthcare industry preferred.

  • Experience with SQL, SAS or other data language preferred.

  • Expertise in healthcare billing, claims work, or other healthcare data related field preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Strong capacity to research, analyze, and interpret financial data drawn from multiple healthcare related sources.

  • Ability to interact professionally with clients and other outside audiences.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills required.

  • Ability to work effectively independently and in teams.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Sellers Dorsey does not sponsor employment visas at this time. Employment with Sellers Dorsey is contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

The anticipated salary range for candidates is $95,800/year in our lowest geographic market range to up to $130,000/year. The final pay offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to the type and years of experience within the job, the type of years and experience within the industry, the candidate’s education, and the candidate’s market location. We are committed to investing as much as possible in our employees and we expect the same from you. Culture is what makes us different as we strongly believe in striving for mastery, teamwork, knowledge sharing, proactivity, a healthy lifestyle, and personal development.

  • Build rapport with key stakeholders and aim to improve the direction of the Product

You would be an ideal candidate if you have:

  • German language proficiency (both written and spoken) is а must.
  • Fluency in English
  • 5+ years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Product Manager for software products.
  • Experience in multiple industries, projects and product set ups
  • Basic understanding of Software technologies - database, integrations, working with data

  • Proven record of working in international environment with variety of stakeholders and personalities

  • Extremely organized persona with strong time-management skills

raw.description:
“I am hugely excited about my future and the future of CyberOne. I have enjoyed my time here immensely and have learnt a huge amount in a short space of time, year-for-year I've learnt more here than I have at Microsoft and PwC.” - CyberOne Consultant

About CyberOne

CyberOne is a pure-play Microsoft security partner dedicated to helping enterprises realise the full value of the Microsoft Security portfolio—across Defender XDR, Sentinel, Entra, Purview, Intune, Copilot for Security and more. We combine deep technical expertise with outcome-driven services that accelerate secure cloud adoption, modernise threat protection and simplify compliance.

Job Title: Customer Success Executive

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time

The Role:

At CyberOne, Customer Success isn’t a support function — it’s frontline cyber defence. This role is pivotal to ensuring our customers stay protected, get maximum value from our services, and see us as their trusted cyber partner for the long run.

You’ll be the person customers rely on to keep their managed security services running smoothly, evolving over time, and delivering real-world outcomes. You’ll own renewals, identify growth opportunities (upsell/cross-sell), and lead service delivery management across your accounts.

This is a varied, high-impact role that sits right at the intersection of Operations, Service Delivery, and Sales — ideal for someone who thrives on ownership, customer relationships, and making things happen.

What You’ll Be Doing

Customer Ownership & Growth

  • Support the Head of Customer Success in running a world-class customer success function.

  • Take accountability for renewals, re-contracting, and solution evolution to minimise churn and maximise customer lifetime value.

  • Maintain a clear, accurate forecast of your pipeline — renewals, expansions, and opportunities in flight.

  • Meet customers regularly to understand their challenges and map them to the right CyberOne services and technology.

Trusted Advisor & Relationship Builder

  • Build deep, trusted relationships with customers at every level — from IT teams to senior stakeholders.

  • Become the go-to person for everything service-delivery related.

  • Lead structured monthly/quarterly service reviews, ensuring actions are agreed, owned, and delivered on time.

  • Support account development planning with commercial awareness and sharp customer insight.

Service Delivery Leadership

  • Manage delivery against contracted SLAs and service schedules, ensuring we meet obligations and exceed expectations.

  • Direct and oversee order processing, fulfilment, and customer requests end-to-end.

  • Handle escalations calmly and professionally, including producing Root Cause Analysis reports that strengthen customer confidence.

  • Keep internal teams aligned and informed so we move as one team around the customer.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual service reports and deliver them via our customer portal.

  • Identify where processes can be improved for speed, quality, and efficiency — then help implement those changes.

  • Assist with internal statistics and reporting to support decision-making across the business.

  • Support resourcing for projects and pre-sales work.

  • Own and maintain the customer performance improvement plans and action tracking.

  • Generate Statements of Work, managed service schedules, welcome packs, and coordinate contract delivery with Operations.

Employees are expected to demonstrate a security-first mindset and ensure that information security considerations are incorporated into their day-to-day activities, decision-making, and interactions with customers, suppliers, and colleagues.

What “Great” Looks Like in This Role

  • Customers renew confidently and view CyberOne as vital to their cyber resilience.

  • Pipeline is visible, dependable, and growing — with new value being created, not just maintained.

  • Service reviews are proactive, structured, and lead to action.

  • Escalations are rare — and when they happen, they’re handled quickly, transparently, and professionally.

  • Internal teams feel supported and aligned around a clear customer plan.

The Ideal Candidate

You’re someone who takes pride in being organised, accountable, and customer-obsessed — with the commercial instincts to spot growth opportunities and the operational sharpness to keep delivery on track.

You will have:

  • Excellent administration, organisation, and time management skills.

  • Strong analytical ability with a practical, problem-solving mindset.

  • High attention to detail — you don’t let things slip.

  • Confident written and verbal communication skills, including customer-facing reporting.

  • A proactive, self-starting style — comfortable working independently or as part of a team.

  • The ability to learn quickly and become fluent in the security services and tech we deliver.

  • Working knowledge of CyberOne systems (or the capability and drive to pick them up fast).

  • Strong skills across Microsoft tools (PowerPoint, Power BI, Word, Excel).

  • Customer-facing and administrative experience in a cyber / IT services environment.

  • Broad understanding of cyber security and managed service delivery.

  • This role requires someone who can operate autonomously while ensuring customers experience a seamless, collaborative ‘one team’ approach across the wider team/organisation.

Why Join Us?

  • CyberOne Ranked #79 Globally in MSSP Alert’s 2025 Top 250 MSSPs

  • Work with experienced cybersecurity professionals on meaningful, high-impact engagements

  • Exposure to a wide range of industries, challenges, and modern Microsoft security solutions

  • A collaborative environment that values expertise, autonomy, and continuous learning

  • Competitive compensation, strong benefits, and a clear path for career progression

If you’re passionate about Microsoft 365 security and want a role where your expertise genuinely makes a difference, we’d love to talk.

💡 Let’s redefine what it means to be secure. Together.

#CyberDefenders

raw.title: Backend Engineer, Billing & Revenue Systems
raw.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer, Billing & Revenue Systems to help build and maintain the backend services supporting payments, subscriptions, billing workflows, and revenue-related functionality across Bask Health's telehealth platform.

You'll develop APIs, application logic, and integrations that connect patient checkout, merchant billing configuration, subscription management, and payment processing.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with experience building production backend applications and working with transactional data. You'll implement meaningful features, investigate billing issues, and help improve the accuracy and reliability of systems used by merchants, patients, and internal teams.

Our backend stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases, with technologies such as Prisma and Drizzle used across the platform.

You'll collaborate with engineers, product managers, finance, and operations teams to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions.

We're looking for someone who pays attention to details, understands the importance of data accuracy, and enjoys solving backend problems that directly affect real transactions and customer experiences.

What You'll Do

  • Build, test, and maintain backend services supporting payments, subscriptions, billing, and revenue-related workflows.
  • Develop APIs and application logic for subscription creation, renewals, cancellations, payment status updates, and billing changes.
  • Implement backend features using TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases.
  • Build and maintain integrations with payment processors and third-party billing services.
  • Work with payment events, webhooks, and asynchronous processing to keep billing records up to date.
  • Help implement pricing rules, discounts, trials, and billing configuration across merchant and patient workflows.
  • Create and maintain database models for transactions, subscriptions, invoices, and billing events.
  • Implement validation, error handling, retries, and safeguards against duplicate transaction processing.
  • Work with AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, and EventBridge to support background jobs and event-driven workflows.
  • Help investigate discrepancies between internal billing records and external payment systems.
  • Build automated tests for billing logic, subscription changes, payment failures, and common edge cases.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, investigate failed payments or unexpected billing behavior, and help implement lasting fixes.
  • Improve logging, monitoring, and visibility into billing system performance.
  • Collaborate with finance and operations teams to understand recurring billing issues and reporting needs.
  • Work with product managers and senior engineers to break requirements into technical implementation tasks.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and engineering discussions.
  • Follow secure development practices when handling payment-related and sensitive customer information.
  • Contribute to internal tools that help teams investigate transactions and resolve billing issues.
  • Document APIs, billing workflows, and important system behavior.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to support development, debugging, and testing while reviewing generated code carefully.
  • Take ownership of assigned features from implementation through testing, deployment, and follow-up.
  • Help improve existing billing services and contribute ideas for making transaction processing more reliable and maintainable.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on backend development.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js.
  • Experience building, testing, and maintaining production backend applications and APIs.
  • Experience working with SQL databases, relational data models, and database schema design.
  • Practical experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs, processing webhooks, or implementing asynchronous backend workflows.
  • Understanding of transactional data integrity, error handling, and reliable data processing.
  • Familiarity with serverless applications, background jobs, or event-driven architectures.
  • Experience using modern database access tools or ORMs.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure handling of sensitive information.
  • Ability to implement backend features involving complex business rules and state changes.
  • Experience writing automated tests and debugging production applications.
  • Familiarity with Git, code reviews, and modern software development workflows.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and communicate findings clearly.
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools while independently reviewing and validating generated code.
  • Ability to complete assigned features independently and collaborate with senior engineers on more complex projects.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, particularly when working with transactional data.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where engineers take ownership of their work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building payment processing, billing, or subscription management systems.
  • Experience integrating Stripe or comparable payment processors.
  • Familiarity with recurring billing, subscription renewals, cancellations, refunds, or failed-payment recovery.
  • Experience implementing idempotency, webhook processing, retries, or transaction reconciliation.
  • Familiarity with pricing engines, discounts, trials, or subscription plan management.
  • Experience with SST and AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, and EventBridge.
  • Experience with Prisma, Drizzle, or tRPC.
  • Familiarity with Next.js, React, or full-stack TypeScript development.
  • Experience working with multi-tenant SaaS applications or monorepo architectures.
  • Experience building e-commerce checkout flows, merchant billing tools, or paid SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with PCI DSS considerations or payment-related security practices.
  • Experience developing internal tools for finance, billing, or operations teams.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and investigating production transaction failures.
  • Experience using Cursor, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools.

raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer, Billing & Revenue Systems to help build and maintain the backend services supporting payments, subscriptions, billing workflows, and revenue-related functionality across Bask Health's telehealth platform.

You'll develop APIs, application logic, and integrations that connect patient checkout, merchant billing configuration, subscription management, and payment processing.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with experience building production backend applications and working with transactional data. You'll implement meaningful features, investigate billing issues, and help improve the accuracy and reliability of systems used by merchants, patients, and internal teams.

Our backend stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases, with technologies such as Prisma and Drizzle used across the platform.

You'll collaborate with engineers, product managers, finance, and operations teams to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions.

We're looking for someone who pays attention to details, understands the importance of data accuracy, and enjoys solving backend problems that directly affect real transactions and customer experiences.

What You'll Do

  • Build, test, and maintain backend services supporting payments, subscriptions, billing, and revenue-related workflows.
  • Develop APIs and application logic for subscription creation, renewals, cancellations, payment status updates, and billing changes.
  • Implement backend features using TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases.
  • Build and maintain integrations with payment processors and third-party billing services.
  • Work with payment events, webhooks, and asynchronous processing to keep billing records up to date.
  • Help implement pricing rules, discounts, trials, and billing configuration across merchant and patient workflows.
  • Create and maintain database models for transactions, subscriptions, invoices, and billing events.
  • Implement validation, error handling, retries, and safeguards against duplicate transaction processing.
  • Work with AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, and EventBridge to support background jobs and event-driven workflows.
  • Help investigate discrepancies between internal billing records and external payment systems.
  • Build automated tests for billing logic, subscription changes, payment failures, and common edge cases.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, investigate failed payments or unexpected billing behavior, and help implement lasting fixes.
  • Improve logging, monitoring, and visibility into billing system performance.
  • Collaborate with finance and operations teams to understand recurring billing issues and reporting needs.
  • Work with product managers and senior engineers to break requirements into technical implementation tasks.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and engineering discussions.
  • Follow secure development practices when handling payment-related and sensitive customer information.
  • Contribute to internal tools that help teams investigate transactions and resolve billing issues.
  • Document APIs, billing workflows, and important system behavior.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to support development, debugging, and testing while reviewing generated code carefully.
  • Take ownership of assigned features from implementation through testing, deployment, and follow-up.
  • Help improve existing billing services and contribute ideas for making transaction processing more reliable and maintainable.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on backend development.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js.
  • Experience building, testing, and maintaining production backend applications and APIs.
  • Experience working with SQL databases, relational data models, and database schema design.
  • Practical experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs, processing webhooks, or implementing asynchronous backend workflows.
  • Understanding of transactional data integrity, error handling, and reliable data processing.
  • Familiarity with serverless applications, background jobs, or event-driven architectures.
  • Experience using modern database access tools or ORMs.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure handling of sensitive information.
  • Ability to implement backend features involving complex business rules and state changes.
  • Experience writing automated tests and debugging production applications.
  • Familiarity with Git, code reviews, and modern software development workflows.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and communicate findings clearly.
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools while independently reviewing and validating generated code.
  • Ability to complete assigned features independently and collaborate with senior engineers on more complex projects.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, particularly when working with transactional data.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where engineers take ownership of their work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building payment processing, billing, or subscription management systems.
  • Experience integrating Stripe or comparable payment processors.
  • Familiarity with recurring billing, subscription renewals, cancellations, refunds, or failed-payment recovery.
  • Experience implementing idempotency, webhook processing, retries, or transaction reconciliation.
  • Familiarity with pricing engines, discounts, trials, or subscription plan management.
  • Experience with SST and AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, and EventBridge.
  • Experience with Prisma, Drizzle, or tRPC.
  • Familiarity with Next.js, React, or full-stack TypeScript development.
  • Experience working with multi-tenant SaaS applications or monorepo architectures.
  • Experience building e-commerce checkout flows, merchant billing tools, or paid SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with PCI DSS considerations or payment-related security practices.
  • Experience developing internal tools for finance, billing, or operations teams.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and investigating production transaction failures.
  • Experience using Cursor, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools.

raw.description:
At Keywords, we are using our passion for games, technology and media to create a global services platform for video games and beyond. Our aim is to become the “go to” provider of technical services.

We enable leading content creators and publishers to leverage our expertise and capacity across the lifecycle of interactive content. In so doing we empower our clients to remain lean and agile, and to focus on creating the most engaging experiences.

Keywords is trusted and relied upon by many of the world’s leading video game companies to work alongside them during concept, development and live operations by leveraging the breadth and depth of our industry leading service lines every step of the way. www.keywordsstudios.com

We are seeking an experienced Server Infrastructure Administrator to support the technology initiatives of the IT Infrastructure team at Keywords. The administrator will be responsible for follow-the-sun delivery and support of related services, managing both Windows and Linux server environments (with Linux comprising roughly 30% of the scope), providing prompt reaction on all server and cloud infrastructure incidents as 2nd line support, and cooperating with other infrastructure teams for resolution.

Main Responsibilities

  • Ensure that all escalated incidents are handled within SLAs.
  • Act as expert support for Windows and Linux server related incidents, managing daily tasks and workflows efficiently within ServiceNow (SN).
  • Manage problem resolution with third-party vendors and participate in Problem management processes.
  • Support company server infrastructure (Windows and 30% Linux) on-premise and in a Cloud.
  • Provide operational administration for highly available server landscapes, including storage servers and server hardware lifecycle management (specifically Dell, HP, and Synology NAS).
  • Support MS Active Directory, design Group Policies (GPO), and manage DHCP and DNS services.
  • Deliver new services according to business requirements.
  • Participate in and lead server infrastructure projects, ensuring that existing studios are brought to the latest infrastructure standards. Provide administration for virtualization environments (VMware and Hyper-V).
  • Administer, maintain, and optimize version control and CI/CD infrastructure, specifically Perforce servers, GitLab, and Jenkins, ensuring high availability for development teams.
  • Implement infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible to streamline server provisioning and routine maintenance tasks.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and efficiency enhancements.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation on all system designs, configurations, and troubleshooting procedures.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field or equivalent experience.
  • Strong technical background with 4+ years' experience in Server Infrastructure administration (Windows and Linux).
  • Very strong technical knowledge of the Microsoft Stack, Active Directory, GPOs, DHCP, DNS, as well as virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V).
  • Solid understanding of Linux server administration (approx. 30% of the role): Familiarity with major distributions (e.g., Ubuntu, RHEL), basic Bash or Python scripting, and command-line troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with server hardware provisioning and out-of-band management (Dell iDRAC, HP iLO).
  • Strong technical knowledge of storage architectures (SAN/NAS, specifically Synology) and network storage protocols (iSCSI, NFS, SMB/CIFS).
  • Practical experience with Data Backup and Disaster Recovery solutions, specifically Veeam and Commvault.
  • Experience managing daily IT operations, incidents, and requests using ServiceNow (SN).
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management tools, specifically Ansible.
  • Experience administering and maintaining version control and CI/CD systems, with a strong focus on Perforce, GitLab, and Jenkins. Strong understanding of Infrastructure change management.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and identify/resolve complex IT infrastructure issues.
  • Strong decision-making skills and an understanding of gaming industry dynamics and trends, with a passion for gaming.
  • Availability to travel if needed.

To be considered for the position, please ensure your CV is submitted in English.

Benefits

This is a permanent, full-time position offering a gross monthly salary range of MXN $32,000 to $38,000, depending on experience, plus all statutory benefits under Mexican Labor Law (Ley Federal del Trabajo).
