Overview

Position Overview:

Join HealthEdge as Senior Manager, FP&A – Risk Adjustment and take on a key leadership role in shaping our financial future. In this position, you will lead financial planning and analysis for the Risk Adjustment organization, manage and develop a team of FP&A Analysts, and serve as a trusted financial partner and advisor to Risk Adjustment leadership. You will own the forecasting, budgeting, and reporting cadence for the Risk Adjustment P&L, translate complex financial and operational data into clear insights for executive audiences, and drive the analytical rigor, scalability, and process discipline that allow FP&A to grow with the business. This role combines strong financial acumen and people leadership with advanced analytical and data capabilities to improve forecasting accuracy, reporting efficiency, and scalable decision support.

Reports To: SVP, Financial Planning & Analysis

About Center of Excellence:

Centers of Excellence (COE) are teams whose primary goal is to provide expertise in a specific field. COEs will usually provide support through training, research, and skilled leaders. In the case of HealthEdge, our Centers of Excellence incorporate the Human Resources, IT, Legal and Financial fields, all of which provide support to our Product divisions and allow the enterprise to move forward and achieve its goals.

Team Leadership:

This role directly manages a team of FP&A Analysts supporting the Risk Adjustment organization. The Senior Manager is responsible for hiring, coaching, developing, and performance management of the team; setting priorities and workload; reviewing deliverables for quality and accuracy; and building the technical and business-partnering skills of team members over time.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead the FP&A function supporting the Risk Adjustment organization, serving as the primary financial business partner and trusted advisor to Risk Adjustment leaders
  • Manage, mentor, and develop a team of FP&A Analysts, including workload prioritization, quality review of deliverables, and career development
  • Own the preparation and review of monthly revenue and expense forecasts for HealthEdge's Risk Adjustment P&L, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
  • Direct the build, maintenance, and enhancement of complex financial models supporting monthly forecasts, annual budgets, and long-range planning
  • Oversee preparation and delivery of monthly and year-to-date management reporting packages, including KPI tracking and variance analysis, ensuring insights are actionable for leadership
  • Lead financial analyses, executive commentary, and presentation materials for monthly executive and operational reviews, presenting directly to senior leadership
  • Provide deep technical and analytical expertise, and guide the team, in responding to complex, ad-hoc reporting and data requests
  • Partner with Finance, IT, and business stakeholders on system implementations, upgrades, and migrations impacting financial planning and reporting
  • Champion the design and enhancement of automated reporting, dashboards, and data models to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy and timeliness
  • Develop and maintain a quantitative and qualitative analytics framework that integrates financial, operational, and performance data
  • Identify and lead opportunities for process standardization, automation, and efficiency gains across forecasting, reporting, and analysis workflows
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enable FP&A to scale effectively with the growth of the business
  • Escalate risks, opportunities, and key business drivers to senior finance and Risk Adjustment leadership in a clear, timely manner

What You Bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in Corporate FP&A, finance business partnering, or related analytical roles, including prior experience leading or mentoring other analysts
  • Prior direct people management experience strongly preferred; demonstrated ability to develop talent and manage team performance
  • Risk Adjustment experience within FP&A or a closely related healthcare finance function strongly preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, or similar subject area; Master's degree or MBA preferred
  • Strong understanding of P&L with an ability to link operational drivers to financial outcomes and communicate insights clearly to non-financial and executive audiences
  • Solid understanding of GAAP accounting principles and financial reporting
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence (written, verbal, and presentation), with demonstrated experience partnering with and presenting to senior leadership; experience partnering with Product, Operations, or Healthcare-related teams is a plus
  • Proven ability to lead multiple engagements and manage rapidly changing priorities across a team, taking an action-oriented and solution-focused approach
  • Highly organized with a track record of building standardized, efficient, and scalable processes that enable teams to meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience leading or participating in financial system implementations, migrations, or planning tool enhancements a plus
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, complex formulas, large datasets); experience with SQL, BI tools, or automation platforms is a strong plus
  • Experience using Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) / Planning and Budgeting Cloud Solution strongly preferred

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

**The annual US base salary range for this position is $165,000 to $178,000. This salary range may cover multiple career levels at HealthEdge. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.

  • Lead the preparation and periodic updates of Clinical Evaluation Reports (CERs), Clinical Evaluation Plans (CEPs), Summary of Safety and Clinical Performance documents (SSCPs), Post-Market Clinical Follow-up Plans (PMCFPs), and Post-Market Clinical Follow-up Reports (PMCFRs) to support regulatory submissions and ongoing compliance.
  • Design compliant, sustainable literature search strategies and conduct systematic literature reviews to identify, evaluate, and summarize published clinical evidence and current scientific and medical practice.
  • Analyze clinical, post-market surveillance, preclinical, and marketing data using quantitative and qualitative methods to evaluate device safety, performance, and benefit-risk.
  • Lead clinical evaluation projects and establish clinical evidence strategies throughout new product development, aligning clinical evidence with regulatory, clinical research, preclinical testing, marketing, and product claims strategies.
  • Evaluate clinical evidence against current U.S., European, and Australian regulatory requirements and collaborate with medical experts and cross-functional stakeholders to develop scientific conclusions on device safety and performance.
  • Identify evidence gaps and residual risks and develop post-market clinical follow-up activities with Clinical Research to address unanswered clinical questions.
  • Translate clinical data and scientific findings into peer-reviewed publications, white papers, clinical summaries, posters, presentations, and other materials supporting cross-functional business needs.

What you will need

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred to be in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Clinical Evaluation, or a related function supporting regulatory or clinical evidence activities.
  • Prior experience within the medical device industry.
  • Experience developing clinical evaluation documentation for medical devices, including Clinical Evaluation Reports, Clinical Evaluation Plans, Summaries of Safety and Clinical Performance, or post-market clinical follow-up documentation.

Preferred

  • Experience with scientific writing, systematic literature reviews, analysis of published scientific literature, and interpretation of clinical or scientific data.
  • Experience applying U.S., European, or Australian medical device regulatory requirements to clinical evidence or clinical evaluation activities

This is a remote position.

Technical Support Engineer: Backup and Disaster Recovery
Location:Remote, South Africa
Employment Type:Full time
Working Hours:Approximately 3:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. South African Standard Time
Experience:3 to 5 years

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Technical Support Engineer to provide overnight support for a growing technology company serving Managed Service Providers.

This position is suited to a strong Tier 2 technician or developing Tier 3 engineer with experience in Windows Server, networking, virtualization, backup, and disaster recovery technologies.

You will be responsible for responding to technical support requests, assessing urgent incidents, performing initial troubleshooting, and escalating critical issues with complete and accurate technical information. During quieter periods, you will assist with general technical support cases and ongoing ticket resolution.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently, communicating with experienced IT professionals, and remaining calm during urgent technical situations.

Key Responsibilities
  • Respond to technical support requests received by phone, email, and ticketing systems
  • Assess backup, recovery, and disaster recovery incidents to determine their severity and urgency
  • Perform initial troubleshooting across servers, backups, virtualization, storage, and networking environments
  • Determine whether an issue can be resolved directly or requires escalation to a senior engineer
  • Gather complete and accurate technical information before escalating critical incidents
  • Follow documented troubleshooting procedures, technical playbooks, and escalation processes
  • Assist with backup failures, data restoration requests, and recovery related support cases
  • Independently manage assigned tickets and maintain clear communication throughout the support process
  • Document troubleshooting steps, findings, actions, and escalations accurately
  • Communicate professionally with Managed Service Providers and other technical stakeholders
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and support team members to move cases toward resolution
  • Assist with general technical support tickets during periods of lower emergency call volume

Requirements

Minimum Requirements
  • At least three years of experience in technical support, systems administration, infrastructure support, or a related technical role
  • Strong hands on experience supporting Windows Server environments
  • Practical knowledge of backup, data restoration, and disaster recovery concepts
  • Experience troubleshooting servers, virtualization platforms, networking, and storage systems
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and NAT
  • Experience managing technical support tickets from initial assessment through resolution or escalation
  • Ability to assess urgent incidents and make sound escalation decisions
  • Strong analytical, diagnostic, and problem solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and technical documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently during overnight hours
  • Reliable availability for the required working schedule

Preferred Experience
  • Previous experience working for a Managed Service Provider
  • Experience supporting Managed Service Providers or other technical business clients
  • Experience with backup and disaster recovery products, appliances, or platforms
  • Experience with image based backups, data restores, recovery testing, or cloud failover
  • Experience supporting VMware ESXi or Microsoft Hyper V environments

• Working knowledge of Ubuntu Linux

  • Familiarity with storage technologies such as RAID, SMB, iSCSI, or ZFS
  • Familiarity with PowerShell, Bash, or Python
  • Relevant Microsoft, VMware, Linux, or CompTIA certifications

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a dependable and technically capable support engineer who can communicate confidently with experienced IT professionals.

You should be able to distinguish between a routine support request and a genuine technical emergency. You must be comfortable gathering technical information, following established procedures, and escalating issues appropriately when senior engineering assistance is required.

This role will suit someone who enjoys technical troubleshooting, wants to deepen their knowledge of backup and disaster recovery, and is interested in developing into a more advanced engineering position.

Personal Attributes

• Calm and professional under pressure

  • Strong analytical and problem solving ability

• Clear and confident communicator

• Detail oriented and process driven

• Comfortable working independently

  • Accountable for assigned tickets and responsibilities

• Willing to learn and ask questions

  • Interested in long term technical development

Remote Working Requirements

Applicants must have:

  • A quiet and professional home working environment
  • Reliable fibre internet with a minimum speed of 100 Mbps
  • Backup power for their computer and internet connection
  • A modern computer suitable for technical support work
  • At least 8 GB of RAM, with 16 GB preferred

• A reliable noise cancelling headset

  • Consistent availability throughout the required working hours

Application Process

Applicants should submit an updated CV clearly outlining their experience with Windows Server, backup and disaster recovery, virtualization, networking, and technical support.

Shortlisted applicants may be required to complete a technical assessment and participate in multiple interviews.

raw.title: State Government Affairs Associate (West)
raw.excerpt: OVERVIEWThe Foundation for Government Accountability (FGA)is hiring a State Government Affairs Associate (West) to keep our reform campaigns moving across our Western states.
raw.description:
OVERVIEW

The Foundation for Government Accountability (FGA)is hiring a State Government Affairs Associate (West) to keep our reform campaigns moving across our Western states. In this role, you’ll work alongside our State Government Affairs Directors to track bills, manage follow-up with lawmakers, and build materials for the 2027 sessions.

This role is built for someone who wants to win policy fights in more than one state at a time. You’ll have a hand in every Western portfolio, from digging into bill data to pitching legislators in statehouses across the region.

The ideal candidate brings three to five years in state government affairs, campaigns, or policy work. This role is remote and reports to the Senior Director of State Affairs for the Western states. Expect frequent travel, especially during session.

CULTURE AND FIT

The people who consistently succeed at FGA are those whose actions and behavior reflect our five Core Values. If you adhere to these values and answer “yes” to each of the following questions, you may be a fit.

1)Candid to Solve: Being willing to have tough conversations in order to solve issues and build trust.

  • Do you seek out constructive feedback—and provide it to others—to solve issues and build trust with coworkers?

2)Grow or Die: We don’t have a neutral gear; we must consistently challenge ourselves and each other to grow in our talents and skills.

  • Are you aware of your strengths and weaknesses, and do you seek out complementary skills and growth in order to mitigate your weaknesses?

3)Politically Savvy:Policy doesn’t change in a vacuum, but in a political reality that we must understand and account for.

  • Do you agree that embracing the realities of politics is necessary to change public policy?

4)Partnership-Oriented: Internal and external relationships are not transactional. That starts with our team members and the perspective that we need the rest of the team to succeed in order to win personally.

  • Are you comfortable creating your own structure for work, such as setting work hours, your own priorities, and creating clarity and a work plan from a broad goal?

5)Bought in to Win: We’re at FGA because we want to change policy. No one is counting hours or widgets. We are here to get results, and sometimes, that will require going the extra mile or doing a job that isn’t technically ours.

  • Do you fully support FGA’s mission and believe that lives are improved through work, not welfare, and that free markets create more freedom and opportunity than government control?

These values shape how we hire and how we work together. Expect to talk about them openly during the interview process.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As State Government Affairs Associate (West), you will have four primary areas of responsibility:

1) Support the State Government Affairs Directors

  • Manage bill tracking, meeting follow-up, and back-end data.
  • Build and send the materials directors need for lawmakers and partners.

2) Represent FGA in the States

  • Join stakeholder and committee meetings at the direction of the Senior Director of State Affairs to advance FGA’s reforms.
  • Travel with directors on state trips to meet lawmakers and present FGA’s reforms.

3) Work with FGA’s In-State Contractors

  • Build working relationships with the in-state contractors in each director’s portfolio.
  • Join update and strategy calls and manage the follow-up.

4) Build State Plans and Session Reports

  • Work with the directors on pre-session plans for each state.
  • Draft post-session reports once the 2027 sessions close.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Three to five years in state government affairs, campaigns, or policy work.
  • Working knowledge of how bills move through a statehouse, from committee to the governor’s desk.
  • Strong communicator with lawmakers, partners, and teammates.
  • Comfortable using AI to speed up research, drafting, and data work. Quorum or other bill tracking experience a plus.
  • Live in or near the Western states region for frequent travel, especially during session.
  • Match FGA’s Core Values (described above).

TIMING, LOCATION, AND COMPENSATION

FGA is seeking to fill this position as soon as possible. Beyond travel to the states, expect legislative fly-ins and quarterly team meetings.

FGA’s headquarters are in Naples, FL, but nearly all of our staff work remotely from across the country. We build our systems and culture around clarity, flexibility, and strong communication. Key elements include:

  • Quarterly in-person team meetings at which you’ll build deeper relationships, set clear goals aligned with FGA’s big vision, and brainstorm how to seize new opportunities
  • An intensive 90-day orientation to familiarize you with the FGA team, our policies, and how we operate
  • Home office setup, including equipment and communication tools you need to hit the ground running

FGA offers a competitive salary between $90,000–$120,000, depending on experience and qualifications, along with a benefits package that includes a six percent retirement match, health benefits, and generous paid leave.

Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Lithuania

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Lithuania. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. raw.description:
About Resources Legacy Fund (RLF)

Resources Legacy Fund builds the architecture behind lasting environmental progress. From climate resilience to land and water conservation to community well-being, we help visionary ideas take shape—offering the steady support and strategic know-how to turn complex challenges into collective victories.

We deliver transformative outcomes for our planet and its people through trusted partnerships and creative campaigns. Rooted in California and expanding across Western North America and beyond, we have a 25-year track record of supporting initiatives at every scale. We also host fiscally sponsored projects that reach across the globe, reinforcing the efforts of change makers worldwide.

Addressing three interconnected crises — climate change, biodiversity loss, and environmental injustice — requires creativity, collaboration, and fast reflexes. With deep operational expertise and the confidence of donors and partners, we enable lasting solutions to rise.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Database Coordinator will support RLF’s Salesforce instance, Community Site(s), improvements, and platform integrations. They will help manage day-to-day operations, system modifications, and the integration of external portals and third-party applications. They will also help develop and deploy the next phases of RLF’s Salesforce implementation by scheduling meetings and tracking timelines, tasks, communications, and deliverables.

The Database Coordinator will serve as the primary point of contact for Salesforce portal functionality, troubleshooting and answering technical support questions from grants management staff, fiscally sponsored project staff, and grantees. The Database Coordinator will also coordinate with program staff on application content and requirements. They will gather feedback on portal enhancements and errors, manage vendor tickets through resolution, and lead ongoing Salesforce portal specific trainings, materials, and onboarding for RLF and FSP staff.

This position is full-time, non-exempt, and reports to the Database Manager. This is a fully remote position (8am -5pm preferred in candidate’s local time zone) with occasional travel required for meetings and staff retreats.

Duties Include:

  • Oversee day-to-day activities and management of Salesforce portals and related third-party applications.
  • Assist the Database Manager with day-to-day primary Salesforce instance maintenance including regular system updates, troubleshooting system issues, and monitoring system upgrade request tickets.
  • Maintain an in-depth understanding of data flows and systems that govern the RLF Salesforce instance and sites.
  • Work collaboratively across other functions of the technology department to align priorities, timelines, performance expectations and deliverable acceptance criteria.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate systems and external vendors.
  • Facilitate meetings between different teams and stakeholders as needed to advance initiatives and maintain alignment.
  • Create and maintain training materials, documentation, and resources to support system users including updates and new project onboarding.
  • Manage all aspects of portal user and license management including new user setup/deactivation, roles, profiles, permissions, etc.
  • Be a resource to staff on Salesforce; help troubleshoot issues.
  • Maintain procedures for system reviews, technical documentation, and data cleaning and integrity in the system.
  • Create and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards for staff usage as needed.
  • Coordinate the development of user acceptance testing and production launches.

QUALIFCATIONS

Note: These qualifications are guidelines, not hard and fast rules, so if you have 75% of the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply. Experience can include paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work and lived experiences that helped you to build the competencies, knowledge, and skills needed for this position. Applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.

  • A minimum of 2 years as a Salesforce Administrator; Salesforce Platform Administrator Certification (ADM201) preferred. If you don’t currently hold this certification, you will be expected to earn it within your first year.
  • Minimum 2-5 years of experience managing Salesforce or CRM system.
  • Experience working at a non-profit strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with grants management systems, community sites, financial/accounting systems, and/or other databases required.

•Advanced Excel skills.

  • Experience gathering business requirements and working with a team to find the best solution.
  • Strong project management skills: ability to follow a project through from beginning to completion.
  • Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and deliver tasks on deadline.
  • Strong verbal and written skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and explain complex issues and solutions clearly through documentation and reports. Outstanding listening skills, and ability to patiently, constructively interact with diverse stakeholders who may be experiencing challenges with the platform.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with third party Salesforce third-party applications including Form Assembly strongly preferred.
  • Previous experience with non-profit grantmaking, development, and/or program management.
  • Positive attitude and a commitment to being part of and building a positive work environment.

Commitment to Nondiscrimination

We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel valued, respected, and included. We know that our work is enriched by the varied voices and perspectives of every staff and board member, so we are committed to making an earnest effort to recruit, welcome, train, develop, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds. We believe that a diverse and inclusive culture expands our creative capacity to do our work and achieve greater outcomes for people and the natural world.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

The starting pay for the Database Coordinator is $40-$43 per hour (approximately $75,000 - $80,000 annually). We have an alternate Fridays off work schedule and offer a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan with a 5% match, and generous paid time off. RLF also offers a technology allowance, student loan repayment assistance, the Calm app, mental health benefits and approximately 16 paid holidays per year.

TO APPLY

Please provide a resume and cover letter explaining how your skills fit this position.

RECRUITMENT SCHEDULE

November 13 – Recruitment Launches

November 30 - Application deadline (applications received after this date may still be considered)

December 11 – Screening interviews

raw.description:
Please Note: If you are a current Spin Master employee with access to Workday, apply to this job via the Workday application.

Are you a kid at heart looking to build a career with a leading global children's toy, entertainment and digital gaming company?

At Spin Master, our unwavering commitment to open mindedness, integrity and innovation is a great part of what has made us an industry leader. How do we stay ahead of the pack? By hiring the best and brightest minds—and that’s why we want you!

Job Description:

About Hapiko

Hapiko makes Stickerbox, a voice-activated sticker printer for kids. A child says whatever they can imagine, and seconds later it's a real sticker in their hand. Hapiko is a Spin Master company, so we pair a small, senior engineering team with the reach of one of the world's largest toy companies.

What will you work on?

You'll own everything behind that moment: the real-time connection layer, the API, the job pipeline and the cloud infrastructure every device talks to. We're a small team building a first-of-its-kind product and scaling it globally, and the backend has to stay fast, safe for kids and affordable as we grow.

This is a hands-on, end-to-end ownership role. The foundations are in place. Your job is to harden them, scale them and set the standards others follow as the team grows.

How will you create impact?

  • Own the API and job queues that every sticker request runs through.
  • Keep the real-time connection layer that devices rely on healthy and reliable, partnering with our firmware engineer.
  • Tune and extend autoscaling so the system handles holiday spikes and a growing fleet, partnering with our ML Serving engineer on GPU inference.
  • Mature our observability: metrics, logs, tracing and alerts that tell us what's wrong before families do.
  • Build cost instrumentation so we can see what each request, model and service actually costs.
  • Own release engineering for server-side services, including safe deploys, database migrations and fast rollback.
  • Partner with our Trust & Safety engineer on abuse prevention, device security and privacy for a kids' product.
  • Share on-call and make the rotation quieter over time.

What are your skills and experience?

  • Depth in Python and PostgreSQL.
  • Elixir experience, or real interest in learning it.
  • You've owned production infrastructure end to end, not just written code that runs on it.
  • You've scaled a queue-driven or real-time system through an order of magnitude of traffic growth.
  • You're comfortable being paged for systems you own, and you work to make that happen less.

The anticipated pay range for candidates who will work in Ontario is $136,700 to $182,300 Per Annum. The offered pay to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience within the job, years of experience within the required industry, education, etc. Spin Master Inc. is a multi-state employer, and this salary range may not reflect positions that work only in other states.




This job posting is tied to an open vacancy.


What you can expect from us:


Our mission is to Make Life More Fun with a vision to push the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and fun.

• Growth and Career Opportunities • Flexible Work Hours • Innovation, Collaboration and Fun • Comprehensive Benefits • Other fun Perks!

What’s it like to work here?


Spin Master is a fast-paced, hands-on organization that provides many great opportunities for impactful decision-making; though our challenging start-up atmosphere isn’t for everyone, we have a proven record of opportunities for future advancement and internal transfers for our passionate and results driven team.


Everyone is welcome in our sandbox and we are committed to an accessible and inclusive hiring process that provides reasonable accommodation to all applicants.


Spin Master strives to create an accessible and inclusive application and selection process and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to job applicants who may require provisions to participate in the recruitment, selection and/or assessment processes. Should you require an accommodation, please contact our Talent Acquisition team, by email at or by phone at 416 364-6002 and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.


Follow us on Instagram and Twitter @SpinMaster to stay up to date on Spin Master career opportunities.


We do appreciate all interest; however only those selected for interview will be contacted.

Job Description: English Language Expert – Nigeria

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote (Nigeria)

About the Role

We are seeking Nigerian English Language Experts to support an AI training project focused on improving speech recognition and language understanding. You will apply your knowledge of Nigerian English accents, dialects, vocabulary, and regional language variations to review audio recordings and improve transcription accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Listen to multi-speaker audio recordings and identify speaker and audio metadata, including dialect, accent, audio quality, background noise, age, and speaking style.
  • Review and correct first-pass ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) transcripts using Nigerian English spelling and language conventions.
  • Identify and categorize regional accents, including Yoruba, Igbo, Hausa, Edo, Ijaw, Efik, Tiv, and Nigerian Pidgin-influenced English.
  • Apply knowledge of Nigerian English vocabulary, idioms, slang, and code-switching, including English-Pidgin and English-Yoruba combinations.
  • Ensure accurate and consistent language annotation according to project guidelines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fluent proficiency in Nigerian English with familiarity across regional accents and dialects.
  • Background in linguistics, language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or a related field.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to distinguish regional differences in Nigerian English pronunciation, vocabulary, and usage.
  • Experience with audio annotation, metadata tagging, or transcription is an advantage.
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed annotation guidelines.
  • Interest in linguistic technology, AI training, or language data projects is a plus.

Roper Technologies is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to help design, build, and deploy advanced AI systems across our portfolio of market-leading software businesses.
This role will focus on developing scalable machine learning products and services, shared AI components, and intelligent agents that drive meaningful business impact. Depending on experience level, the role may involve leading architectural initiatives, mentoring engineers, and shaping technical strategy.
We are looking for hands-on engineers who are excited about building production-grade AI systems—not just prototypes—and who thrive in a high-impact, applied environment. Candidates who have demonstrated ability to think through product as well as engineering are highly desired.

What You’ll Do

AI & ML System Development
  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning models and AI systems in production environments
  • Develop components such as:
    • Model inference services
    • Data and feature pipelines
    • Complex recommendation and matching services
    • Vision based analysis systems
    • Evaluation and monitoring pipelines
  • Optimize models for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency
Intelligent Agents & Applied AI
  • Contribute to the development of AI agents and multi-step workflow automation systems
  • Build systems that integrate with enterprise tools and APIs
  • Implement tool-use frameworks, memory mechanisms, and evaluation loops
  • Experiment with LLMs, foundation models, and fine-tuning approaches
  • Help translate AI research advances into practical, scalable solutions
Engineering Excellence
  • Write high-quality, maintainable, and well-tested code
  • Participate in architecture design and technical reviews
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and MLOps workflows
  • Implement observability and monitoring for AI systems in production
  • Follow security, compliance, and responsible AI best practices
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with product, data engineering, and infrastructure teams
  • Help identify high-impact AI use cases within portfolio companies
  • Support integration of shared AI components into business applications
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Qualifications

We welcome candidates across a range of experience levels. The scope and seniority of responsibilities will scale accordingly.
Required
  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering, data science, or machine learning (more for senior roles)
  • Experience building and deploying production software systems
  • Strong programming skills in Python (experience in additional languages is a plus)

Level and compensation will be determined based on experience and demonstrated expertise.
What We Value

  • Practical, impact-driven AI development
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment responsibly
  • Ownership mindset and bias toward execution

Why Join Roper

raw.description:
Proceso de selección desarrollado por matteria

México - Remoto

Quiénes somos

Organización regional sin fines de lucro especializada en sostenibilidad empresarial e impacto. Trabaja con empresas, aliados, academia, sector público y sociedad civil para promover la adopción de estándares internacionales de gestión, fortalecer prácticas de triple impacto y movilizar colaboración hacia una economía más inclusiva, equitativa y regenerativa. Opera mediante programas de acompañamiento, formación, comunidad, alianzas y acción colectiva en América Latina y el Caribe.

Propósito del cargo

Impulsar el crecimiento de Empresas B en la Región Norte mediante el desarrollo y cierre de alianzas estratégicas con actores empresariales e institucionales que permitan ampliar el alcance del movimiento. La posición combina visión estratégica con ejecución comercial directa, identificando oportunidades, estructurando propuestas y negociando acuerdos que generen nuevas certificaciones. Su responsabilidad es regional desde el inicio, con foco prioritario en México durante el primer año.

Principales Responsabilidades

  • Identificar y priorizar oportunidades de crecimiento: Mapear organizaciones empresariales, gremiales e institucionales con potencial para ampliar la certificación B en la Región Norte, concentrando la ejecución en México durante el primer año, según las oportunidades de cada sector y territorio.

  • Desarrollar relaciones institucionales y empresariales de alto nivel: Establecer y fortalecer vínculos con cámaras de comercio, asociaciones, instituciones públicas, redes empresariales y directivos corporativos, generando oportunidades concretas de colaboración y crecimiento.

  • Estructurar, negociar y cerrar alianzas estratégicas: Identificar las necesidades de potenciales aliados, desarrollar propuestas de valor y programas de colaboración, y liderar su negociación hasta la formalización, en alineación con la Gerencia Regional de Estándares y Crecimiento.

  • Articular la implementación de las alianzas: Coordinar la transferencia y puesta en marcha de los acuerdos formalizados con los equipos responsables, sin asumir la ejecución operativa ni los procesos técnicos de certificación.

  • Gestionar y ampliar la cartera de aliados y oportunidades: Dar continuidad a las relaciones y oportunidades existentes, desarrollar nuevas alianzas mediante prospección propia y articular esfuerzos con Marketing, Country Managers y equipos regionales.

  • Impulsar los indicadores de crecimiento y conversión: Contribuir al incremento de registros en la Evaluación de Impacto B, envíos a certificación y nuevas Empresas B, mediante la generación, negociación y cierre de alianzas estratégicas.

  • Asegurar la trazabilidad de la gestión comercial: Supervisar el seguimiento de oportunidades, acuerdos y compromisos mediante las herramientas de gestión existentes, con apoyo del equipo operativo y visibilidad de los avances y resultados.

  • Representar institucionalmente a Sistema B: Participar y liderar reuniones, espacios de relacionamiento y eventos estratégicos en la Región Norte, con autonomía de gestión, criterio ejecutivo y disponibilidad para viajes frecuentes, estimados en un 30 % del tiempo.

Requisitos y competencias para trabajar con nosotros

Educación

  • Formación profesional en negocios, administración, ingeniería o áreas afines al relacionamiento corporativo.

Experiencia

  • Experiencia comprobable en crecimiento comercial, desarrollo de negocios o venta consultiva B2B de servicios, consultoría, certificaciones o soluciones intangibles.

  • Evidencia de negociación y cierre de acuerdos o programas con aliados, no únicamente prospección o relacionamiento sin resultados.

  • Experiencia trabajando en estructuras matriciales, multiárea o multipaís.

  • Relacionamiento directo con gerencias, equipos ejecutivos, gremios o tomadores de decisión.

  • Conocimiento del mercado empresarial mexicano y de su dinámica institucional.

  • Se valora experiencia en sostenibilidad, ESG, estándares internacionales, ecosistemas empresariales o modelos de membresía.

Conocimientos y habilidades

  • Desarrollo de alianzas B2B, identificación de necesidades, formulación de propuestas, negociación y cierre consultivo.

  • Manejo avanzado de CRM, análisis de pipeline, forecast e indicadores de conversión.

  • Capacidad para comprender y comunicar requisitos técnicos, metodologías y estándares.

  • Español requerido; inglés deseable; portugués valorable.

Competencias

  • Orientación a resultados y disciplina de ejecución: organización, rigurosidad y atención al detalle para gestionar el pipeline, los indicadores, los compromisos y el seguimiento de oportunidades.

  • Comunicación, persuasión e influencia: conversaciones de valor, escucha de necesidades y comunicación asertiva con públicos directivos e institucionales.

  • Priorización y criterio comercial: capacidad para evaluar el potencial, la factibilidad y el impacto de las oportunidades, enfocando los esfuerzos en aquellas con mayor posibilidad de conversión.

  • Autonomía y criterio propio: capacidad para identificar oportunidades, proponer iniciativas y avanzar en su ejecución con seguimiento y responsabilidad, actuando con independencia frente a empresas de cualquier tamaño sin requerir acompañamiento constante.

  • Balance entre apertura relacional y ejecución: capacidad de generar vínculos genuinos con tomadores de decisión sin sacrificar el seguimiento estructurado, el registro disciplinado en CRM y el cierre efectivo de oportunidades.

  • Influencia transversal, colaboración y comunicación con públicos diversos: capacidad para trabajar con diferentes áreas, países y actores, construir acuerdos y coordinar acciones dentro de una estructura matricial.

Perfil de nuestro equipo de trabajo

  • Integridad y rigor en la aplicación de estándares y políticas.

  • Orientación a resultados, datos y compromisos adquiridos.

  • Colaboración efectiva en una estructura regional y matricial.

  • Coherencia entre el propósito de impacto y la sostenibilidad financiera.

Intereses claves para trabajar con nosotros

  • Transformación del sector empresarial mediante prácticas de sostenibilidad e impacto.

  • Expansión de estándares internacionales de gestión y medición.

  • Desarrollo del mercado mexicano y fortalecimiento de soluciones de impacto para empresas.

  • Construcción de una economía más inclusiva, equitativa y regenerativa.

Razones para sumarte a nuestro equipo

  • Liderazgo de una comunidad regional de aproximadamente 360 Empresas B, cifra compartida durante el levantamiento de noviembre de 2026 y sujeta a evolución.

  • Capacidad de definir la experiencia y propuesta de valor para empresas de distintos tamaños, sectores y geografías.

  • Relacionamiento con alta dirección empresarial y articulación de alianzas multisectoriales con impacto regional.

  • Trabajo remoto desde México, flexibilidad de organización del trabajo y colaboración con equipos de varios países.

Detalles relevantes antes de postular a esta vacante

  • La persona debe residir en México.

  • Se requiere disponibilidad para viajes y trabajo con distintos husos horarios.

  • Disponibilidad para viajes nacionales frecuentes y estratégicos (estimados en un 30% del tiempo, equivalente a una semana al mes); movilidad indispensable hacia los principales hubs de crecimiento en México (tales como Guadalajara, Monterrey, Puebla, Baja California o Oaxaca) para la gestión presencial de alianzas con cámaras de comercio, gremios e instituciones públicas.

  • Alcance geográfico: Región Norte de Sistema B Internacional, que comprende México, Colombia, Venezuela, Centroamérica y el Caribe. La posición tiene responsabilidad regional desde su incorporación, con foco prioritario de ejecución en México durante el primer año.

Job Description

Location | Home based
Type | Permanent
Salary | £37,000 - £50,000 (depending on experience)

An excellent opportunity to join Lloyds Wealth as a home-based Paraplanner, helping turn complex financial information into clear, holistic and compliant recommendations that make a meaningful difference to our clients.

At Lloyds Wealth, you’ll work remotely as part of a supportive and collaborative team, helping our advisers deliver high-quality financial planning. You’ll combine technical expertise, sound judgement and attention to detail to produce recommendations that clients can understand and act upon with confidence.

The role

As a Paraplanner, you’ll create clear, accurate and personalised financial planning reports for new and existing clients across the full range of products and advice areas offered by our Advisers.

You’ll assess client information, undertake research and translate proposed advice into well-structured recommendations. Every report must meet Lloyds Wealth’s internal standards, external regulatory requirements and the individual needs of the client.

You’ll take responsibility for the quality of your work, checking reports for accuracy and, where required, providing peer quality checks for colleagues. You’ll also ensure client and advice information is correctly recorded across our systems, responding promptly to enquiries, requests and instructions from both internal and external clients.

This is a varied, home-based role in which you’ll contribute to projects, support colleagues remotely and identify opportunities to improve processes, productivity and the overall client experience.

Why join us?

  • Home-based working. You’ll have the flexibility to work from home while remaining closely connected to advisers, fellow paraplanners and the wider business.
  • Make a meaningful contribution. Your work will directly support advisers in delivering clear, holistic and client-led financial planning.
  • Develop your technical expertise. You’ll work across a broad range of products, client needs and financial planning scenarios.
  • Career development. We’ll support your ongoing professional development and any relevant qualifications required for the role.
  • Collaborative environment. You’ll be part of a high-performing team where advisers, paraplanners and support colleagues work together to deliver excellent outcomes.
  • Exceptional benefits. These include 30 days’ holiday, private medical cover, life insurance and a matched pension of up to 21%

What you’ll bring

  • Level 4 Diploma qualified (Chartered / Level 6 welcome but not essential)
  • Experience producing clear, accurate and compliant financial planning reports
  • Strong technical knowledge and understanding of regulatory requirements
  • Excellent written communication and attention to detail
  • The ability to manage priorities independently in a busy environment
  • A proactive, collaborative approach to client service and continuous improvement

This is a place for you:

Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion supporting our customers, colleagues and communities, and we’re committed to creating an environment in which everyone can thrive, learn and develop.


We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer Initiative.


We offer reasonable workplace adjustments for colleagues with disabilities, including flexibility in office attendance, location and working patterns. And, as a Disability Confident Leader, we guarantee interviews for a fair and proportionate number of applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role with a disability, long-term health or neurodivergent condition through the Disability Confident Scheme.


We provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. Just let us know what you need.


At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. With us you'll have a key role to play in shaping the financial services of the future, whilst the scale and reach of our Group means you'll have many opportunities to learn, grow and develop.

We keep your data safe. So, we'll only ever ask you to provide confidential or sensitive information once you have formally been invited along to an interview or accepted a verbal offer to join us which is when we run our background checks. We'll always explain what we need and why, with any request coming from a trusted Lloyds Banking Group person.

We're focused on creating a values-led culture and are committed to building a workforce which reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Together we’re building a truly inclusive workplace where all of our colleagues have the opportunity to make a real difference.

Lead Dynamic & Runtime Application Security as Our Next Senior Security Engineer!


Are you ready to own dynamic and runtime security across a massive, multi-product enterprise software portfolio? Join our global Application Security team to scale automated defenses, protect cutting-edge AI and API architectures, and empower dozens of engineering teams to build resilient, cloud-native solutions for the AI era!


About Us:

Trimble is an industrial technology company transforming the way the world works by delivering solutions that enable our customers to thrive. We create technologies that connect the digital and physical worlds, helping our customers increase productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability. From purpose-built products to enterprise-level solutions, our technology empowers professionals in construction, geospatial, government, transportation, and more.

Corporate:

Trimble is a global technology company that connects the physical and digital worlds, transforming the ways work gets done. With relentless innovation in precise positioning, modeling and data analytics, Trimble enables essential industries including construction, geospatial and transportation. Whether it's helping customers build and maintain infrastructure, design and construct buildings, optimize global supply chains or map the world, Trimble is at the forefront, driving productivity and progress. For more information about Trimble (Nasdaq:TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com.


What Makes This Role Great:

In this high-impact senior role, you will take complete ownership of the Dynamic & Runtime Security pillar within our global Application Security program. You will directly influence how dozens of engineering teams secure complex APIs, modern cloud architectures, and emerging AI/LLM implementations while shaping our multi-year strategy for automated runtime defense.

Key Exciting Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end execution, expansion, and optimization of enterprise DAST, IAST, API Security, and Runtime Security solutions across a multi-product portfolio.
  • Establish proactive API discovery, continuous posture management, and runtime security controls while driving security initiatives for AI/LLM implementations.
  • Synthesize signals across DAST, IAST, SAST, SCA, and runtime telemetry to eliminate noise and empower developers with high-fidelity, actionable risk prioritization.
  • Partner with AppSec peers to integrate dynamic security automation seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines alongside SAST, SCA, Container, and IaC security tooling.
  • Act as a strategic security advisor to engineering, DevOps, and product teams to modernize runtime protection across diverse technology stacks and cloud environments.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of dedicated experience in Application Security, Product Security, or Software Security Engineering within complex enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on mastery with enterprise-grade DAST and IAST platforms (such as Burp Suite Enterprise, Rapid7, Veracode DAST, Contrast Security, or HCL AppScan).
  • Deep understanding of API security testing (REST, GraphQL, gRPC), API gateways, and runtime defense models (RASP, eBPF monitoring, WAF/WAAP). • Proven track record securing multi-language applications (Java, Python, Go, Node.js, C#/.NET, C++) and automating scans within modern CI/CD workflows and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Strong grasp of vulnerability scoring and risk prioritization frameworks including CVSS v3/v4, EPSS, and OWASP Top 10.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience securing AI-enabled applications, LLM wrappers, and APIs against OWASP LLM Top 10 threat vectors.
  • Familiarity with neighboring AppSec domains including SAST, SCA, Container Security, and Infrastructure-as-Code scanning.
  • Software engineering background with the ability to write custom automation scripts (Python, Go, Bash) and review multi-language source code.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CISSP, AWS Certified Security Specialty, or CKS.

Logistics:

Location: Canada, Remote

Travel Requirement: 0-10%


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact.

We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

  • You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data-driven insights that reduce waste.
  • Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.
  • Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

Senior Security Engineer, Application Security, AppSec, Dynamic Security, DAST, IAST, Runtime Security, API Security, AI Security, DevSecOps, Remote Canada Jobs

How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

raw.title: Investor Outreach Specialist (BBS960)
raw.excerpt: We're looking for an Investor Outreach Specialist to be the first voice real estate investors and homebuyers hear at a growing U.
raw.description:
We're looking for an Investor Outreach Specialist to be the first voice real estate investors and homebuyers hear at a growing U.S. mortgage brokerage. You will call warm inbound leads who have asked about investment property or short-term rental financing, build trust quickly, qualify their goals and timeline, and book consultations with the mortgage team while you are still on the phone.

This is a relationship-first sales role, not a dialing-volume role. The leads are warm, and the quality of the conversation is what turns them into attended appointments and funded loans. You will not be reading a script. You will ask good questions, listen, handle objections naturally, and make people feel they are talking to a person who understands their plans. The licensed mortgage team handles loan terms and advice, and your job is to qualify interest and set up the consultation. If you naturally connect with people, think on your feet, and take ownership of results in a performance-driven environment, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Performance incentives on top of base pay, including commission for attended consultations and for funded loans from your appointments
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours, with the main calling window in the late afternoon and early evening Eastern Time
  • Work with a growing, relationship-focused brokerage serving real estate investors
  • Ongoing coaching, and a role where quality of conversation matters more than call counts

What You'll Work On

Warm Lead Conversations

  • Contact warm inbound leads who have requested information about investment properties or short-term rentals
  • Build trust and rapport within the first few minutes of every conversation
  • Ask thoughtful discovery questions to understand each prospect's goals and timeline
  • Handle common objections calmly and naturally without sounding scripted

Qualification and Booking

  • Qualify prospective borrowers and investors before scheduling appointments
  • Schedule qualified consultations directly on the mortgage specialist's calendar while still on the phone
  • Coordinate with the mortgage team to give them useful context before every consultation

Follow-Up and CRM

  • Maintain detailed, accurate CRM notes after every interaction
  • Follow structured follow-up sequences with prospects who are not ready yet
  • Keep pipeline records organized so nothing is lost between a first call and a funded loan

How Success Is Measured

  • High-quality conversations and qualified appointments booked
  • Appointment show rate
  • CRM accuracy, organization, and consistent follow-up
  • Professional communication and contribution to funded loans
  • Quality always comes before quantity

What You Bring

  • Fluent English with excellent verbal communication skills
  • A confident, warm, conversational voice that does not sound robotic or overly scripted
  • The ability to build rapport quickly with strangers, think on your feet, and adapt the conversation naturally
  • Strong questioning and listening skills
  • Calm, professional objection handling
  • Organized habits and a record of documenting every interaction accurately
  • Coachability: you learn quickly and enjoy feedback
  • Ownership of results and comfort in a performance-driven environment
  • Dependable, punctual, and highly professional
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet work environment
  • Available to work full-time during US business hours, including the late afternoon and early evening Eastern Time calling window

Nice to Have

  • Experience as an SDR, appointment setter, or in inside sales or high-ticket sales
  • Experience in real estate sales, the mortgage industry, loan processing, or real estate investing
  • Experience in business development, investor relations, or financial services
  • Experience with CRMs such as Bonzo, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or Salesforce

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself in your natural speaking voice, describing your sales or phone experience, and explaining how you would build trust in the first minute of a call with a stranger

Shortlisted candidates will take part in an initial interview and a live role-play over Zoom or Google Meet, where you handle a realistic prospect conversation. We are not looking for perfection or prior mortgage expertise. We are evaluating how you build rapport, think on your feet, ask good questions, and handle objections.

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you genuinely enjoy talking with people, can earn someone's trust quickly, and want a role where your communication skills directly drive your results, this role gives you the coaching and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Job Description: English Language Expert – India

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote (India)

About the Role

We are seeking Indian English Language Experts to support an AI training project focused on improving speech recognition and language understanding. You will use your knowledge of Indian English accents, regional dialects, vocabulary, and cultural nuances to review audio recordings and improve transcription accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Listen to multi-speaker audio recordings and identify speaker and audio metadata, including dialect, accent, audio quality, background noise, age, and speaking style.
  • Review and correct first-pass ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) transcripts using Indian English spelling and language conventions.
  • Identify and categorize regional accents, including Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, and Kannada-influenced English.
  • Apply knowledge of Indian English vocabulary, idioms, slang, and code-switching, including Hinglish.
  • Ensure accurate and consistent language annotation according to project guidelines.
  • Provide feedback to improve linguistic accuracy and annotation quality.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Native or near-native proficiency in Indian English with familiarity across regional dialects and cultural nuances.
  • Background in linguistics, English teaching, language studies, or a related field.
  • Experience in transcription, language annotation, or corpus development is preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to explain linguistic decisions, provide constructive feedback, and adapt to changing project requirements.
  • Familiarity with transcription software and digital annotation platforms.
  • Interest in language innovation and AI-driven language technology.

raw.description:
Associate Director, AP New Course Product Development

College Board – AP&I

Location:

  • This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type:

  • This is a full-time term position that will last for 2 years from the start date.

About the Team

AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. With 40+ courses in a wide variety of subject areas, AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level.

Through the New Course Initiative, the AP Publications team is partnering with the larger AP Program to expand the course portfolio, with several new courses currently in development. The team consists of professionals with expertise in a variety of domains that are integral to the editorial development and production of AP course products. The team builds the publications that bring each new course to life: Course Frameworks (CFs), Course and Exam Descriptions (CEDs), Practice Exams (PEs), and teacher- and student-facing course resources such as project-based learning (PBL) implementation guides and project guides. The team partners closely with course experts, development committees, editors, and outside vendors to deliver clear, accurate, high-quality materials on schedule.

About the Opportunity

As Associate Director, AP New Course Product Development, you will play a key role in moving new AP course publications from early drafts through final page proofs. You will build and prepare turnover manuscripts for CFs, CEDs, and course resources; keep publication schedules accurate and visible to everyone who depends on them; plan and support meetings with course stakeholders; and serve as a reliable point of contact for AP colleagues and outside vendors. As priorities shift, you will also lend the same type of support to existing AP courses.

This is an ideal opportunity for a highly organized, detail-oriented early career professional who enjoys the craft of publishing, thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, and is motivated by mission-driven work in service of expanding access to college-level learning.

In this role, you will:

Build Manuscripts, Support Page Reviews, and Deliver Final Files for New Course Publications and Resources (40%)

  • Prepare and assemble turnover manuscripts for CFs, CEDs, PE, and course resources (PBL guides, project guides, and related materials) using approved templates, styles, and AP editorial conventions
  • Incorporate content, reviewer, and editorial revisions accurately across iterative drafts, maintaining clean version control
  • Track and prepare supporting elements, such as graphics requests, permissions, and sample exam item delivery, so manuscripts are complete at handoff
  • Perform quality checks, including copy-to-copy comparisons and consistency checks, before manuscripts move to editorial review or paging
  • Perform cross-check reviews of PDF page proofs to verify that edits from prior rounds were made accurately and completely
  • Consolidate stakeholder and leadership review comments onto a single revision PDF for the external vendor, flagging conflicting feedback for resolution and ensuring each edit is clear and actionable
  • Close the loop on each publication by delivering final approved content and files to the appropriate teams for posting

Manage Schedules and Coordinate Stakeholder Meetings (25%)

  • Track and maintain publication schedules for assigned new courses, keeping milestones, dependencies, and owners current in Smartsheet
  • Flag schedule risks early and propose options to keep milestones on track
  • Plan and coordinate meetings with key course stakeholders, including course experts and cross-divisional collaborators; prepare agendas and materials, capture notes, and follow up on action items
  • Document decisions in a shared, easy-to-find location so course teams can access current information independently

Maintain Stakeholder and Vendor Correspondence (20%)

  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for AP stakeholders and outside vendors (such as compositors and production partners), ensuring consistent communication, tracking of deliverables, and clarity of ownership
  • Prepare turnovers, review requests, and revision instructions; confirm receipt and track turnaround times
  • Maintain correspondence and decision logs for each assigned course
  • Elevate issues to the appropriate lead and help steer them to resolution

Support Revised AP Courses and Continuous Improvement (15%)

  • Provide manuscript, page review, scheduling, and coordination support for revised AP courses as priorities and capacity require
  • Deliver final approved content and files for revised courses to the appropriate teams for posting
  • Ramp quickly into unfamiliar course content and conventions as assignments shift
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by building checklists, job aids, and templates, and by exploring approved generative AI tools that make manuscript work more efficient and consistent

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

  • 3+ years of experience in publishing, editorial, or project coordination, ideally with educational materials, and a bachelor's degree
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and project coordination skills and the demonstrated ability to move forward multiple projects in concert while meeting timelines
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Acrobat, and Smartsheet (working knowledge of Adobe InDesign and SharePoint is preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills 
  • Strong attention to detail
  • A growth mindset and flexibility when working through ambiguity and shifting priorities in a dynamic, collaborative setting 
  • Ability to operate independently, anticipate needs, and take initiative while building strong partnerships across teams and levels of seniority 
  • The ability to travel 2-4 times per year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $56,000–$85,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.
