raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, we value engineers who enjoy solving practical problems, working directly with customers, and taking ownership of technical implementations. Our customers include entrepreneurs and e-commerce operators building their own businesses, and our implementation work helps them move from initial setup to a functioning platform experience. We're looking for people who combine strong technical skills with clear communication, organization, and follow-through.

About the Role

We're looking for an Implementation Engineer to help customers configure, test, troubleshoot, and launch Bask Health's platform.

This is a customer-facing technical position focused on turning implementation requirements into reliable, functioning software configurations.

You'll work closely with Customer Success Managers, Product Managers, and Software Engineers to help merchants complete technical onboarding and prepare for launch.

You'll be responsible for investigating implementation challenges, coordinating technical requirements, validating supported configurations, and communicating progress throughout the implementation process.

Bask Health provides software that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform connects merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll develop a strong understanding of how the platform's supported components work together.

You'll help customers understand the technical steps required to implement the platform.

You'll participate in technical onboarding discussions with merchants and internal teams.

You'll gather relevant technical requirements from customers.

You'll review implementation objectives and identify the configurations needed to support approved use cases.

You'll help translate customer requirements into documented implementation plans.

You'll identify technical dependencies and potential implementation risks.

You'll communicate implementation requirements and limitations clearly.

You'll help establish technical milestones and track implementation progress.

You'll coordinate with Customer Success Managers to align technical work with customer onboarding plans.

You'll assist customers with supported platform configuration workflows.

You'll help customers understand merchant-facing settings and configuration options.

You'll investigate issues affecting storefront setup and supported customization.

You'll troubleshoot questionnaire configuration and workflow behavior.

You'll help identify configuration problems that prevent supported workflows from functioning correctly.

You'll investigate checkout-related implementation issues.

You'll help distinguish between platform defects, configuration mistakes, and external dependencies.

You'll review supported integrations that are relevant to customer implementations.

You'll investigate basic API connectivity and authentication issues.

You'll troubleshoot integration-related problems when they affect implementation progress.

You'll coordinate with specialized integration engineers when deeper investigation is required.

You'll help customers understand supported integration requirements.

You'll work with Engineering to resolve implementation blockers that require product changes or technical investigation.

You'll prepare clear engineering escalation reports.

You'll document reproducible technical problems and relevant diagnostic findings.

You'll follow established procedures for tracking and escalating software defects.

You'll participate in implementation testing and validation.

You'll help create or maintain technical test plans for supported configurations.

You'll verify that approved workflows behave as expected in designated testing environments.

You'll document test results and outstanding issues.

You'll identify implementation defects before customer launch when possible.

You'll coordinate with relevant teams to resolve launch-blocking issues.

You'll help determine whether technical implementation requirements have been completed.

You'll communicate unresolved risks to the appropriate decision-makers.

You'll support technical launch-readiness reviews.

You'll help prepare implementation handoff documentation.

You'll work with Customer Success Managers to ensure ongoing support teams understand the customer's configuration.

You'll document important implementation decisions and technical dependencies.

You'll help transition completed implementations to ongoing customer support.

You'll provide post-launch technical assistance for issues related to the implementation.

You'll investigate unexpected behavior identified shortly after launch.

You'll coordinate with Engineering when post-launch problems require deeper investigation.

You'll help ensure implementation-related issues are documented and tracked.

You'll maintain accurate technical records throughout the customer implementation lifecycle.

You'll use approved project management, ticketing, and documentation tools.

You'll track assigned implementation tasks and technical follow-up responsibilities.

You'll provide clear updates on implementation progress.

You'll communicate proactively when technical work is blocked.

You'll identify customer dependencies that may delay implementation.

You'll help customers understand what information or actions are needed to continue.

You'll avoid promising unsupported functionality or unapproved launch dates.

You'll explain technical concepts to customers with different levels of software experience.

You'll communicate professionally with entrepreneurs, operators, and technical stakeholders.

You'll be comfortable working with customers who are launching an online business for the first time.

You'll provide practical guidance based on approved product capabilities.

You'll work closely with Customer Success to understand customer objectives.

You'll collaborate with Product when implementation requests reveal product limitations or feature gaps.

You'll partner with Engineering to investigate platform issues and validate fixes.

You'll help identify recurring implementation problems.

You'll contribute to internal implementation guides and technical onboarding documentation.

You'll help improve implementation checklists and standard operating procedures.

You'll document common configuration mistakes and approved solutions.

You'll help identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual implementation work.

You'll contribute ideas for improving technical onboarding efficiency.

You'll support the development of reusable implementation templates when appropriate.

You'll help identify areas where clearer product documentation could reduce implementation delays.

You'll review implementation feedback and share recurring themes with Product and Engineering.

You'll help improve the consistency of technical handoffs between teams.

You'll follow approved change management procedures.

You'll avoid making unauthorized changes to production systems or customer environments.

You'll use approved tools and environments for technical testing.

You'll follow security requirements when handling customer configurations and integration credentials.

You'll access only the systems and information necessary and authorized for your responsibilities.

You'll protect sensitive information and use designated communication channels.

You'll recognize when implementation questions involve privacy, security, or compliance concerns.

You'll escalate those concerns to the appropriate teams.

You'll understand the boundaries between technical implementation and regulated healthcare operations.

raw.description:
SUMMARY:

The Investigative Services Unit Specialist is a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on potential fraud cases and related investigative activities affecting AF Group. The primary function of the ISU Specialist is to detect and deter insurance fraud and to use developed knowledge, skills, and abilities to support the mission of AF Group and comply with state regulatory requirements. The Specialist will effectively manage day-to-day investigative assignments by providing timely, quality, and cost-effective investigative results to field staff. When potential fraud cases are identified, the Specialist will conduct thorough investigations, document results, coordinate mitigation strategies, make appropriate recommendations, and required notifications.

Under the direction of the ISU Director, this position is responsible for fraud investigations, compliance with state regulatory requirements, liaison with law enforcement, anti-fraud training, and ISU quality assurance. Investigations could include complex financial fraud and organized fraud-ring schemes. The ISU Specialist directs vendor investigations, examines investigative reports, reviews surveillance video, and determines if further investigation is warranted. The Investigative Specialist will review vendor invoices for accuracy and contract compliance. The Specialist collaborates with stakeholders to coordinate mitigation strategies and risk management. The ISU Specialist is responsible for educating internal and external customers on the department’s capabilities and effectiveness and provides training on reporting potential fraud.

RESPONSIBILITIES/TASKS:

  • Communicates and collaborates with departmental stakeholders to promote open lines of communication and appropriate referrals for investigation.
  • Assess, triage, and prioritize referrals received to develop investigative plan.
  • Direct, communicate, and manage work assigned to investigative vendors.
  • Analyze intelligence information and make determination for further investigation utilizing available resources, knowledge of fraud schemes and investigation strategies.
  • Conduct investigations to include desk and field investigations, and interviews of involved parties. Obtain, review, and analyze relevant documents and records.
  • Fraud investigations conducted to include claimants, medical and ancillary providers, premium avoidance, and other schemes related to workers compensation, property, casualty, commercial auto, trucking, and surplus coverage.
  • Coordinate and direct onsite investigation of catastrophic claim incidents as requested by claim adjustors.
  • Prepares comprehensive investigation reports and documents all findings and developments in the case management system.
  • Comply with all state regulations related to reporting potential fraud.
  • Conducts follow-up on fraud referrals and monitors the status of a case through prosecution. Testifies in court proceedings when required.
  • Responds to subpoena and other external record requests in accordance with AF Group procedures.
  • Determines loss incurred and seek restitution or civil recovery.
  • Assesses investigative results to determine savings achieved.
  • Establishes and maintains external relationships with law enforcement, trade organizations and others involved in the investigation of insurance fraud.
  • Consistently monitors workflows to maximize efficiency.
  • Monitor vendor performance standards and service levels. May make recommendations for metrics used to measure vendor performance.
  • Analyzes trends and completes comprehensive and detailed reports.
  • Reconcile vendor billing and follow up with accounts payable/vendors regarding vendor accounting issues.
  • Evaluates training needs and designs and develops training modules, materials and evaluations related to fraud for internal and external customers as needed.
  • Maintains up-to-date technical knowledge of investigative core functions.
  • Deliver presentations as needed.
  • Use independent judgment in all areas of responsibility, while considering department and division priorities.
  • Coordinates with enterprise companies in the development and management of ISU.
  • Additional duties and projects assigned.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the job. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

EMPLOYMENT QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION OR EQUIVALENT EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor’s degree in business, criminal justice, law enforcement, insurance, or related field of education required. Knowledge of insurance fraud and other relevant civil and criminal laws is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered in lieu of degree, preference given to degree. Continuous learning required, as defined by the Company’s learning philosophy. Certification, or progress toward, highly preferred and encouraged.

EXPERIENCE:

With proper education credentials, minimum of seven years of law enforcement and/or insurance claims investigations required. Workers’ compensation experience and/or experience in a property/casualty insurance organization preferred.

SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES (SKA) REQUIRED:

  1. Strong interpersonal and superior communication skills Must be customer oriented and able to represent the department in meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
  2. Strong writing skills with proven ability to synthesize and document complex case investigation results and prepare presentations.
  3. Demonstrated leadership abilities.
  4. Ability to work independently and collaborate on group projects.
  5. Strong knowledge of laws, regulations, and compliance requirements related to insurance.
  6. Demonstrated technical knowledge of insurance administration, claims management, or relevant insurance expertise.
  7. Strong background in word processing, spreadsheets, and graphics programs required with knowledge of Microsoft applications preferred.
  8. Ability to analyze and synthesize large data sets and complex policy, financial and medical records.
  9. Ability to analyze and interpret documents for accuracy in reference to technical, legal, and financial information.
  10. Ability to effectively exchange information clearly and concisely, present ideas, report facts, and other information, and respond to questions as appropriate, both in oral and written communications.
  11. Ability to quickly make decisions and comprehend the consequences of various problem situations and take appropriate actions and/or refer problems for necessary decision making.
  12. Ability to organize and prioritize multiple assignments.
  13. Ability to maintain confidentiality,
  14. Ability to perform other assignments at locations outside the office.
  15. Ability to work with minimal supervision.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Work is performed in a home setting with no unusual hazards. Occasional travel required. Must possess a valid driver’s license with a record that meets corporate standards. Work is required at various times of the day and sometimes weekend work may be required.

PAY RANGE:
Actual compensation decision relies on the consideration of internal equity, candidate’s skills and professional experience, geographic location, market, and other potential factors. It is not standard practice for an offer to be at or near the top of the range, and therefore a reasonable estimate for this role is between $73,600 - $123,200.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment in any form. Candidates for the position stated above are hired on an "at will" basis. Nothing herein is intended to create a contract.

The qualifications listed above are intended to represent the minimum education, experience, skills, knowledge, and ability levels associated with performing the duties and responsibilities contained in this job description.

Freight Dispatcher — Load Exceptions & Service Recovery

Full-Time | Remote — United States | U.S. Freight Operations

When Freight Plans Change, Keep the Operation Moving

We are hiring a Freight Dispatcher — Load Exceptions & Service Recovery to support U.S. trucking operations with a focus on shipment delays, service exceptions, changing appointments, driver communication, and operational follow-up.

Freight does not always move according to the original plan. Drivers encounter facility delays, appointment changes, traffic, weather, equipment problems, Hours-of-Service limitations, and other situations that require accurate information and timely coordination.

This position may be a strong fit for transportation professionals, including experienced or former CDL-A drivers, who understand how quickly operating conditions can change and how important clear communication becomes when they do.

Previous employment specifically under the title of Freight Dispatcher is not required. Applicants must have relevant U.S. trucking, transportation, logistics, fleet, or closely related operational experience.

Load Exception Management

  • Monitor active freight for delays, missed check-ins, appointment changes, and service exceptions.
  • Identify missing information and determine what additional details are needed.
  • Gather accurate updates from drivers, brokers, shippers, receivers, and authorized transportation personnel.
  • Document delays and changing shipment conditions promptly.
  • Identify situations requiring operational, safety, compliance, or management escalation.
  • Maintain clear records of outstanding issues and required follow-up.
  • Continue monitoring assigned exceptions until the appropriate operational action has been completed.

Service Recovery & Coordination

  • Assist with coordinating revised pickup or delivery appointments when authorized.
  • Communicate verified changes to drivers and applicable transportation personnel.
  • Evaluate how delays may affect subsequent appointments or freight assignments.
  • Assist with identifying workable next steps when an original transportation plan changes.
  • Coordinate routine recovery actions within assigned authority.
  • Escalate decisions requiring additional authorization.
  • Avoid making commitments regarding freight, appointments, rates, or service outcomes outside assigned authority.

Driver & Broker Communication

  • Communicate professionally with U.S. CDL-A drivers, freight brokers, shippers, receivers, and transportation personnel.
  • Request accurate driver and shipment-status information.
  • Communicate verified appointment and operational changes.
  • Maintain professional telephone, email, and digital communication.
  • Document significant communications and outstanding actions.
  • Escalate broker-verification, safety, service, documentation, or compliance concerns when appropriate.

Freight & Load Support

  • Use DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable U.S. freight load boards when assigned.
  • Review available freight according to lane, equipment type, mileage, appointments, and operating requirements.
  • Calculate loaded mileage, deadhead mileage, total trip mileage, and rate per mile.
  • Consider driver availability and Hours of Service when evaluating alternative freight options.
  • Present appropriate freight information for authorized review and booking.
  • Negotiate freight rates only when specifically authorized.

Transportation Documentation

  • Maintain accurate load and dispatch records.
  • Review rate confirmations and applicable shipment instructions.
  • Maintain bills of lading, proof-of-delivery documents, and related transportation records.
  • Document appointment changes, delays, detention, layover, TONU, and other applicable freight exceptions.
  • Maintain accurate communication histories and operational notes.
  • Identify missing or inconsistent information requiring follow-up.

Required Transportation Background

Relevant professional experience may include:

  • CDL-A truck driving
  • Freight dispatch support
  • Fleet operations
  • Carrier operations
  • Transportation coordination
  • Logistics operations
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Shipment tracking
  • Load planning
  • Comparable U.S. trucking operations

Required Skills

  • Working knowledge of U.S. trucking and transportation operations.
  • Ability to recognize and manage routine transportation exceptions.
  • Familiarity with U.S. freight load boards.
  • Understanding of pickup and delivery appointments.
  • Working knowledge of driver Hours-of-Service considerations.
  • Ability to calculate loaded mileage, deadhead mileage, and rate per mile.
  • Ability to communicate calmly and accurately during changing transportation conditions.
  • Fluent professional spoken and written English.
  • Strong professional telephone and email communication.
  • Strong organization, documentation, and follow-up skills.
  • Computer and spreadsheet proficiency.
  • Reliable computer and stable high-speed internet connection.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Helpful Additional Experience

Experience with shipment tracking, ELD systems, detention and layover documentation, TONU situations, appointment rescheduling, transportation-management systems, broker verification, freight documentation, or active-load exception management is beneficial.

Work Arrangement & Schedule

This is a full-time remote position supporting U.S. freight operations.

Primary hiring location: Columbus, Ohio, United States.
Hiring market: Remote — United States.

Qualified applicants may be considered throughout the United States.

raw.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

People come to TopDog Law at one of the hardest moments of their lives: injured, overwhelmed, and unsure of what comes next. They need someone in their corner who knows their name, understands their situation, and is actively fighting to get them the best possible outcome. The Case Manager exists to be that person, a dedicated advocate who owns the client relationship completely and ensures no one ever feels like just a file number. When this role is done right, clients feel heard, supported, and confident that someone is genuinely working for them.

What You Will Own

  • Own the client relationship from day one through settlement, the Welcome Call is yours, the relationship is yours, and the outcome is yours
  • Be the client's dedicated advocate, connecting them to the right care fast and walking them through one of the most stressful experiences of their life with confidence and compassion
  • Drive cases forward with urgency, moving through each phase with precision and purpose
  • Build demand packages that tell a compelling story and negotiate toward outcomes that make a real difference for real people
  • Be the source of truth on every case you touch, leveraging cutting-edge technology to stay sharp, move fast, and never let anything slip
  • This is not a hand-off role, it's full ownership, and for the right person, it's one of the most impactful seats in the firm

What You Bring

Required:

  • 2–6 years of experience supporting Personal Injury pre-litigation matters on cases in Illinois
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage a high-volume caseload in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience requesting, reviewing, and summarizing medical records and bills
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work independently while collaborating with a team

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Bachelor's degree or Paralegal Certificate
  • Experience in a high-volume or fast-growing law firm
  • Familiarity with Personal Injury claims processes and insurance procedures
  • Experience with case management software (e.g., Filevine, Clio, SmartAdvocate)
  • Comfort working in evolving systems and processes

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $66,000 - $82,000 commensurate with experience
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

raw.title: Real Estate Executive VA - Administrative Operations & CRM Support
raw.excerpt: ROLE TITLEReal Estate Executive VA - Administrative Operations & CRM SupportReady to be the person who keeps three busy real estate partners organized, their leads moving, and their business running smoothly behind the scenes?
raw.description:
ROLE TITLE

Real Estate Executive VA - Administrative Operations & CRM Support

Ready to be the person who keeps three busy real estate partners organized, their leads moving, and their business running smoothly behind the scenes?

We're looking for a sharp, proactive, and experienced Real Estate Executive VA who can take ownership of administrative operations, manage Compass CRM, and ensure important opportunities don't get lost in the day-to-day workload.

If you know your way around Compass, can manage multiple moving pieces without constant reminders, and take pride in keeping every lead, follow-up, document, and task accounted for, this could be your next role.

Pro tip: Applications that include a short introduction video highlighting your real estate experience and hands-on Compass CRM background are strongly encouraged. Be prepared to demonstrate your actual Compass knowledge during the selection process.

This is a fully remote role supporting a U.S.-based residential real estate team. You'll communicate professionally with three managing partners and coordinate closely with their existing ISA and Transaction Coordinator during the client's designated U.S. business hours.

This is not an entry-level real estate VA position. STK will provide orientation on its internal processes and team procedures, but will not provide foundational Compass training. You must have actual, hands-on experience using Compass CRM and be able to work with it confidently from the start. Candidates without this experience should not apply.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Executive and Administrative Support

  • When emails and correspondence arrive for the three managing partners, review, organize, prioritize, and flag items requiring their attention.
  • Draft routine client and business communications for review or coordination, using the team's established communication practices.
  • When appointments, meetings, or scheduling requests arise, coordinate calendars and communicate scheduling details to the appropriate people.
  • Track pending administrative assignments, identify approaching deadlines, and follow up before outstanding items become overdue.
  • Maintain organized records, business documents, and operational information so the partners can retrieve what they need without searching through scattered communications.
  • When routine administrative needs arise, identify the next action and handle it within your authority instead of waiting for step-by-step instructions.
  • Escalate matters requiring a managing partner's judgment rather than making unauthorized client, business, or transaction decisions.

2. Compass CRM Management and Administration

  • Independently navigate and operate Compass CRM and the associated Compass platforms used by the team.
  • When new contacts, prospects, or leads enter the business, create or update the appropriate CRM records and maintain accurate contact information.
  • Monitor leads generated through website inquiries, QR codes, property signage, and other sources.
  • When a lead enters the CRM, review its available information, maintain the appropriate record, and ensure the required follow-up activity is documented.
  • Create and manage CRM tasks, reminders, activities, and follow-up records according to established workflows.
  • Maintain contact notes and communication histories so the managing partners can understand previous interactions and outstanding next steps.
  • Set up buyer property searches and appropriate notifications using the team's established Compass workflows.
  • Support the team's existing CRM processes and ensure that leads, contact records, and follow-up activities are not left incomplete.
  • Review assigned CRM records for missing information, outdated details, and outstanding activities, and correct issues within your authority.

Mandatory execution standard: You must already know how to use Compass CRM in a real estate operating environment. General CRM experience, familiarity with other real estate platforms, or willingness to learn Compass does not meet this requirement.

3. Lead Management and Follow-Up Coordination

  • Monitor incoming buyer and seller inquiries and ensure they are recorded and directed to the appropriate real estate partner.
  • Organize prospects according to their current status, interaction history, and required follow-up.
  • When prospects are not immediately ready to transact, maintain their follow-up schedules and coordinate longer-term nurturing activities.
  • Assist with approved email outreach and client communications.
  • Maintain follow-up schedules for networking contacts, referrals, and prospective clients.
  • When a prospect requires partner involvement, communicate the relevant context and next action rather than simply forwarding an unorganized contact record.
  • Track assigned follow-up activities and identify overdue or missed engagements before they become neglected leads.
  • Maintain consistent engagement throughout the sales pipeline using the team's approved processes.

This role requires active follow-through. Updating a CRM record without ensuring that its required next action is accounted for is not sufficient.

4. Inside Sales Agent (ISA) Support

  • When the ISA requires prospecting information, research and compile relevant contact lists for the team's existing lead-generation activities.
  • Prepare organized prospect lists covering potential sellers, distressed properties, builders, attorneys, and other relevant real estate contacts.
  • Maintain accurate prospect information and corresponding lead records in Compass CRM.
  • Coordinate prospect list delivery, corrections, and updates with the existing ISA.
  • Track administrative aspects of lead-generation activities and maintain the information needed for reporting.

Scope clarification: You are supporting the ISA's administrative and prospecting requirements. You are not replacing the team's existing cold-calling function.

5. Real Estate Listing and Buyer Support

  • When new property listings need administrative preparation, enter and update listing information using the team's approved systems.
  • Organize property details, listing information, and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain listing records and make administrative updates as required.
  • When a prospective buyer needs property options, set up and maintain the appropriate buyer searches in Compass.
  • Prepare real estate forms, contracts, and related documentation using approved templates and under the appropriate supervision.
  • Coordinate required information and document handoffs with the existing Transaction Coordinator.
  • Monitor administrative requirements associated with new listings and buyer inquiries, and follow up on missing information or incomplete handoffs.
  • Keep administrative records organized so that listing and buyer-related work can progress without avoidable documentation delays.

6. Email Marketing and Client Nurturing

  • Assist with creating, scheduling, and managing email marketing campaigns.
  • Build and maintain email nurturing sequences using Flodesk and other approved platforms.
  • Organize client and prospect lists for targeted communications.
  • Support email blasts, action plans, and recurring client engagement campaigns.
  • Execute approved marketing workflows and configure practical automation for repetitive communications where applicable.
  • Coordinate campaign content and scheduling with the team.
  • Maintain accurate audience lists and follow the team's approved campaign instructions.

7. Process Execution and Workflow Improvement

  • Follow the team's established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) when completing recurring administrative and operational activities.
  • Execute documented workflows consistently rather than creating individual workarounds that bypass established procedures.
  • When repetitive administrative work creates unnecessary manual effort, identify the activity and suggest practical opportunities for automation or process improvement.
  • Use approved AI-assisted tools, including Claude where applicable, to improve administrative efficiency.
  • Maintain operational checklists and tracking systems used to monitor recurring responsibilities.
  • Coordinate with Scale Virtually's Process Engineering Team when process updates or workflow adjustments are required.
  • Communicate workflow issues when existing instructions are incomplete, conflicting, or preventing accurate execution.

8. Reporting and Accountability

  • Submit structured Start-of-Day (SOD) and End-of-Day (EOD) reports.
  • At the start of the workday, communicate priorities and identify outstanding items requiring attention.
  • At the end of the workday, report completed activities, pending tasks, and outstanding follow-ups.
  • Maintain visibility into CRM updates, lead management activities, and important administrative responsibilities.
  • Track assigned work through completion and communicate potential delays before deadlines are affected.
  • Escalate urgent matters to the appropriate managing partner promptly.
  • Keep communication clear and specific so the partners can identify what has been completed, what remains outstanding, and where their involvement is needed.

REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

Candidates must meet ALL of the following:

  1. Hands-on Compass experience: Previous direct experience using Compass's real estate platforms, particularly Compass CRM, in an actual real estate working environment. Experience with other CRMs alone does not qualify.
  2. Immediate Compass readiness: Able to independently perform relevant Compass CRM activities without foundational platform training.
  3. Relevant real estate experience: Previous work as a Real Estate Virtual Assistant, Real Estate Executive Assistant, or Real Estate Administrative Assistant.
  4. Residential real estate knowledge: Understands residential real estate terminology and administrative workflows, including buyer inquiries, seller prospects, property listings, and transaction-related documentation.
  5. CRM and lead management: Has personally maintained CRM records, organized leads, documented interactions, and coordinated follow-up activities.
  6. Listing and buyer administration: Has experience supporting property listing administration and buyer-related workflows.
  7. Executive support capability: Can support multiple executives while keeping priorities, communications, and task ownership organized.
  8. Independent execution: Can complete established administrative workflows without daily instructions, constant checking, or repeated reminders.
  9. Professional English communication: Can communicate clearly and professionally in written and spoken English with managing partners, prospects, the ISA, and the Transaction Coordinator.
  10. Recordkeeping accuracy: Maintains accurate contact records, notes, documents, follow-up tasks, and operational information.
  11. SOP compliance: Can follow documented processes and identify when clarification or escalation is necessary.
  12. Professional judgment: Can handle sensitive client information discreetly and recognize when a matter requires partner approval.

Important: Candidates who have never used Compass CRM hands-on will not proceed, regardless of their general real estate VA experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting a multi-agent residential real estate team.
  • Experience using Flodesk or similar email marketing platforms.
  • Familiarity with Claude or other AI-assisted productivity tools.
  • Experience with lead nurturing campaigns and CRM automation.
  • Previous coordination with Inside Sales Agents and Transaction Coordinators.
  • Familiarity with buyer searches, MLS-related workflows, and listing administration.
  • Experience working within structured, process-driven real estate organizations.

TOOLS

Required proficiency:

  • Compass CRM
  • Associated Compass real estate platforms used by the team

Additional platforms and tools:

  • Flodesk
  • Claude
  • Other approved AI-assisted productivity tools
  • Other approved email marketing and administrative platforms

Candidates must distinguish between tools they have actually used and tools they have only encountered or studied.

WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT

  • You can use Compass without being taught the basics. You have performed real CRM work and can explain exactly how you managed contacts, leads, activities, and buyer searches.
  • You close administrative loops. When a lead needs follow-up, a document is missing, or an appointment needs coordination, you track it until the next required action is completed or properly escalated.
  • You can manage three partners without creating three times the supervision. You organize competing priorities and make routine decisions within your authority.
  • Your CRM records are reliable. The partners and ISA can look at a record and understand the prospect's history, current status, and next action.
  • You communicate problems before they become operational failures. You do not wait until a missed deadline or neglected lead becomes someone else's emergency.
  • You execute consistently and improve intelligently. You follow SOPs, maintain reporting discipline, and identify practical opportunities to reduce repetitive work.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

  • This is not a general virtual assistant position for someone whose only experience is calendar management, inbox management, or basic data entry.
  • This is not a Compass training opportunity. Candidates who need someone to teach them how Compass CRM works are not qualified.
  • This is not an Inside Sales Agent or cold-calling position. The team already has an ISA.
  • This is not a Transaction Coordinator position. You will support listing and buyer administration and coordinate documentation handoffs with the existing Transaction Coordinator.
  • This is not a passive administrative role. You are expected to own assigned workflows, monitor outstanding tasks, and follow through without constant supervision.

POSITION DETAILS

  • Work Arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Employment Structure: Virtual Assistant / independent contractor engagement.
  • Preferred Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week.
  • Alternative Schedule: Part-time, 20 hours per week, may be considered.
  • Working Hours: Must be available during STK's designated U.S. business hours. The applicable U.S. time zone and agreed schedule will be confirmed during engagement.
  • Weekend Availability: May be requested depending on operational requirements and the mutually agreed schedule.
  • Work Environment: Performance-driven, remote, and process-oriented. The role requires consistent communication, structured reporting, independent task ownership, and coordination across multiple team members.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Applications must demonstrate actual, hands-on Compass experience.

Please submit:

  1. Your updated resume, including the real estate teams or professionals you have supported and the administrative responsibilities you personally handled.
  2. A description of your direct experience with Compass CRM. Specify how you used it to manage contacts, incoming leads, follow-up tasks, buyer searches, and listing administration.
  3. The approximate duration and context of your Compass experience. State whether you used Compass directly in a professional role or only encountered it through training or demonstrations.
  4. Your experience supporting multiple real estate agents, partners, or executives.
  5. Your experience with Flodesk, email nurturing, lead management, and coordination with ISAs or Transaction Coordinators.
  6. Your availability for 20 or 40 hours per week and your ability to work during the client's designated U.S. business hours.

Compass proficiency will be validated during recruitment through a practical assessment using a permitted demonstration environment or a scenario-based walkthrough. Candidates must be able to explain their actual platform experience. STK will not provide foundational Compass software training.

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

Success in this role will be evaluated through observable execution:

  1. Immediate Compass readiness: Performs assigned Compass-related activities independently without basic platform instruction.
  2. Administrative efficiency: Reliably assumes recurring administrative responsibilities from all three managing partners.
  3. CRM accuracy: Maintains complete, accurate, and organized contact and prospect records.
  4. Lead follow-up consistency: Ensures assigned leads have documented follow-up activities and appropriate next steps.
  5. Operational reliability: Completes assigned work on schedule and escalates issues before they affect operations.
  6. Communication: Coordinates effectively with the managing partners, ISA, and Transaction Coordinator.
  7. Process compliance: Follows established workflows, documentation standards, and reporting requirements.

POSITION OBJECTIVE

Provide STK's three managing partners with a dependable, experienced, Compass-proficient Real Estate Executive VA who can immediately take ownership of recurring administrative operations, maintain reliable CRM records, coordinate lead management, and support listing and buyer administration.

The intended result is fewer administrative interruptions for the partners, more consistent prospect follow-up, reliable operational records, and stronger execution across the team's existing real estate workflows.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off
  • HMO
  • Fully Remote Work

raw.description:
The Product Application Engineer (PAE) – Drives serves as the technical owner for motor control and variable frequency drive (VFD) solutions, supporting opportunities from pre-sales through early project execution. This role ensures Drive system architectures are safe, compliant, properly sized, and executable, acting as the technical bridge between Sales, Project Management, and Engineering. The PAE protects the customer, project execution, and Drives portfolio by ensuring only buildable, technically defensible solutions progress into execution. Key Accountabilities Drives Technical Ownership · Own end-to-end Drives system architecture, including: o LV and MV VFDs o Transformers, line reactors, and filters o Bypass schemes and control architectures · Validate application suitability based on process conditions, environment, and duty cycle · Own technical assumptions, risks, exclusions, and deviations related to Drives scope · Ensure compliance with: o Customer specifications o IEC / IEEE standards (harmonics, EMC, insulation, etc.) o Schneider Electric Drives application and portfolio rules Primary Responsibilities Pre-Sales Technical Support · Review customer technical specifications and process requirements · Validate: o Drive and motor compatability o Constant/variable torque duty cycles o Environmental conditions (ambient temperature, altitude, enclosure type) · Assess application-specific risks, including: o Harmonics o Motor compatibility o Bypass, redundancy, and cooling requirements · Support Sales during technical discussions with customers Outcome: Only technically sound and executable Drives solutions are offered. Solution Design & Architecture Ownership · Define overall Drives solution architecture, including: o Drive topology o Input/output filtering o Control philosophy and communication approach · Ensure alignment with standard and approved Schneider Electric Drives offerings · Review and approve concept-level documentation: o Functional descriptions o Single-line and concept diagrams o Control and interlock philosophies Outcome: Engineering receives clear technical intent with minimal ambiguity. Handover to Project Execution · Lead or support the technical handover for Drives scope · Document and communicate: o Application constraints o Technical assumptions and exclusions o Known risks (harmonics, motor stress, cooling, bypass design) · Support early execution phases to prevent rework and late-stage changes Outcome: Project Managers and Engineering teams begin execution with clarity and confidence. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance · Collaborate closely with: o Sales: Enable feasible, win-ready technical solutions o Project Managers: Provide clear scope definition and risk visibility o Engineering & Factories: Promote standard, repeatable Designs · Challenge non-standard or high-risk Drive applications · Capture and share lessons learned within the Drives community Out of Scope / Not Accountable For · Detailed electrical schematics or CAD drafting · Day-to-day project management · Commercial negotiations, pricing, or margin ownership · Factory expediting or order management (The PAE provides guidance and technical ownership; execution is performed by delivery teams.) Success Metrics · Reduction in Drives-related execution changes · Fewer technical escalations during commissioning · Positive feedback from Project Management and Engineering · Adherence to Drives standards and best practices First 90 Days Expectations · 0–30 Days: Learn product ranges, standards, and common Drive applications · 31–60 Days: Support opportunities with increasing technical ownership · 61–90 Days: Independently own Drives solutions end-to-end for assigned scope · LV and/or MV VFD systems and motor control applications · Industrial applications and process understanding · IEC / IEEE standards related to drives and power quality · Strong technical communication and stakeholder management skills Professional Mindset “If the motor, drive, and process don’t work together, the solution isn’t finished.” Ready to make your technical expertise count? raw.description:
Daniyal Technologies is looking for a highly detail-oriented and proactive Remote Operations Coordinator to help us manage, monitor, and enforce operational compliance across our remote teams. This is a high-responsibility role that requires a deep understanding of remote productivity tools, employee behavior patterns, and a sharp eye for inconsistencies or non-compliance.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor employee activity using Hubstaff (time tracking, activity levels, screenshot review).

  • Perform daily reviews of standup submissions and remote work reports.

  • Evaluate team members’ online availability, response times, and shift adherence using Microsoft Teams and internal check-in systems.

  • Conduct random security audit calls (via Teams) to verify employee availability and desktop activity.

  • Track PTO, missed clock-ins, low activity periods, and other discrepancies — and flag/report as needed.

  • Analyze performance trends and prepare weekly operations reports.

  • Follow up with team members who miss clock-ins, exceed break time, or are inactive during work hours.

  • Coordinate with HR to document warnings and violations of company WFH policy.

  • Ensure all SOPs and compliance expectations are enforced consistently across departments.

  • Review login history, device screenshots, and timesheets to verify work readiness and integrity.

  • Assist management with internal operations audits and reports.

Why Join Us?

  • Location: Remote

  • Salary: $1,000-$2000/month depending on experience

  • Schedule: Full-time, 5 Days Per Week(Standard Office Hours)

  • Paid Days off: 40 Per Year

  • Flexible & Productive Environment: Enjoy better focus & breathing space

  • Fast-Track Growth: Performance-based bonuses

  • Career Development: Long-term growth opportunities with a US-based company

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong attention to detail, especially when reviewing activity logs, screenshots, and team behavior.

  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal).

  • Prior experience with remote operations, workforce management, or employee monitoring is a must.

  • Familiarity with Hubstaff, Microsoft Teams, and common remote work tools.

  • Disciplined, reliable, and unafraid to follow up or hold team members accountable.

  • A calm but assertive personality — able to give reminders without micromanaging.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years experience in operations, compliance, or remote team coordination.

  • Proficiency in Hubstaff, Microsoft Teams, Google Sheets, and time-tracking software.

  • Stable internet connection and backup power preferred.

  • Must be based in the Philippines and available during US working hours.

  • Fluency in English Communication is Mandatory

How We Work

We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team. Our expectations are high because our mission demands excellence. If you’re organized, detail-obsessed, and thrive in structured environments — we want you on the team.

Note:

We use employee monitoring software. This role requires deep interaction with these systems. If you’re not comfortable with remote monitoring, this role may not be a fit.

Highlights

Remote Operations Coordinator to help us manage, monitor, and enforce operational compliance across our remote teams.

Current Employees:

If you are a current Staff, Faculty or Temporary employee at the University of Miami, please click here to log in to Workday to use the internal application process. To learn how to apply for a faculty or staff position, please review this tip sheet.

The Office of the Executive Dean for Research (EDR) based in the Miller School of Medicine (MSOM), has an exciting opportunity for a full-time Senior Manager, Sponsored Programs to work Hybrid or Remote in Miami, FL.


CORE JOB SUMMARY

This role supports the research mission of the University of Miami, MSOM, and the goals of the Executive Dean for Research Office. Applicants must have relevant federal grant administration experience with federal sponsors such as: NIH, DOD, NSF, to be considered for this role.


The Senior Manager, Sponsored Programs directs and oversees all administrative and financial aspects of the Sponsored Programs division at the assigned facilities. The Senior Manager, Sponsored Programs operates with the goals of increasing sponsored funding levels and the output of funding proposal, as well as maximizing the use and efficacy of existing research funding dollars. Further, the incumbent develops and implements policies and methods that further these goals.


CORE JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Identifies potential donors or sources of funding and plans outreach strategies.
  • Participates in the development of grants applications and proposals.
  • Schedules and oversees planning for special events that publicize the organization and its programs to the community.
  • Trains, mentors, and supervises sponsored programs staff members, and prepares performance reports.
  • Negotiates contractual provisions with potential partners.
  • Develops and provides reports or documentation needed to secure and maintain funding and grants. Ensures that grants and contracts adhere to organizational standards.
  • Acts as department expert and primary point of contact on funding issues and disputes.
  • Establishes and continuously assesses the effectiveness of the internal controls within the unit and compliance with University policies and procedures.
  • Ensures employees are trained on controls within the function and on University policy and procedures.

Department Specific Functions

  • Demonstrate knowledge of federal regulations related to research administration, including OMB Uniform Guidance, Cost Accounting Standards (CAS), and Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR).
  • Oversee proposal submissions for an assigned portfolio of departments, faculty, and researchers to federal agencies, foundations, and industry sponsors.
  • Collaborate with faculty to develop proposal budgets, review sponsor guidelines, and coordinate the collection of required documentation to meet sponsor and Office of Research Administration (ORA) deadlines.
  • Oversee the submission of institutional training grants across the medical school, including NIH T32, R25, and R38 programs.
  • Work collaboratively within the Office of the Executive Dean for Research (EDRO) and with the departments and programs supported by RDS, including the EDRO Internal Awards Program.
  • Serve as a liaison between faculty and central administrative and compliance offices.
  • Participate in the preparation and submission of annual progress reports, including NIH Research Performance Progress Reports (RPPRs) through eRA Commons.
  • Assist faculty with post-award activities, including preparation and interpretation of financial reports, forecasting, effort distribution, and effort certification. Provide guidance on allowable and unallowable expenditures throughout the award lifecycle.
  • Work directly with the Office of Research Administration and faculty to facilitate non-funded sponsored agreements, including data use agreements (DUAs), material transfer agreements (MTAs), non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), no-cost extensions, and amendments.
  • Provide oversight and submission support for sponsor-related materials, including Just-in-Time (JIT) documents, post-submission requests, PRAMs, biosketch reviews, and other supporting documentation.
  • Manage a portfolio of faculty with responsibility for post-award activities, including financial reporting, forecasting, effort management, and compliance oversight.
  • Provide guidance on allowable and unallowable expenditures. Review and approve requisitions, expense reports, and purchase orders for assigned sponsored projects within Workday.
  • Meet regularly with faculty and respond promptly to requests, questions, and communications.
  • Maintain access to and proficiency in University of Miami financial and research administration systems, including IBIS, Workday, and Velos.
  • Complete all required ORA onboarding and continuing education programs to maintain system access and compliance requirements.
  • Perform other duties, ad hoc reporting, and special projects as assigned by Executive Dean for Research leadership. Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Possess strong written and verbal communication skills

This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities as necessary.


CORE QUALIFICATIONS


Education:

Bachelor’s degree in relevant field


Experience:

Minimum 7 years of relevant experience.

The University of Miami offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, tuition remission and more.

UHealth-University of Miami Health System, South Florida's only university-based health system, provides leading-edge patient care powered by the ground breaking research and medical education at the Miller School of Medicine. As an academic medical center, we are proud to serve South Florida, Latin America and the Caribbean. Our physicians represent more than 100 specialties and sub-specialties, and have more than one million patient encounters each year. Our tradition of excellence has earned worldwide recognition for outstanding teaching, research and patient care. We're the challenge you've been looking for.

The University of Miami is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants and employees are protected from discrimination based on certain categories protected by Federal law.

raw.description:
About Inovi Inc.

Born in Silicon Valley, we’re a boutique AI infrastructure company building sustainable, next-generation digital infrastructure, end to end. From design through operation, our work is engineered for the performance, scale, and efficiency that advanced AI and computing demand, while strengthening the communities around us.

Location: Central/Northern Virginia preferred or remote across the US for the right candidate. Up to 50% travel.

Type: Full-time, exempt

Reports to: Director, Data Center Deployment

Direct reports: Team of engineers, to be built

Work Authorization: Due to client contractual obligations, all applicants must be a US Citizen or Permanent Resident

Position Summary

We're growing our deployment team and hiring Deployment Program Managers to own the delivery of these projects from notice to proceed through close-out. You'll build the schedule, run the vendors, walk the site and hand the finished infrastructure to the customer.

You'll report to the head of data center deployments and work closely with our Operations and Engineering teams. This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable on a data hall floor as in a customer schedule review.

Essential Job Function and Key Responsibilities

  • Own the planning, scheduling and delivery of assigned customer deployments, from notice to proceed through close-out.
  • Manage scope, budget, procurement coordination and subcontractor performance across each project.
  • Serve as the site-level point of contact for customers and drive disciplined change-management.
  • Manage vendors, measure their progress and rate their performance against quality KPIs.
  • Create and standardize reporting, and give regular updates on status, risks and schedule variance to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Track approved deployment plans with customers, engineers and construction vendors until the infrastructure is in service.
  • Run meetings, maintain timelines and keep large, diverse groups informed of progress and obstacles.
  • Anticipate bottlenecks, manage risk and escalations, and balance business needs against technical constraints.
  • Help shape how Inovi plans and delivers deployments as the team grows.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
  • Experience delivering AI/GPU, high-density or liquid-cooled deployments
  • Building and owning schedules in Asana or similar project management tools
  • Background with a hyperscaler, colocation provider or mission-critical contractor
  • ITIL, CSM, PMP or a similar certification
  • Based within easy reach of a major airport
  • 5+ years of data center or network capacity planning, data center or network infrastructure program/project management, or related technical experience
  • Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)
  • Ability to sustain at least 50% travel to customer sites and data center facilities

What Success Looks Like

This position will be under a 90-day probationary period. You are a versatile marketing professional who can move from strategy to execution quickly.

You have seen excellent marketing done inside a sophisticated organization, but you do not require a large team, agency or established infrastructure to produce excellent work.

You are resourceful, intellectually curious, technologically fluent and comfortable solving problems that may not yet have a defined playbook.

Inovi is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Inovi will use e-Verify to confirm work authorization. Inovi used e-Verify to verify work authorization.

raw.description:
TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.

At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.

AI Fearlessly.

Location: This role can be based anywhere globally, with preferred locations in Canada, USA, Tel Aviv, or Australia.

Position Summary:

TrendAI is seeking a Vulnerability Researcher to join our team of security researchers here in the Zero Day Initiative. The Zero Day Initiative is radically changing the enterprise security landscape with its unique brand of industry-leading vulnerability research. The Vulnerability Researcher role will leverage the intelligence coming in from a globally distributed network of vulnerability researchers to deliver actionable guidance to the product teams inside of TrendAI. This role produces the intelligence that ensures that TrendAI products can detect and block zero-day threats to an enterprise. It will also support the sales and marketing teams within TrendAI through the publication of research, white papers, and blogs that will be presented at top security conferences and tradeshows around the world.

If you enjoy analyzing, finding and exploiting vulnerabilities, researching exploit techniques and mitigations, and building systems to streamline reverse engineering analysis tasks then we'd love to hear from you.

We're primarily seeking experienced Senior, Staff, and Principal-level researchers. The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise and the ability to operate at a Staff level or above. We are also open to exceptional Senior Vulnerability Researchers who demonstrate the potential to grow into a Staff or Principal role.

Responsibilities:

  • Research newly discovered vulnerabilities in a wide range of software products

  • Reverse engineer and research network protocols, file formats, and software

  • Develop and verify proof-of-concept files and exploit code

  • Produce reports describing software vulnerabilities and detection of attack vectors

  • Monitor security industry publications, news groups and other online sources for newly discovered security vulnerabilities and emerging threats

  • Implement new and improve existing tools to automate and streamline the vulnerability research process

  • Collaborate with other vulnerability researchers on research, analysis and report production

Required Knowledge:

  • Functional understanding of TCP/IP protocol stack and higher-level networking protocols (wire-level protocols, RF communications, BGP, routing protocols, or others).

  • Experience in static and dynamic reverse engineering binaries ((x86, x64, ARM, PPC, MIPS, SPARC, 68k, or others)

  • Knowledge in a variety of operating systems internals

Required Skills & Abilities:

  • Ability to analyze and describe vulnerabilities and attack methods

  • Familiarity with tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja, WinDbg, gdb, LLDB, and Wireshark

  • At least two of C/C++, assembly language, Java, Python, and .NET

  • Ability to produce reliable exploits for a wide range of vulnerabilities.

  • Understanding of exploit mitigations such as DEP and ASLR

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills

  • Reliable and dependable team player

  • Great attention to detail and personal quality assurance

  • Self-directed, self-motivated with the ability to work with minimal supervision

Professional Designation/Certification:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or a related field preferred but not required.

Experience:

  • Industry experience performing similar technical role preferred but not required

Why Join TrendAI?

TrendAI is a leader in AI security. We not only delivered the first open-weight, cybersecurity-focused large language model, but also the industry’s first security companion agent evaluated directly by customers. Trend Vision One integrates endpoint, cloud, network, email, identity, AI application, and data security into a single, unified platform. In this role, you will partner with business leaders to design systems that can reason, learn, and protect—accelerating agility, speed of delivery, and data-centric security. You will help transform cutting-edge research into real-world defense capabilities, protecting millions of users in the generative-AI agent era and enabling enterprises to stay ahead of evolving threats.

What We Offer You:

At TrendAI, what matters to you matters to us. We offer competitive pay with company performance-based bonus, strong benefits for you and your family, and real opportunities to grow your skills across cutting-edge technology. We're big on work-life balance, team connection, and building a culture that's genuinely inclusive and collaborative.

Benefits vary by candidate location, but we're happy to share our benefits summary upon request.

Be Passionate. Be Innovative. Be a Trender.

At Trend Micro, we embrace change, empower people, and encourage innovation in a connected world. Our diversity and multicultural workforce are key contributing factors to our success across the globe. Trend Micro provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. Trend Micro does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy and childbirth or related medical conditions, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care leave status, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, product marketing plays an important role in connecting what we build with the businesses that use it. We value clear communication, a strong understanding of our customers, and the ability to turn complex product capabilities into practical value.

About the Role

We're looking for an Associate Product Marketing Manager, New Grad to support product marketing initiatives across Bask Health's software platform.

This is an entry-level opportunity for someone who is interested in the intersection of technology, business, customer research, and marketing.

You'll help our team communicate what Bask Health's products do, why they matter, and how customers can use them to build and manage their telehealth businesses.

You'll work with experienced product marketers and collaborate with product managers, engineers, designers, sales, customer success, and other internal stakeholders.

You'll gain exposure to different areas of the Bask Health platform, including merchant tools, website creation, clinical and pharmacy workflows, AI-enabled features, analytics, and monetization capabilities.

A major part of this role will involve learning how our products work and translating that understanding into clear, accurate customer-facing materials.

You'll support the development of product messaging, feature descriptions, launch announcements, presentations, and educational resources.

You'll help research our customers, including entrepreneurs, e-commerce businesses, healthcare providers, and organizations building direct-to-consumer telehealth experiences.

You'll learn how different customers evaluate software platforms, what problems they're trying to solve, and which capabilities matter most to them.

You'll conduct competitive research to understand how other SaaS, e-commerce, and healthcare technology companies position their products.

You'll help organize research findings into summaries that product marketing and other teams can use.

You'll support product launches by coordinating deliverables, preparing draft materials, tracking timelines, and gathering feedback from stakeholders.

You'll work with product managers to understand upcoming features and help document their functionality and intended customer benefits.

You'll collaborate with engineers and designers when additional technical or product information is needed.

You'll help create sales enablement materials that explain product features and answer common customer questions.

You'll also support customer success teams by developing educational content that helps customers understand and adopt new features.

You'll assist with maintaining product marketing documentation, messaging libraries, competitive research, and launch resources.

You'll have opportunities to contribute ideas for improving how Bask Health communicates its products.

You'll learn how product marketing performance is evaluated through customer feedback, launch results, product adoption, and other relevant indicators.

You'll also gain experience reviewing marketing materials for accuracy and consistency, particularly when communicating healthcare-related or technical product capabilities.

This role is designed to provide hands-on experience while giving you opportunities to take increasing ownership of projects as your skills develop.

We're looking for someone who is curious, organized, comfortable asking questions, and excited to learn how software products are built, launched, and adopted.

You don't need to know everything about product marketing when you join. What matters is your ability to learn quickly, communicate clearly, take initiative, and follow through on your work.

What You'll Do

  • Support product marketing initiatives across Bask Health's software platform.
  • Assist with developing product positioning and messaging.
  • Research customer needs, business challenges, and software purchasing considerations.
  • Conduct competitive research on SaaS, e-commerce, and healthcare technology platforms.
  • Organize competitive findings into clear summaries and comparison materials.
  • Help prepare product launch briefs, announcements, and supporting resources.
  • Track launch deliverables, deadlines, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Collaborate with product managers to understand new features and updates.
  • Work with engineers and designers to gather accurate product information.
  • Draft customer-facing feature descriptions and product overviews.
  • Assist with creating product presentations and sales enablement materials.
  • Help develop customer education resources and onboarding content.
  • Support website and landing page copy for product-related features.
  • Research how customers use different platform capabilities.
  • Gather customer feedback from sales and customer success teams.
  • Help identify recurring customer questions and product objections.
  • Support the development of messaging that addresses customer needs.
  • Assist with preparing product demonstrations and feature walkthroughs.
  • Help maintain product marketing documentation and messaging libraries.
  • Organize research notes, product information, and launch materials.
  • Support internal communications about product updates and launches.
  • Help ensure product marketing materials use accurate and consistent terminology.
  • Coordinate feedback and revisions across internal stakeholders.
  • Assist with analyzing product launch results and customer engagement.
  • Track relevant product adoption and marketing performance indicators.
  • Research industry trends related to SaaS, e-commerce, telehealth, and AI.
  • Contribute ideas for improving product messaging and customer education.
  • Take ownership of assigned projects while learning from experienced team members.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Recent graduate or early-career professional with approximately 0–2 years of relevant experience.
  • Strong written communication skills.
  • Ability to explain ideas clearly and concisely.
  • Interest in product marketing, software products, and technology.
  • Willingness to learn how complex software platforms work.
  • Strong research and information-gathering skills.
  • Ability to organize information and summarize key findings.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, presentations, and written documents.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with different stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to ask questions and seek clarification when needed.
  • Ability to incorporate feedback and improve work.
  • Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently on clearly defined assignments.
  • Interest in understanding customer needs and business challenges.
  • Willingness to learn about B2B SaaS and customer journeys.
  • Strong initiative and a sense of ownership over assigned work.
  • Adaptability in a changing software environment.
  • Ability to learn new tools and processes quickly.
  • Commitment to producing accurate, well-organized work.

Nice to Have

  • Internship experience in product marketing, marketing, product management, or business operations.
