raw.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior UX Researcher, Patient & Provider Experience to lead research that helps Bask Health better understand the needs, behaviors, and challenges of patients and healthcare providers using our platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects patient onboarding, digital questionnaires, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce tools.

These experiences involve different types of users with different goals. Patients need to navigate digital healthcare experiences clearly and confidently, while providers need efficient, reliable workflows that support their responsibilities.

As a Senior UX Researcher, you'll help us understand how these users interact with the platform, where they experience friction, and what opportunities exist to improve the product.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role that combines qualitative and quantitative research, usability testing, behavioral analysis, and product strategy. You'll own research projects from defining questions and selecting methodologies through participant recruitment, study execution, analysis, and communication of findings.

Your work will focus on patient and provider experiences, including onboarding, intake questionnaires, clinical workflow interfaces, patient communications, and other interactions that influence usability and operational efficiency.

You'll conduct interviews, usability studies, concept testing, surveys, and observational research to understand user needs and evaluate existing or proposed product experiences.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers, product designers, engineers, content designers, and operational stakeholders to ensure research addresses meaningful product questions and informs decisions throughout development.

You'll also help connect qualitative findings with available product analytics and operational data, giving teams a clearer understanding of both what users do and why they do it.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, research must be conducted with appropriate attention to privacy, informed participation, sensitive information, and the boundaries of approved clinical workflows.

You'll help establish repeatable research practices, maintain organized findings, and make insights accessible to teams across the company.

We're looking for a researcher who is comfortable navigating complex product environments, can independently lead studies, and knows how to turn user evidence into practical recommendations that improve real experiences.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end UX research for patient-facing and provider-facing experiences across Bask Health.
  • Develop research plans that address product questions, user needs, and business objectives.
  • Conduct qualitative interviews with patients, providers, and other authorized research participants.
  • Plan and execute moderated and unmoderated usability studies.
  • Evaluate patient onboarding, intake questionnaires, and multi-step digital workflows.
  • Research provider experiences involving clinical and administrative platform tools.
  • Conduct concept testing to evaluate proposed product features and interaction patterns.
  • Develop surveys and structured feedback methods to understand user needs.
  • Use observational research to identify workflow inefficiencies and usability problems.
  • Analyze qualitative findings to identify patterns, motivations, and unmet needs.
  • Incorporate quantitative product data where appropriate to strengthen research conclusions.
  • Develop research questions, hypotheses, and study objectives in collaboration with product teams.
  • Recruit and screen appropriate research participants using approved processes.
  • Create interview guides, usability tasks, and research discussion materials.
  • Evaluate navigation, terminology, comprehension, and task completion across digital experiences.
  • Identify sources of confusion, unnecessary friction, and workflow abandonment.
  • Research how patients understand instructions, status updates, and next steps.
  • Study how providers interact with platform tools during approved operational workflows.
  • Develop journey maps, research summaries, and evidence-based opportunity assessments.
  • Present findings and recommendations to product managers, designers, engineers, and leadership.
  • Collaborate with product designers to validate concepts and improve proposed solutions.
  • Work with content designers to evaluate language comprehension and information clarity.
  • Partner with product managers to prioritize research opportunities.
  • Support iterative testing throughout product development and after feature launches.
  • Help establish research standards, documentation practices, and reusable study templates.
  • Maintain organized research findings and make insights accessible to relevant teams.
  • Ensure research activities respect participant privacy, consent, and appropriate data-handling requirements.
  • Independently own complex research initiatives from planning through synthesis and actionable recommendations.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in UX research, user research, product research, human-computer interaction, or a closely related field.
  • Experience independently leading end-to-end research projects for digital products.
  • Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating research methodology, findings, and product impact.
  • Strong understanding of qualitative research methods.
  • Experience conducting moderated user interviews and usability testing.
  • Familiarity with quantitative research methods and survey design.
  • Ability to select appropriate research methods based on product questions.
  • Experience developing research plans, hypotheses, and study objectives.
  • Experience recruiting and screening research participants.
  • Strong understanding of research ethics and participant consent.
  • Experience synthesizing qualitative findings into actionable insights.
  • Ability to identify behavioral patterns, usability problems, and unmet user needs.
  • Familiarity with user-centered design and product development processes.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product designers and product managers.
  • Ability to communicate research findings clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience presenting evidence-based recommendations to product teams.
  • Familiarity with usability metrics and task-based evaluation.
  • Experience working with surveys, interviews, and observational research.
  • Ability to evaluate complex workflows and multi-step user journeys.
  • Understanding of information architecture and interaction design principles.
  • Experience organizing and documenting research findings.
  • Ability to balance research rigor with practical product development timelines.
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple research priorities and deliver meaningful results.

Nice to Have

  • Experience conducting UX research for healthcare or telehealth products.
  • Familiarity with patient-facing digital healthcare experiences.
  • Experience researching provider workflows or clinical software.
  • Understanding of digital patient intake and onboarding processes.
  • Experience conducting research involving sensitive or personal information.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare-related privacy considerations.
  • Experience working with clinicians, pharmacists, or healthcare operations stakeholders.
  • Understanding of health literacy and patient comprehension challenges.
  • Experience evaluating complex forms and questionnaires.
  • Familiarity with accessibility research and inclusive study practices.
  • Experience combining qualitative research with product analytics.
  • Familiarity with tools such as UserTesting, Maze, Dovetail, Lookback, or comparable research platforms.
  • Experience using Figma prototypes during usability studies.
  • Understanding of mixed-methods research approaches.
  • Experience conducting longitudinal research or diary studies.
  • Familiarity with journey mapping and service blueprinting.
  • Experience working with multi-tenant or white-label SaaS platforms.
  • Understanding of patient-provider communication workflows.
  • Experience evaluating AI-assisted healthcare product experiences.
  • Experience developing scalable research operations and insight repositories.

If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

Job Summary

Job Summary

As the GSI Account Director for Accenture, you will own the end-to-end strategic relationship with our premier Global Systems Integrator (GSI) across the EMEA region.

This role is responsible for accelerating joint revenue growth, expanding market share, and driving deep executive and operational alignment with Accenture’s Security and Cloud practices.   • Revenue & Pipeline Growth: Own joint pipeline creation, governance, and revenue attainment for the Accenture partnership across the EMEA region, delivering predictable quarterly growth across Sell-With and Sell-Through engagements.

Shape the Narrative. Amplify Scientific Discovery. Advance Human Health.

The Jackson Laboratory (JAX), a global nonprofit biomedical research institution, seeks an experienced and strategic Director, Public Relations & Communications to lead enterprise-wide public relations, media relations, thought leadership, and research communications initiatives.

This leader will develop and execute integrated communications strategies that elevate JAX's visibility, strengthen its reputation, and position JAX and its researchers as trusted voices in biomedical research, genomics, and precision medicine. The ideal candidate is a skilled communicator, media relations expert, and strategic advisor who thrives in a fast-paced environment and excels at building relationships across scientific, executive, and external audiences.

Location & Travel

This is a remote U.S.-based position requiring periodic travel to JAX campuses and events. Preference will be given to candidates located on the East Coast.

Compensation

Salary Range: $146,306 - $212,141

Compensation is based on relevant experience, geographic location, and internal equity considerations. JAX offers a comprehensive benefits package supporting employee health, well-being, and professional growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute enterprise public relations, media relations, thought leadership, and research communications strategies aligned with JAX's mission and strategic priorities.

  • Serve as a trusted communications advisor to executive leadership and key stakeholders across the organization.

  • Develop compelling messaging, media campaigns, press materials, and thought leadership opportunities that elevate JAX's scientific impact and reputation.

  • Build and maintain relationships with media, industry influencers, external partners, and other key audiences.

  • Identify and prepare JAX leaders and researchers for media interviews, speaking opportunities, and public engagements.

  • Lead a high-performing research communications team, translating complex scientific discoveries into engaging content for diverse audiences.

  • Establish and manage communications analytics, reporting, and KPIs to measure effectiveness and inform strategy.

  • Oversee crisis communications planning, preparedness, and response activities, serving as a spokesperson when needed.

  • Manage external communications agencies and strategic partners.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.

  • 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in communications, public relations, or media relations.

  • 6+ years leading strategic communications initiatives, preferably within biomedical research, healthcare, life sciences, higher education, or nonprofit organizations.

  • Demonstrated success developing and executing communications and media relations strategies that drive measurable results.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting scientific, healthcare, biomedical research, or life sciences organizations.

  • Experience advising executive leaders and subject matter experts.

  • International media relations experience.

Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

  • Strong media relations, stakeholder management, and executive advisory capabilities.

  • Proven ability to translate complex scientific concepts into compelling stories.

  • Strategic thinker with a hands-on, results-oriented approach.

  • Experience managing multiple high-impact projects and priorities simultaneously.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience measuring communications performance and impact.

Join JAX and help tell the stories behind discoveries that are transforming human health around the world.


About JAX:

The Jackson Laboratory is an independent, nonprofit biomedical research institution with a National Cancer Institute-designated Cancer Center and nearly 3,000 employees in locations across the United States (Maine, Connecticut, California, New York, Florida), Japan and China. Its mission is to discover precise genomic solutions for disease and empower the global biomedical community in the shared quest to improve human health.


Founded in 1929, JAX applies over nine decades of expertise in genetics to increase understanding of human disease, advancing treatments and cures for cancer, neurological and immune disorders, diabetes, aging and heart disease. It models and interprets genomic complexity, integrates basic research with clinical application, educates current and future scientists, and provides critical data, tools and services to the global biomedical community. For more information, please visit www.jax.org​​​​​​​.

Position Summary:


The Senior Manager, Audit Technical Resource Group supports the delivery of high-quality audit and assurance services by providing technical guidance, quality review support, and practical resources to engagement teams. This role applies professional standards to complex accounting, auditing, and financial reporting matters and performs Report Quality Reviews (RQRs) across a variety of engagement types and industries, helping teams navigate technical issues and maintain compliance with firm and regulatory requirements.


Through technical consultation, training, and collaboration, the Senior Manager strengthens the capabilities of client-facing professionals, promotes consistency in the application of professional standards, and contributes to the firm's commitment to audit quality and technical excellence. Success in this role requires both strong technical accounting knowledge and significant hands-on experience preparing and reviewing financial statements across a broad range of industries and engagement types.


Responsibilities:


Technical Execution

  • Perform Report Quality Reviews of financial statements and assurance reports across a variety of engagement types and industries to help ensure technical accuracy, consistency, and compliance with firm methodology and professional standards.
  • Research, analyze, and formally document technical accounting and auditing issues to ensure GAAP compliance
  • Respond to advanced technical inquiries using professional standards and research tools
  • Develop and update technical tools, templates, training materials, and whitepaper guidance on complex accounting issues
  • Participate in internal inspections, peer reviews, and quality management activities, including documentation and follow-up
  • Deliver and support technical training through firmwide programs such as TRG News and Technically Speaking webinars
  • Develop and maintain advanced knowledge of accounting and auditing standards, including new and emerging guidance
  • Maintain current knowledge of GAAP, professional standards, and technology platforms relevant to assurance services

Workflow, Communication & Collaboration

  • Support KSM staff with ad hoc technical, quality, risk, and independence matters
  • Contribute to innovation and compliance initiatives within the Audit practice
  • Enhance marketing efforts by contributing thought leadership articles, whitepapers, and guidance on technical matters
  • Collaborate with Audit leadership to support execution of technical quality and operational initiatives across the Audit practice
  • Partner with internal communications on current assurance and accounting concepts, process improvements, and changes

Requirements/Qualifications:


Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting (Master's degree a plus)
  • Active CPA license in good standing

Experience

  • 5+ years of progressive public accounting audit experience, including significant experience preparing and/or reviewing financial statements across multiple industries and engagement types
  • Demonstrated experience performing detailed review of financial statements and disclosures with a strong understanding of financial reporting requirements under U.S. GAAP
  • Demonstrated experience researching, interpreting, and applying accounting and auditing standards to complex matters
  • Experience mentoring or supervising audit professionals
  • Solid background in US GAAP and knowledge of current audit and accounting concepts
  • Ability to research technical issues and create or review technical documentation, accounting memos, financial statements, and auditor reports supporting accounting and internal control matters

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, national origin, race, religion, veteran status, or any other protected category.

KSM only accepts resumes directly submitted by a candidate and referrals submitted by current KSM employees. raw.title: Security Engineer
raw.excerpt: As a Security Engineer at Stacks Labs, you'll work with the CTO to help building secure systems, including the sBTC signer network, the Stacks node, our smart contracts, and the infrastructure and release pipeline that ship them.
raw.description:
As a Security Engineer at Stacks Labs, you'll work with the CTO to help building secure systems, including the sBTC signer network, the Stacks node, our smart contracts, and the infrastructure and release pipeline that ship them.

You'll operate autonomously in a fully remote role, embedded with a globally distributed engineering team. This is a hands-on role for someone who would rather find and fix the bug instead of writing a slide about it.

Outcomes You'll Drive

  • We find our vulnerabilities before anyone else does
    You hunt through code, infrastructure, and deployments with an attacker's mindset. The things you find get triaged, remediated, fixed.
  • Security that ships as code
    Your work produces pull requests, hardened configs, detection rules, and tests. Engineers see you as someone who makes their systems better, not someone who slows them down.
  • A hardened perimeter where it matters
    Key custody, secrets management, access control, CI/CD, and the software supply chain are locked down against the realistic threats to a system securing crypto-assets.
  • An AI-augmented security practice
    LLMs and coding agents multiply your reach across code review, fuzzing, triage, and log analysis. You know exactly where they help, where they lie, and how to build systems that leverage them to scale things up.
  • Calm, rehearsed incident response
    When something goes wrong there's a playbook, a clear owner, and a blameless postmortem that leaves the system stronger than before.

What You'll Do

Offense

  • Threat model and attack our software, infrastructure, and contracts. Write exploits against our own systems before adversaries do.
  • Build and run fuzzing, property-based, and adversarial test harnesses.
  • Run internal red-team exercises and coordinate external audits and bug bounty programs, triaging and validating what comes back.

Defense

  • Detection and monitoring: what does "compromised" look like, and how do we know within minutes rather than days?
  • Harden hosts, CI/CD, and the software supply chain. Audit dependencies and design reproducible builds and signed/attested releases.
  • Support incident response and post-incident reviews.

Engineering & Tooling

  • Review security-sensitive PRs across the codebase and pair with engineers on secure design.
  • Build AI-driven security tooling: agents for code review and dependency triage, LLM-assisted log analysis, automated first-pass audits of new contracts and integrations.
  • Write clear, actionable findings and advisories for internal teams, external signers, and partners.

What We're Looking For

  • Security is what you do for fun, not just for work. CTFs, bug bounties, side research, reading advisories at breakfast.
  • 5+ years in software engineering and ****a meaningful portion of it in security. Red team, blue team, appsec, detection engineering, or security research.
  • Solid programming foundation. You read and write production code (Rust, Go, C, TypeScript, Python, or similar), and you understand systems, networking, and cryptography.
  • Hands-on offensive or defensive experience: exploit development, pentesting, incident response, detection engineering, or hardening production systems.
  • Pragmatism. You measure yourself in closed attack paths and shipped fixes. You know risk matrices exist, but you don't lead with them.
  • Fluency with AI tooling. You use LLMs and coding agents daily in security work, you've built something with them, and you have grounded opinions about their failure modes.
  • Strong written communication. Findings, advisories, and design reviews that people actually read and act on.
  • Comfort working remotely and autonomously across time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Expertise in Rust, our primary language.
  • Bitcoin protocol internals, or experience auditing smart contracts (Clarity, Solidity, or similar).
  • Threshold signatures, MPC, or applied cryptography.
  • Security of distributed systems and consensus protocols.
  • Cloud and infrastructure security.
  • Experience building AI agents for security workflows, or securing systems that integrate LLMs.
  • A public track record: CVEs, published research, notable CTF placings, or bug bounty history.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation including $160,000-$200,000 USD base salary.
  • Stacks (STX) tokens - STX is the native cryptocurrency of the Stacks network.
  • Comprehensive health coverage and free life and disability insurance.
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave to support you through one of life's biggest transitions.
  • Monthly stipends for your home office or co-working space of choice.
  • Annual learning and development stipend to keep growing your skills.
  • An open vacation policy, take the days you need when you need.
  • 401(k) with a 3% match.
  • A high-ownership role shaping some of the most critical infrastructure in the Stacks ecosystem.
  • A fast-moving, focused team where strong engineering judgment is valued and where your work will ship quickly and visibly.
  • The chance to define engineering standards for one of the most ambitious Bitcoin L2 ecosystems, shaping how Bitcoin moves in and out of smart contracts.
  • A remote-first culture with flexibility, autonomy, and deep collaboration with product and engineering.

Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

At the end of this thrilling journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to help redefine cybersecurity expertise. Get ready for an exciting adventure into the world of cybersecurity! 🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Customer Success, Senior Manager:

As the Senior Manager, US, your mission is to lead and empower a team of Customer Success Associates and Managers in the US, fostering excellence in customer experiences that drive retention, adoption, expansion, and growth. You aim to take full ownership of key CS operating model initiatives, collaborate cross-functionally, and leverage data to continuously improve client experiences, while building trust-based relationships with senior client stakeholders.

Your active participation in the Customer Success leadership team contributes to the vision, strategy, planning, and execution, ensuring strategic growth and the success of your customers.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

  • Location: US
  • Fully remote
  • Full-time role

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

As the Senior Manager, Customer Success, you will report to the Head of CS, NORAM and Fed and work closely with a diverse range of stakeholders, including your team of Customer Success Associates and Managers, as well as leaders in Sales, Product, Engineering, RevOps, Finance, and Marketing. ChurnZero, HubSpot, Tableau, Slack, Gong & the 3 As (Adaptability - Active Listening - Assertiveness). HackTheBox, obviously!

📚 Interesting resources you should check:

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming a Customer Success, Senior Manager at Hack The Box:

  • Own and drive the regional Gross Retention Rate (GRR) and Net Retention Rate (NRR) metrics
  • Recruit, manage & coach a team of Customer Success Associates and Customer Success Managers in the US, and empower them to deliver excellent customer experiences that drive retention & adoption, as well as expansion & growth.

So, if you're ready to embark on a journey of disruption, growth, and adventure, we can't wait to meet you!

raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, we understand that helping a customer launch is only the beginning. Long-term success comes from helping businesses adopt the platform, understand its capabilities, and continue getting value as their operations evolve. We value people who take initiative, understand how online businesses work, build strong relationships, and identify practical ways to improve customer retention.

About the Role

We're looking for a Merchant Adoption & Retention Manager to help e-commerce businesses successfully adopt Bask Health's telehealth platform, maintain consistent engagement, and continue seeing value from the software.

This is a hands-on post-sale customer success position with a specialized focus on merchant activation, adoption, retention, and reducing preventable customer churn.

You'll work with entrepreneurs, online merchants, and growing businesses to understand how they use Bask Health, where they encounter challenges, and what support they need to remain successful.

You'll help identify the factors that contribute to strong customer engagement and the warning signs that a merchant may be struggling or considering leaving.

Bask Health provides software that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and manage direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

Our platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll develop a strong understanding of the merchant-facing platform experience and the steps involved in successfully adopting supported capabilities.

You'll work with merchants at different stages of their customer lifecycle.

You'll help recently onboarded merchants transition from initial setup into active platform usage.

You'll identify situations where customers have completed onboarding but are not consistently using the platform.

You'll help merchants understand the next practical steps they can take to improve adoption.

You'll work with Customer Success Managers and other internal teams to identify obstacles that may be limiting customer engagement.

You'll help develop structured adoption plans based on each merchant's business goals and current platform usage.

You'll provide approved guidance on platform capabilities that may be relevant to a merchant's needs.

You'll recognize that different merchants have different business models, operating experience, and growth priorities.

You'll adapt your communication and support approach based on the customer's level of experience and business needs.

You'll build relationships with entrepreneurs, founders, and business owners.

You'll take time to understand what each merchant is trying to accomplish with Bask Health.

You'll identify whether a merchant's challenges relate to product understanding, operational processes, technical issues, or unmet expectations.

You'll work with the appropriate teams to address those challenges.

You'll proactively engage merchants who appear to be struggling with activation or ongoing adoption.

You'll help customers understand how supported platform workflows fit into their business operations.

You'll coordinate with onboarding and customer success teams to improve transitions between customer lifecycle stages.

You'll identify recurring onboarding issues that may lead to long-term disengagement.

You'll share practical recommendations for improving the merchant onboarding experience.

You'll help develop follow-up strategies for merchants who have not reached expected activation milestones.

You'll monitor available customer engagement indicators to identify adoption trends.

You'll review relevant account activity, platform usage, and support history when authorized.

You'll recognize when declining engagement may indicate an increased risk of churn.

You'll help develop proactive retention plans for merchants showing signs of disengagement.

You'll reach out to at-risk merchants through approved communication channels.

You'll ask questions to understand the underlying reasons for reduced usage or dissatisfaction.

You'll work with customers to identify realistic next steps for addressing their concerns.

You'll coordinate with Customer Success Managers when an account requires broader relationship management or renewal planning.

You'll help ensure merchants receive consistent communication during retention-related discussions.

You'll track retention risks, customer concerns, and follow-up commitments in approved systems.

You'll help maintain clear records of adoption progress and retention activities.

You'll participate in discussions about customers who may be considering cancellation or non-renewal.

You'll contribute relevant information about customer engagement, unresolved issues, and possible retention opportunities.

You'll support renewal readiness by helping merchants recognize the value they receive from the platform.

You'll avoid making unauthorized commitments about pricing, contract terms, credits, refunds, or product functionality.

You'll coordinate commercial requests with authorized leadership or sales representatives.

You'll help identify customers who could benefit from adopting additional existing platform capabilities.

You'll recommend relevant adoption opportunities based on actual merchant needs.

You'll focus on sustainable customer engagement rather than unnecessary upselling.

You'll work with product and engineering teams to communicate recurring adoption barriers.

You'll identify platform features or workflows that customers frequently misunderstand.

You'll help document technical issues that prevent merchants from completing expected tasks.

You'll coordinate with technical support or customer success engineering when specialized troubleshooting is required.

You'll communicate approved updates to merchants while issues are being investigated.

You'll help ensure unresolved technical problems are considered when assessing account health and retention risk.

You'll identify patterns in customer feedback that may indicate opportunities for product improvements.

You'll contribute to customer education resources that make it easier for merchants to use supported platform features.

You'll help improve onboarding guides, adoption checklists, and merchant-facing instructional materials.

You'll participate in developing repeatable engagement and retention playbooks.

You'll help identify effective communication strategies for merchants at different stages of their lifecycle.

You'll contribute ideas for re-engaging inactive or low-engagement customers.

You'll help distinguish between customers who need additional education and those experiencing broader product or business challenges.

You'll work with customer success leadership to prioritize retention initiatives.

You'll help identify opportunities to improve customer lifecycle processes.

You'll contribute to the development of practical customer health indicators.

You'll help track metrics such as activation progress, feature adoption, customer engagement, churn risk, and retention.

You'll use available customer data to identify patterns and recommend appropriate actions.

You'll help prepare summaries of adoption trends and recurring retention concerns.

You'll contribute to discussions about customer churn reasons and opportunities to prevent avoidable cancellations.

You'll help improve how the team documents and categorizes customer disengagement.

You'll participate in customer business reviews when adoption or retention concerns require additional attention.

You'll communicate clearly with merchants about their goals, challenges, and available platform capabilities.

You'll work with founders and business owners who expect practical answers and timely follow-through.

You'll manage multiple merchant relationships or initiatives while maintaining accurate records.

You'll prioritize work based on customer needs, engagement risks, and approved team objectives.

You'll take ownership of assigned adoption and retention activities.

You'll follow through on commitments and communicate proactively when additional support is needed.

You'll collaborate with sales, onboarding, customer success, technical support, product, and engineering teams.

You'll help ensure customer feedback reaches the teams best positioned to address it.

You'll recognize when a merchant request involves clinical, pharmacy, or compliance matters.

You'll direct those requests to the appropriate licensed or authorized teams.

You'll never provide medical advice, make clinical decisions, or promise prescription-related outcomes.

You'll follow approved privacy, security, and information-handling procedures.

You'll maintain professional and constructive communication when working with dissatisfied customers.

You'll be comfortable having direct conversations about why a merchant is not using the platform as expected.

You'll approach retention challenges with curiosity and problem-solving rather than relying on generic sales tactics.

You'll understand that long-term customer retention depends on delivering meaningful value and maintaining trust.

You'll help improve the consistency of merchant engagement across the customer lifecycle.

You'll contribute to a team environment that values ownership, initiative, accountability, and continuous improvement.

We're looking for someone with at least two full years of genuine post-sale Customer Success experience and recent, substantive e-commerce experience.

You should understand how online merchants operate and have experience helping customers adopt software, remain engaged, and overcome challenges that affect retention.

Experience with customer health monitoring, churn prevention, renewal support, or retention initiatives would be particularly valuable.

Success in this role means improving merchant activation and adoption, identifying retention risks early, strengthening customer engagement, and helping Bask Health build long-term relationships with the businesses using its platform.

What You'll Do

  • Support merchant activation and ongoing platform adoption.
  • Help merchants transition from onboarding into consistent platform usage.

  • Develop practical adoption plans based on merchant goals and needs.
  • Build relationships with entrepreneurs, founders, and business owners.

  • Help analyze recurring reasons for customer disengagement.
  • Participate in customer business reviews and account planning discussions.
  • Collaborate with sales, onboarding, customer success, and technical teams.
  • Escalate clinical, pharmacy, and compliance matters to authorized teams.
  • Follow approved privacy, security, and information-handling procedures.
  • Manage multiple merchant relationships or initiatives with strong organization.
  • Take ownership of assigned adoption and retention activities and follow through consistently.

Benefits

  • At least 2 full years of genuine post-sale Customer Success experience with direct responsibility for customer relationships.
  • Demonstrated ownership of customer onboarding, adoption, ongoing engagement, retention, or renewals.
  • Recent, substantive experience working with e-commerce merchants, online stores, or merchant-facing commerce software.
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce operations and direct-to-consumer business models.
  • Experience helping customers adopt and consistently use SaaS products.
  • Ability to identify customer engagement challenges and potential retention risks.
  • Experience building relationships with entrepreneurs, founders, or business owners.
  • Strong customer communication and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to understand customer business goals and connect them to supported product capabilities.
  • Experience developing customer follow-up plans or adoption strategies.
  • Ability to investigate reasons for customer dissatisfaction or declining engagement.
  • Experience managing customer concerns and coordinating appropriate solutions.
  • Familiarity with customer retention, renewal support, or churn prevention processes.
  • Experience collaborating with technical support, product, or engineering teams.
  • Ability to explain software workflows clearly to non-technical customers.
  • Experience maintaining accurate customer records, account notes, and follow-up commitments.
  • Familiarity with CRM or customer success management tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple merchant relationships or customer success initiatives.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to take initiative.
  • Ability to recognize when customer requests require specialized assistance.
  • Experience working collaboratively with sales, onboarding, or other customer-facing teams.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Availability to collaborate during required U.S. Eastern Time working hours.
  • Comfortable working in a growing software company with evolving processes and priorities.
  • Strong accountability for customer engagement and assigned retention initiatives.

Nice to Have

  • Experience as a Customer Success Manager at an e-commerce SaaS company.
  • Experience supporting Shopify merchants or direct-to-consumer brands.
  • Familiarity with Shopify, BigCommerce, Klaviyo, Recharge, Gorgias, Yotpo, or similar commerce platforms.
  • Personal experience owning or operating an e-commerce business.
  • Experience developing customer adoption or activation programs.
  • Experience identifying and reducing customer churn.
  • Experience creating retention strategies for SaaS customers.
  • Experience managing at-risk accounts or customer re-engagement initiatives.
  • Familiarity with customer health scoring and engagement monitoring.
  • Experience supporting customer renewals or cancellation prevention.
  • Experience working with gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, or churn metrics.
  • Experience using Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, ChurnZero, or similar tools.
  • Experience analyzing product adoption or customer usage data.
  • Experience developing customer lifecycle communication programs.
  • Experience conducting customer business reviews.
  • Experience improving onboarding processes and adoption resources.
  • Experience collaborating with customer success engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with online storefronts, checkout, subscriptions, and payment workflows.
  • Experience supporting healthcare technology or telehealth businesses.
  • Experience working directly with founders or senior business stakeholders.

raw.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Researcher to help Bask Health better understand how people use our software, what challenges they experience, and where opportunities exist to build better products.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools.

As a Product Researcher, you'll investigate the needs, behaviors, and expectations of the people who interact with these products. Your findings will help inform product strategy, feature development, workflow improvements, and design decisions.

This is a hands-on research role combining qualitative and quantitative methods, product discovery, usability evaluation, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll help teams understand both what users are doing and why they behave the way they do.

Your work will span multiple areas of Bask Health's platform. You may research how merchants configure their businesses, how patients navigate onboarding, how users interact with complex workflows, or how new product concepts address existing problems.

You'll conduct user interviews, surveys, usability studies, concept evaluations, and other research activities to identify unmet needs and evaluate product experiences.

You'll also help connect research findings with available product analytics, customer feedback, and operational observations. By combining different sources of evidence, you'll help teams distinguish isolated complaints from recurring problems and meaningful product opportunities.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers to define research questions, prioritize studies, and identify where additional evidence is needed before making product decisions.

You'll work with product designers and content designers to evaluate prototypes, improve usability, and validate whether proposed solutions address actual user needs.

You'll also partner with engineers and customer-facing teams to understand technical constraints, recurring support issues, and the operational context behind product behavior.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, research must be conducted with appropriate attention to privacy, participant consent, sensitive information, and the boundaries of approved clinical workflows.

You'll help document research findings, organize insights, and make recommendations accessible to teams across the company.

We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, comfortable working with different types of users, and able to turn research evidence into practical recommendations that help teams build better software.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct product research across Bask Health's merchant-facing, patient-facing, and operational software experiences.
  • Partner with product managers to identify research questions and product discovery priorities.
  • Develop research plans that align with product goals and user needs.
  • Conduct user interviews to understand behaviors, motivations, and challenges.
  • Plan and execute moderated and unmoderated usability studies.
  • Design surveys and structured feedback activities.
  • Evaluate new product concepts before development.
  • Test prototypes to identify usability problems and opportunities for improvement.
  • Research how merchants interact with storefront configuration and business management tools.
  • Investigate user experiences across onboarding, questionnaires, and other multi-step workflows.
  • Study how users navigate complex settings, forms, and administrative interfaces.
  • Identify recurring friction points and unmet user needs.
  • Analyze qualitative research findings to identify themes and patterns.
  • Incorporate quantitative product data where appropriate.
  • Review customer feedback and operational observations to identify research opportunities.
  • Help distinguish user preferences from underlying product problems.
  • Collaborate with product designers to improve proposed solutions.
  • Work with content designers to evaluate terminology, instructions, and comprehension.
  • Partner with engineers to understand technical constraints affecting user experiences.
  • Develop interview guides, usability tasks, and research discussion materials.
  • Recruit and screen research participants through approved processes.
  • Create research summaries, journey maps, and actionable recommendations.
  • Present findings clearly to product, design, engineering, and leadership stakeholders.
  • Support research during product discovery, development, and post-launch evaluation.
  • Track recurring user problems and help teams understand changes over time.
  • Maintain organized research documentation and reusable findings.
  • Follow appropriate privacy, consent, and data-handling practices.
  • Independently manage assigned research projects from planning through analysis and presentation.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in product research, UX research, user research, or a closely related field.
  • Portfolio or case studies demonstrating research work and product impact.
  • Experience planning and conducting research for digital products.
  • Strong understanding of qualitative research methods.
  • Experience conducting user interviews and usability testing.
  • Familiarity with quantitative research methods and survey design.
  • Ability to develop clear research questions and study objectives.
  • Experience selecting research methods appropriate to different product problems.
  • Ability to synthesize research findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience identifying user behaviors, pain points, and unmet needs.
  • Familiarity with user-centered design and product development processes.
  • Experience collaborating with product managers and product designers.
  • Ability to communicate research findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience creating interview guides, usability tasks, and research materials.
  • Familiarity with participant recruitment and screening.
  • Understanding of research ethics and informed participation.
  • Ability to evaluate complex digital workflows and user journeys.
  • Experience organizing and documenting research findings.
  • Familiarity with product analytics or behavioral data.
  • Ability to combine multiple sources of evidence to support product decisions.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and research quality.
  • Ability to balance research rigor with product development timelines.
  • Ability to independently manage research projects and collaborate across teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience conducting research for SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with B2B software and merchant-facing applications.
  • Experience researching e-commerce or direct-to-consumer products.
  • Background in healthcare, telehealth, or patient-facing digital experiences.
  • Experience researching complex administrative workflows.
  • Familiarity with storefront configuration, subscriptions, or commerce operations.
  • Understanding of healthcare-related privacy considerations.
  • Experience conducting research involving sensitive information.
  • Familiarity with tools such as UserTesting, Maze, Dovetail, Lookback, or comparable research platforms.
  • Experience evaluating interactive prototypes in Figma.
  • Understanding of mixed-methods research approaches.
  • Experience combining qualitative findings with product analytics.
  • Familiarity with journey mapping and service blueprinting.
  • Experience researching white-label or multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Understanding of accessibility research and inclusive study practices.
  • Experience conducting longitudinal research or diary studies.

raw.description:
Job Description: Ground Combat & Special Operations Subject Matter Expert

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Ground Combat and Special Operations Subject Matter Experts to support a specialized project focused on evaluating AI systems in military-related contexts. In this role, you will apply your operational knowledge and professional judgment to develop realistic evaluation scenarios and assess AI-generated responses.

Your expertise will help improve how AI systems understand military concepts, evaluate complex situations, handle uncertainty, and recognize lawful and unlawful operational boundaries. Previous AI experience is not required; relevant military experience and domain knowledge are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Develop and classify challenging, realistic case studies involving ground-combat and special-operations scenarios, including operational decision-making, execution considerations, and unlawful planning.
  2. Apply knowledge of tactical ground maneuver and direct-action operations to assess complex or ambiguous scenarios.
  3. Evaluate AI-generated responses for source quality, uncertainty handling, reasoning, limitations, and operational relevance.
  4. Identify cases where AI systems unnecessarily refuse legitimate conceptual, doctrinal, or military-readiness questions.
  5. Validate scenarios against authentic ground-combat and special-operations practices to ensure operational realism.
  6. Document edge cases, evaluation findings, and supporting rationale to maintain a rigorous and defensible assessment process.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Hands-on experience in ground-combat units, including infantry, armor, or reconnaissance, or special-operations units such as SOF, Special Forces, raiders, or equivalent allied forces.
  2. Proven responsibility for decision-making in ground maneuver, direct-action, or close-combat operations.
  3. Strong understanding of lawful and unlawful boundaries in tactical military operations.
  4. Experience instructing, mentoring, conducting after-action reviews, leading debriefings, or delivering team-, platoon-, or company-level training.
  5. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex tactical concepts clearly.
  6. Relevant military qualifications, such as SFQC, SEAL/SWCC, allied special-operations equivalents, Ranger or equivalent tabs, or advanced NCO and command experience.
  7. Experience in joint or combined operations, interagency environments, AI evaluation, wargaming, or red-team exercises is an advantage.

Great options and opportunities. We’re certified as a Great Place To Work® and are looking for professionals to help us make Banner Health the best place to work and receive care. Apply today!


The Clinical Opportunity Development department leads Banner Health’s clinical registry abstraction utilizing an AI-assisted Platform. The department manages the full lifecycle of registry reporting — abstraction, QA validation, inter-rater reliability, and submission — across 16+ registries including NSQIP, CathPCI, GWTG Stroke, and Cancer COC, ensuring Banner maintains its hospital certifications and mandatory state and federal reporting obligations. Beyond compliance, the department returns national benchmark performance data to care teams, physician leaders, and nursing leadership to drive clinical quality improvement across the system. It also oversees national rankings strategy (U.S. News, Leapfrog, CMS Stars) and outcomes intelligence to position Banner’s clinical performance against peer institutions.


The Clinical Registry Reporting Specialist responsibilities include turning raw clinical documentation into reportable data that puts Banner Health’s outcomes on the national stage- then watching the same data flow back to the surgeons, cardiologists, and nurses who can act on it to improve patient care.


The ideal candidate will have RN experience for abstraction, NCDR LAAO and STS Congenital and STS General Thoracic registry experience.


Monday to Friday 8am - 4:30pm


This is a fully remote position and available if you live in the following states only: AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NH, NC, ND, NE, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV & WY.

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for abstracting clinical data from the Cerner electronic health record into national and state clinical registries (e.g., ACC/NCDR, STS, AHA Get with The Guidelines, ACS NSQIP, and other state-mandated registries), ensuring data accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with registry specifications. This role also performs quality assurance validation and inter-rater reliability (IRR) testing, maintains current knowledge of evolving registry and clinical guideline requirements, and translates registry benchmark data into actionable performance comparisons of Banner Health against national and peer-system outcomes.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Data Abstraction: Abstracts clinical, procedural, and outcomes data from the Cerner patient chart into assigned clinical registries per each registry's data dictionary and specifications.


2. Quality Assurance: Performs routine QA validation on abstracted records to ensure data integrity, completeness, and accuracy prior to registry submission.


3. Inter-Rater Reliability (IRR): Participates in and supports IRR testing/audits to maintain abstraction consistency across the team and meet registry-required reliability thresholds.


4. Registry Submission: Submits validated data within registry deadlines to ACC/NCDR, STS, AHA GWTG, ACS NSQIP, and other assigned registries.


5. Guideline Currency: Maintains up-to-date knowledge of registry specification changes, clinical guideline updates, and abstraction rule changes; complete required registry certifications/training.


6. Benchmarking & Reporting: Retrieves registry performance reports and translate results into clear benchmark comparisons of Banner Health performance against national and peer-system data for clinical and executive stakeholders.


7. Cross-Functional Coverage: Works flexibly across multiple registries and service lines as assigned, supporting a consistent, system-wide abstraction and benchmarking function.


8. Collaboration: Partners with physicians, service line leaders, quality teams, and registry coordinators to resolve data questions and support performance improvement initiatives.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelors degree in Nursing, Physician Assistant Studies, Medicine (MBBS, MD, DO), or equivalent working knowledge in other related clinical healthcare fields.

Requires 2 to 4 years of clinical experience in an acute care hospital setting.

Strong understanding of medical terminology, chart review, and clinical documentation, high attention to detail with demonstrated data accuracy and quality focus, Proficiency with EHR systems (Cerner Strongly Preferred).


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


Certifications in SCR (Surgical Clinical Reviewer), ODS (Oncology Data Specialist)

Prior experience with clinical registry abstraction (ACC/NCDR, STS, NSQIP, AHA GWTG, Cancer/COC or state registries), Certified clinical data abstractor credential (e.g., CCDS, RHIA/RHIT, or registry-specific certification), Experience with performance benchmarking, dashboards, or quality reporting tools (e.g., Power BI).


Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

raw.description:
Company Summary

Sorenson Communications, incorporating SignVideo and Sign Language Interactions, is a well-established company with a proven track record of service delivery within the public, private and voluntary sector. In addition to providing communication support services, we also have experience in working with health boards, local authorities and other organisations to scope out local needs, pilot and deliver services. We are a Face to Face, Video Relay Services and Video Remote Interpreting provider in the UK. We provide British Sign Language (BSL) video interpreting services to enable communication between the community of over 150,000 deaf BSL users in the UK and hearing people. Our relay service allows users to make and receive BSL interpreted video calls so that they can effectively and effortlessly communicate with each other.

We are passionate about providing communication services and working in partnership with other organisations who share the same objectives. Our staff are fully committed to providing the best quality of service possible.

Role Description

Working for a leading video relay service company, you will be providing access and inclusion for the Deaf community by interpreting telephone calls and interpreting remotely. Using a custom-built platform, you will connect Deaf people to organisations, colleagues, friends and family.

In this role it is expected that you will process calls from Deaf people wishing to contact partner organisations, as well as calls from and to Deaf customers who are registered with the service. You may be asked to translate written documents from and into English or to act as a remote interpreter for pre booked appointments and meetings. A nominated Shift Lead will be available to support you throughout your shift.

There is a large degree of autonomy within this role, and you are expected to use your professional judgement whilst on calls including managing the length of time you are on a call before you transfer to a colleague and managing your need for micro breaks between scheduled break times.

Duties & Responsibilities

  1. Within defined boundaries, to maintain the confidentiality of all participants in the interpreted calls.
  2. To be aware of, and to alert Interpreter Team Leads/hearing call participants as appropriate if you hear or see anything that may raise a safeguarding concern.
  3. To follow agreed policies and procedures whilst processing calls
  4. To interpret telephone calls to partner organisations.
  5. To provide remote interpreting to partner organisations who have agreed this service
  6. To interpret telephone calls from and to individual Deaf customers who are registered with us
  7. To translate brief written documents from English into Sign Language as required by individual Deaf customers
  8. To translate brief signed documents from Sign Language into English as required by individual Deaf customers
  9. To report any concerns or difficulties to the Team Lead/Shift Lead
  10. To remain in contact with interpreter colleagues and keep them informed of breaks using the means provided.
  11. To demonstrate flexibility in supporting the various video services that we provide to meet business needs as directed by the shift lead.

Person Specification

Essential:

  • Registered with the NRCPD, RBSLI, or SRLPDC as a Registered Sign Language Interpreter.
  • Three years post qualification and experience in a range of domains.
  • Suitable home working space
  • Fast, reliable broadband connected via an ethernet cable

Desirable:

  • Experience in video interpreting (though training will be provided)
  • Technology comfortable
  • Flexibility in your approach to work
  • Other Sign Language skills an advantage

What We Offer

  • Fixed hourly rates of pay
  • PC that meets our requirements
  • Access to free and low cost CPD and reflective practice
  • Support from experienced Lead Interpreters
  • Access to Mental Health First Aiders

*Additional Benefits Offered for Staff Interpreters

We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a successful company. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity.

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals with U.S. and Canadian companies, building high-performing remote teams across Latin America and other global markets. We focus on meaningful long-term opportunities, clear expectations, and giving remote professionals the support they need to succeed.

For this role, you will support a U.S.-based neurology practice serving patients across multiple providers, with a strong focus on responsive communication, accurate scheduling, and reliable administrative coordination.

About the Role

As a Virtual Medical Assistant / Medical Administrative Assistant, you will help keep the practice running smoothly by managing incoming patient calls, coordinating appointments, and supporting essential administrative workflows.

You will work across multiple providers and help patients navigate scheduling, insurance verification, referrals, and prior authorizations. The practice is also preparing to transition to Epic, giving you the opportunity to gain or deepen hands-on experience with one of the most widely used EHR platforms in U.S. healthcare.

This is a long-term role for someone who communicates with empathy, stays organized when priorities shift, and can be trusted with sensitive patient information. You will work Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a professional and empathetic first point of contact for patients calling the practice.

  • Maintain complete and accurate patient demographics, appointment information, and administrative records within the practice's EHR.
  • Help patients move through the administrative process smoothly by supporting insurance eligibility and benefits verification.
  • Coordinate referrals and follow through on required documentation so patients can access appropriate care without unnecessary delays.
  • Support prior authorization workflows and complete administrative follow-ups with patients, providers, insurers, and internal team members.
  • Keep providers and internal staff informed of scheduling changes, patient needs, and administrative issues that may affect care.
  • Protect confidential patient information and follow HIPAA-compliant procedures in all communications and documentation.
  • Participate actively in team meetings, training sessions, and process improvements.
  • Learn and transition into Epic as the practice implements the platform in the coming months.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • Previous experience in medical administrative support, patient scheduling, medical reception, or a similar healthcare support role.
  • Experience supporting a U.S. neurology practice or another U.S. medical specialty.
  • Working knowledge of insurance verification, referrals, and prior authorization processes.
  • Strong spoken and written English, with the confidence and professionalism to handle patient phone calls throughout the workday.
  • Experience scheduling appointments and managing calendars for multiple physicians or healthcare providers.
  • Familiarity with medical terminology, patient registration, EHR systems, and medical office workflows.
  • Must currently be based in Mexico due to the client's Epic access and tool restrictions, and must be available full-time Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time.

Nice to Have:

  • Previous hands-on experience with Epic EHR.
  • Familiarity with high-volume patient scheduling and telephone workflows.
  • Experience adapting to an EHR implementation or system transition.

raw.description:
About Convertr

Convertr is the enterprise data integrity layer that ensures clean, compliant, and complete data flows across systems and teams. Global leaders like Microsoft, Oracle, Amazon, Stripe, and HP use Convertr to improve data quality, accelerate operations, and gain full transparency across their lead and data supply chains. By automating complex workflows and standardizing data at scale, Convertr helps organizations drive better decisions, reduce risk, and unlock the full value of their data. The best convert with Convertr.

Why Convertr?

You will be joining a rapidly growing scale-up, with the opportunity to work closely with businesses across our ecosystem of brands, agencies, and publishers – it’s a really exciting time to join the Convertr team. At Convertr, we’re building a platform that delivers real value to B2B businesses, driving operational efficiency and improving the quality of lead data. Our global, API-first platform allows businesses to track and analyse the success of their marketing campaigns and convert their lead data into powerful prospects.

We offer the opportunity to shape your own career, with exposure to industry-leading technologies that are reshaping the demand generation landscape. If you’re a driven, creative, collaborative individual who is looking for a role where you can really make a difference, you’ve come to the right place.

Our unique culture

Our culture is built on integrity, collaboration, respect and expertise, and these core values underpin everything that we do. If you’re driven by innovation, Convertr is right for you. We’re proud to foster a working environment that is collaborative, inclusive and transparent, where our differences are celebrated and we encourage and support the team to be the best versions of themselves. In an exciting time of significant growth, you’ll play a big part in our mission of helping our customers scale, drive operational efficiencies and improving the quality of their lead data. As we continue to scale, we want to hear from talented, driven problem-solvers, who can help us work towards transforming the demand generation landscape.

Position Overview

As a Technical Account Manager, you serve as a product expert of the Customer Success team. Your role involves working across our Support and Services teams to deliver value to our customer base. You will serve as a trusted advisor to our customer base to drive maximum value and adoption of our platform. You will also be an internal escalation point that sits between our Sales, Engineering and wider Customer success team, leveraging your technical expertise and interpersonal skills to build strong relationships and provide internal and external guidance to drive customer success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Onboarding and Training: You will be at the forefront of our customer onboarding experience, providing insights and guidance on best practices as well as assisting with training and development of both new and existing customers.

  • Incident Escalation: You will work alongside our Support and Engineering teams as second-line support, using your deep understanding of our products and features to provide effective solutions and communicate complex issues for escalation.

  • Technical POC: helping build new workflows and working directly with customers to understand use cases and leverage our platform for bespoke, automated workflows.

  • Services and QA: As part of the Services team, you will be responsible for overseeing and managing customer portfolios, including optimisation and QA of platform activity. As an advocate for the customer, you will also manage feedback, pain points and requests with our Product team.

Experience Required

  • 3+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Customer Success, or similar

role in a fast-paced environment

  • Knowledge and understanding of API documentation and usage

  • Experience with CRMs such as Salesforce, Marketo, Hubspot

  • Experience with customer service software (Zendesk or similar)

  • Experience with basic SQL queries desirable but not required

Skills and qualifications

  • Have a high level of intellectual curiosity and the ability to learn constantly.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-diagnosis, and creative problem-solving skills with thedesire and ability to identify and help implement changes

  • Self-driven and proactive nature – a bias for speed and action

  • Strong listening and verbal communication skills: you will need to quickly understand customer needs and deliver a clear and concise response both in person and on video calls

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, being able to explain complex information in simple, clear terms to people without technical backgrounds

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively

  • Highly organized, collaborative and detail-oriented

  • You’re known for being a good collaborator and can motivate or maintain enthusiasm

Working with us means

You will be joining a high-growth fast fast-moving company working with enterprise global brands whilst enjoying every moment with a sociable team from all over the world, also including the below:

  • 25 days holiday plus an extra day for your birthday!

  • Career development opportunities

  • Employee Assistance Program - Free 24/7 wellbeing support for all our team

  • Flexible remote working

  • Team Socials - Regular team parties and social events

  • Choose your own remote working kit

  • Generous company healthcare & access to 401k plans

Convertr is ISO270001 certified, which means we hold a certificate on our internal standards on information security, which we are audited on annually. Therefore, compliance and policies are key to the running of Convertr and we need to ensure that the team comply to the standard of security at all times. You will receive annual training on data compliance, GDPR and data handling as well as regular internal meetings throughout the year to highlight the importance of compliance within our day to day workflows.

raw.description:
Job Title: Website Designer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (with flexibility for project deadlines and client reviews)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Website Designer to create modern, responsive, and conversion-focused websites that blend strong visual design with usability and performance. This role requires both creative design expertise and hands-on CMS implementation skills.

The Website Designer will develop wireframes, create high-fidelity mockups, build pages within CMS platforms, customize styling with HTML/CSS, and ensure websites are optimized for speed, SEO, accessibility, and user experience.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong visual storytelling with technical execution and enjoys building websites that are both beautiful and high-performing.

Responsibilities

Website Design & User Experience

  • Create wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity website designs in Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch
    • Translate brand direction and business goals into responsive, user-friendly website layouts
    • Design websites optimized for usability, engagement, and conversion performance
    • Maintain visual consistency across pages, landing pages, and digital assets

CMS Development & Customization

  • Build, update, and maintain websites using platforms such as WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, or Shopify
    • Customize templates and themes using HTML, CSS, and light JavaScript
    • Manage plugins, integrations, widgets, forms, and third-party tools
    • Ensure websites remain scalable, organized, and easy to maintain

Website Optimization & SEO

  • Optimize websites for speed, accessibility, responsiveness, and SEO best practices
    • Implement proper metadata, heading structures, alt text, schema markup, and internal linking
    • Run performance audits using Google PageSpeed Insights, GTmetrix, Lighthouse, or similar tools
    • Improve Core Web Vitals and mobile responsiveness across devices

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Test websites across browsers, screen sizes, and devices to ensure flawless functionality
    • Troubleshoot formatting issues, plugin conflicts, responsiveness problems, and broken functionality
    • Ensure websites maintain high performance and visual consistency post-launch

Collaboration & Feedback

  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and development teams to align websites with campaigns and business objectives
    • Incorporate stakeholder feedback while maintaining strong design integrity and usability standards
    • Communicate design decisions clearly and professionally across teams

File Management & Website Maintenance

  • Keep website files, assets, and design systems organized and up to date
    • Ensure CMS platforms, plugins, and integrations remain updated and secure
    • Maintain backups, revisions, and organized documentation for future updates

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Strong design eye paired with technical website implementation skills
    • Able to balance aesthetics, usability, performance, and SEO
    • Organized, detail-oriented, and methodical in testing and revisions
    • Collaborative communicator comfortable working across marketing, design, and development teams
    • Passionate about creating visually engaging and high-performing digital experiences

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional website design experience
    • Proficiency with Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar design tools
    • Experience building and customizing websites on WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, or Shopify

• Strong knowledge of HTML and CSS

  • Understanding of responsive design principles and modern UX/UI standards
    • Experience optimizing websites for SEO, speed, and mobile responsiveness

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience designing for e-commerce websites (Shopify, WooCommerce)
    • Basic JavaScript or front-end development knowledge
    • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and SEO optimization workflows
    • Experience supporting B2B SaaS, marketing agencies, or e-commerce brands
    • Understanding of conversion-focused landing page design and user behavior optimization

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Website Designer’s day revolves around turning design concepts into functional, optimized digital experiences. You will:

  • Design layouts, prototypes, and landing pages aligned with brand and user experience goals
    • Build and customize websites within CMS platforms using HTML/CSS enhancements
    • Run performance, responsiveness, and SEO audits to improve speed and visibility
    • Test websites across browsers and devices to ensure flawless experiences
    • Collaborate with marketing and content teams on campaigns, landing pages, and site updates
    • Maintain website security, plugins, and ongoing design consistency

In essence: you ensure websites are visually engaging, responsive, optimized, and aligned with business objectives.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of website builds, revisions, and updates
    • Page load speeds optimized to <3 seconds
    • Mobile responsiveness and accessibility scores ≥90% (Lighthouse)
    • Positive stakeholder feedback on design quality and usability
    • SEO improvements including traffic growth, rankings, and reduced bounce rates
    • Reduced website bugs, formatting issues, and responsiveness problems

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Portfolio Review + Practical Task (e.g., design and implement a landing page in WordPress or Webflow)
    • Client Interview

• Offer & Background Verification
