Job Description

A bit more about this role:

We want to help members navigate the healthcare system in a better and safer way, and care coordination is critical to achieving this for our most vulnerable and complex members. Care coordinators serve as an advocate for these members, with support from nurse case managers, ensuring members have the necessary resources and support to achieve better health outcomes. You’ll be an important part of helping us connect members with their healthcare needs—such as appointments and durable medical equipment—through outreach and follow-up communication.

Our ideal care coordinator is caring, compassionate, solution-oriented, and enthusiastic about providing an outstanding experience for Devoted Health’s members. They are committed to integrity, excellence, and empowering our most complex members to confidently navigate the healthcare system and live healthier lives. They are ready to innovate, adaptable to a continuously evolving startup environment, and willing to start scrappy, working with the whole Devoted family to create a revolution in how care is delivered.


Responsibilities will include:

  • Calling members to review self-reported health risk assessments to get a full picture of their health and needs
  • Coordinating with provider offices and home health agencies to ensure members get what they need
  • Checking in with members over the phone to see how they’re doing and confirm they’ve received the assistance they need
  • Reviewing care plans for members to identify ways to help
  • Working hand-in-hand with other Devoted teams to address member needs
  • Escalating clinical needs to nurse case managers

Attributes to success:

  • Enjoying a fast-paced environment where things move swiftly
  • Understanding urgency and having the ability to juggle multiple priorities
  • Following up relentlessly
  • Seeing the bigger picture of a process and identifying ways to make it better
  • Having the ability and agility to multitask and pivot plans mid-day
  • Being a great team player with a “can-do” attitude
  • Possessing strong communication skills for talking and emailing with a wide variety of stakeholders

Desired skills and experience:

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent (minimum educational requirement)
  • 2+ years of healthcare administrative or office experience
  • Proficiency in technology, specifically Gmail and Google Workspace (G Suite)
  • A track record of strong organization and high attention to detail
  • Previous experience in social services (a plus)
  • Full bilingual fluency in English/Spanish, English/Haitian Creole, or English/Mandarin (a plus)

Salary Range: $25.00 – $30.00 / hour

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

raw.description:
Medical Billing Account Manager – Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Standard U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Medical Billing Account Manager to support day-to-day Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) operations and ensure accurate, timely reimbursement across assigned client accounts.

This is an execution-focused role for a highly organized medical billing professional who can independently manage claim submissions, denial resolution, insurance follow-ups, collections, EOB/ERA review, and account management.

You’ll work within established billing workflows, manage high volumes of claims, communicate with insurance carriers and clients, and help ensure outstanding balances are resolved efficiently.

If you have hands-on medical billing and RCM experience and can independently take ownership of claims from submission through payment, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Management

  • Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and Electronic Remittance Advices (ERAs) to identify:
    • Payment discrepancies
    • Claim denials
    • Rejections
    • Underpayments
    • Non-payment reasons
  • Analyze, investigate, and resolve claim denials and rejections
  • Review claims for proper diagnosis and procedure code relationships
  • Apply appropriate billing modifiers to support accurate claim adjudication
  • Perform claims scrubbing and quality assurance before submission
  • Submit:
    • Initial claims
    • Corrected claims
    • Secondary claims
  • Follow payer-specific submission requirements
  • Manage claim queues and prioritize follow-up activities
  • Maintain accurate billing records, claim notes, and account documentation
  • Follow up promptly on unpaid, rejected, or underpaid claims

Denial Management & Claims Follow-Up

  • Investigate the root causes of denied and rejected claims
  • Determine appropriate next steps for claim resolution
  • Correct billing or claim information where required
  • Track unresolved claims through final resolution
  • Follow up consistently with insurance carriers
  • Monitor claim status and reimbursement timelines
  • Help reduce preventable denials and delayed payments
  • Maintain clear documentation of all follow-up activities

Account Management & Insurance Follow-Up

  • Research payer portals and insurance websites to resolve claim issues
  • Obtain claim status and payment updates from insurance carriers
  • Communicate with payers regarding billing and reimbursement inquiries
  • Support client account management and respond to billing-related questions
  • Monitor aging accounts and support collections activities
  • Maintain consistent communication with clients and internal stakeholders
  • Ensure outstanding billing issues are followed through to resolution

Quality & Compliance

  • Maintain accuracy and compliance with payer guidelines and billing requirements
  • Meet established:
    • Productivity targets
    • Quality standards
    • Turnaround-time expectations
  • Maintain accurate and complete billing documentation
  • Identify recurring billing trends and potential process issues
  • Recommend practical improvements where appropriate
  • Work independently while maintaining a high level of accountability and accuracy

Requirements

  • Previous professional experience in Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
  • Hands-on medical billing experience in a production environment
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Claim submission
    • Denial management
    • Claims follow-up
    • Collections
  • Ability to read and interpret EOBs and ERAs
  • Experience reviewing diagnosis and procedure code relationships
  • Knowledge of billing modifiers and claims scrubbing processes
  • Experience working with insurance payer portals and medical billing systems
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to independently manage billing responsibilities with minimal supervision
  • Ability to maintain accuracy while managing a high volume of claims
  • Previous remote work experience preferred
  • Availability during standard U.S. business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-volume medical billing environments
  • Experience supporting Texas-based medical practices
  • Experience with insurance verification
  • Experience managing client billing accounts
  • Strong background in denial resolution and collections
  • Experience working directly with insurance carriers and payer portals

EHR & Practice Management Systems

Experience with one or more of the following is highly preferred:

  • eClinicalWorks
  • Aprima
  • Medisoft
  • Veradigm
  • Nextech
  • CureMD
  • Office Practicum
  • NextGen

Tools & Technology

eClinicalWorks | Aprima | Medisoft | Veradigm | Nextech | CureMD | Office Practicum | NextGen | Insurance Payer Portals | EHR Systems | Practice Management Systems | Medical Billing Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Have extensive hands-on experience with medical billing and RCM workflows
  • Can independently resolve claim denials and payment issues
  • Understand the full process from claim submission through reimbursement
  • Are comfortable interpreting EOBs, ERAs, codes, and payer responses
  • Know how to prioritize aging and outstanding claims
  • Can manage a high volume of claims without sacrificing accuracy
  • Follow up persistently until billing issues are resolved
  • Communicate effectively with clients, insurance providers, and internal teams
  • Take ownership without requiring constant supervision
  • Thrive in a remote environment and consistently meet productivity expectations

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing claim queues, EOBs, ERAs, and aging accounts to identify claims requiring immediate attention.

Throughout the day, you’ll submit and review claims, resolve denials, follow up with insurance carriers, research payer requirements, update billing documentation, and monitor outstanding balances across assigned accounts.

You may also communicate with clients regarding billing questions, investigate underpayments, update claim notes, and identify recurring issues that could be affecting reimbursement.

In short: you keep the revenue cycle moving by ensuring claims are accurate, denials are resolved, outstanding balances are followed up on, and payments are collected efficiently.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Clean and accurate claim submissions
  • Reduced claim denial and rejection rates
  • Timely resolution of denied claims
  • Improved claims turnaround time
  • Consistent follow-up on unpaid and underpaid claims
  • Aging accounts actively managed
  • Improved collections and reimbursement
  • Accurate account and claim documentation
  • Achievement of productivity and quality targets
  • Strong client account management
  • Reduced outstanding claim backlog
  • Consistent compliance with payer requirements

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Hands-on ownership across the medical billing and RCM lifecycle
  • Direct impact on reimbursement and revenue performance
  • Exposure to multiple payer portals and billing systems
  • Opportunity to manage client accounts independently
  • Work across claims, denials, collections, and insurance follow-up
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Medical Billing Account Manager
    • Senior RCM Specialist
    • RCM Team Lead
    • Medical Billing Manager
    • Revenue Cycle Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Initial Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer Stage

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application and completing the required Spark Hire video interview, our recruitment team will review your experience and qualifications.

Candidates whose backgrounds closely match the role may be asked about their experience with medical billing, RCM, denial management, claims follow-up, collections, payer communications, and EHR/Practice Management systems.

Candidates with experience supporting high-volume medical billing operations, particularly Texas-based practices, will receive strong consideration.

Apply Now

If you have hands-on experience in Medical Billing and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and know how to manage claims, resolve denials, follow up with payers, and improve reimbursement, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a strong opportunity for an experienced medical billing professional who can combine accuracy, persistence, account management, and operational ownership in a remote environment.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Founding ML Engineer — Computer Vision (Object Detection)
On behalf of an AI commerce tech startup · Remote in North America · Full-time

The build:Our client is an early-stage commerce tech company building production computer vision for precise item identification and pricing. As founding ML engineer, you'll own the identification architecture, data strategy, evaluation standards, and production serving path — end to end, from foundation models fine-tuned toward a specific catalog.

The problem is fine-grained: brand, model, edition, variant. "Close" isn't good enough.

What you'll do

  • Design and own the CV architecture for fine-grained item identification — starting from foundation vision models, fine-tuning toward the company's catalog.
  • Define what "accurate enough" means per category; build calibrated confidence scoring so the product says "we're not sure" instead of guessing.
  • Build the feedback loop between model errors and what gets labeled next, with the labeling lead.
  • Decide where to invest: broader category coverage vs. deeper accuracy on today's categories.
  • Own the serving path from research to production — latency, cost, reliability at scale.
  • Represent the model's capabilities and limits company-wide — including with investors and customers.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years applied CV, with at least one system shipped to production at meaningful scale.
  • Hands-on fine-grained / instance-level classification — a problem where "close" isn't good enough.
  • Fluency in PyTorch or TensorFlow; fine-tuning and deploying vision transformers or CNNs in production.
  • Evaluation frameworks for vision models — you know when a model isactuallygetting better.
  • Comfortable being the most senior technical voice on an open-ended problem with no playbook.
  • Strong communication — you explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have:resale/marketplace (StockX, GOAT, Vinted, Rebag, The RealReal) or visual search (Pinterest Lens, Google Lens, Syte); active learning / human-in-the-loop pipelines; low-latency API serving at scale; first-ML-hire startup experience.

raw.description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote (UK hours)

About the Company

Our client is an established UK-based business specialising in the supply and installation of premium stone worktops and bespoke surfaces for residential and commercial projects.

Operating within the manufacturing, construction and home improvement sectors, the company is looking for an experienced Financial Controller to take full ownership of its accounting operations, financial reporting and compliance.

Job Summary

We are looking for a fully qualified, experienced Financial Controller to independently manage the complete finance function of a UK-based business.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong expertise in UK accounting, financial reporting, VAT, payroll, credit control, cost accounting and reconciliations.

Fluent spoken and written English is essential, as this is a client-facing position involving direct communication with UK customers, suppliers, company directors and HMRC.

The ideal candidate is highly organised, detail-oriented and confident managing financial operations independently from day one, without requiring foundational training.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Management & Reporting

  • Prepare accurate monthly management accounts, including profit and loss statements, balance sheets and cash-flow reports.
  • Deliver monthly financial reports to company directors by the 10th working day of the following month.
  • Manage month-end and year-end closing processes, ensuring accurate reporting and reconciliations.
  • Prepare year-end financial packs for external accountants.
  • Maintain and update a rolling 13-week cash-flow forecast weekly.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support business decisions.

UK Tax, Payroll & Compliance

  • Prepare and submit UK VAT returns under Making Tax Digital (MTD).
  • Manage PAYE payroll, RTI submissions, auto-enrolment pensions and statutory payments.
  • Handle CIS submissions and construction VAT domestic reverse charge requirements where applicable.
  • Maintain compliance with HMRC regulations and statutory reporting deadlines.
  • Liaise directly with HMRC and external accountants regarding tax and compliance matters.

Accounts Receivable & Credit Control

  • Oversee invoicing, collections and debtor management.
  • Communicate directly with UK customers via phone and email to resolve payment issues and recover outstanding debts.
  • Prepare and distribute weekly aged-debtor reports.
  • Maintain debtor days below 45 days and minimise overdue balances.

Accounts Payable & Reconciliations

  • Manage supplier invoices, payment schedules and purchase ledger accuracy.
  • Perform regular bank, credit card and ledger reconciliations.
  • Reconcile VAT, payroll and other control accounts monthly.
  • Ensure supplier payments are processed accurately and within agreed terms.

Cost Accounting & Operational Finance

  • Monitor job-level profitability, project costs and site-level financial performance.
  • Track material costs, stock usage and wastage, including stone slabs, glass and other manufacturing materials.
  • Analyse project margins and identify opportunities to improve profitability.
  • Support financial management of company vehicles, fleet costs and financing arrangements.
  • Work with banks, lenders and external financial partners when required.

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Maintain accurate financial records using Xero or comparable cloud accounting software.
  • Improve accounting processes, internal controls and reporting efficiency.
  • Support accounting software migrations, CRM integrations and automation of routine financial tasks.

Requirements

  • Qualified Accountant: Fully qualified ACCA, CIMA, ACA or equivalent recognised accounting qualification.
  • UK Accounting Experience: Ideally 3+ years of hands-on experience managing the full accounts function of a UK limited company.
  • Financial Reporting: Proven ability to independently prepare accurate P&L statements, balance sheets, management accounts and year-end figures.
  • UK VAT & Payroll: Strong practical experience with Making Tax Digital (MTD), PAYE, RTI submissions, auto-enrolment pensions and statutory payments.
  • Credit Control: Confident chasing outstanding payments and communicating directly with UK customers via phone and email.
  • Account Reconciliation: Strong experience with bank, ledger and control account reconciliations.
  • Cost Accounting: Experience tracking costs, monitoring profitability and managing financial data.
  • Accounting Software: Proficiency in Xero, Sage or QuickBooks, with strong Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Fluent English (Mandatory): Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally and confidently with UK stakeholders.
  • Independent Working: Able to take full ownership of the finance function from day one with minimal supervision and no foundational training.
  • Remote Setup: Reliable computer, fast internet connection and a quiet, secure workspace.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in construction, manufacturing, real estate or the kitchen and bathroom industry.
  • Knowledge of CIS and the UK construction VAT domestic reverse charge.
  • Experience with job costing, inventory management and material wastage tracking.
  • Familiarity with CRM integrations, accounting software migrations and process automation.
  • Experience handling HMRC enquiries and corporation tax matters.
  • Knowledge of vehicle financing, fleet costs and banking relationships.
  • Previous experience working remotely with UK-based companies.

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

🌍 Fully remote position working with an established UK business.

📈 Long-term career growth and professional development opportunities.

🚀 Opportunity to take ownership of the finance function and improve financial operations.

🎯 High-impact role working directly with company directors.

💻 Remote working environment with a UK-based team.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, customer experience is about making it easier for businesses to succeed with our software. We value clear communication, thoughtful problem-solving, reliable support, and people who can build processes that improve the experience for customers and the teams supporting them.

About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Customer Experience to lead and improve the experience of businesses using Bask Health's software platform.

This role is responsible for developing our customer experience strategy, leading customer-facing service operations, improving support quality, and building processes that help customers successfully use our platform.

You'll oversee how customers experience Bask Health across important stages of their relationship with us, including onboarding, activation, ongoing platform use, technical support, and issue resolution.

Our customers include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, online business owners, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to launch and manage direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

You'll bring a strong understanding of how SaaS customers interact with software platforms and what makes those experiences effective, consistent, and reliable.

You'll develop a customer experience strategy that aligns service quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction with Bask Health's business priorities.

You'll evaluate the customer journey and identify opportunities to reduce friction across different interactions with the platform and our teams.

You'll help establish clear service expectations and customer communication standards.

You'll build consistent processes for handling customer questions, technical issues, escalations, and follow-up requests.

You'll work closely with customer success managers to understand recurring customer concerns and opportunities to improve the overall experience.

You'll collaborate with customer success engineering and technical support teams to improve how technical problems are communicated, investigated, and resolved.

You'll help establish clear ownership of customer issues so requests do not get lost between teams.

You'll identify gaps in existing support workflows and develop practical improvements.

You'll lead, coach, and develop customer-facing team members within the approved organizational structure.

You'll establish performance expectations that emphasize service quality, accountability, clear communication, and effective problem-solving.

You'll help managers and individual contributors improve their ability to handle difficult customer situations.

You'll create processes for reviewing customer interactions and identifying opportunities for coaching.

You'll establish meaningful customer experience metrics and reporting practices.

You'll monitor relevant indicators such as customer satisfaction, response times, resolution times, escalation trends, and recurring support issues.

You'll use customer feedback and operational data to identify patterns that require attention.

You'll help establish a consistent approach to collecting and acting on customer feedback.

You'll collaborate with product and engineering teams to communicate recurring usability problems and customer frustrations.

You'll help prioritize customer experience improvements based on impact, frequency, and operational importance.

You'll work with product managers to improve customer-facing workflows and reduce avoidable support requests.

You'll help develop clear onboarding resources, product education materials, and self-service support documentation.

You'll identify opportunities to make customer communications more useful and easier to understand.

You'll help ensure customers receive consistent information across different teams and communication channels.

You'll oversee important customer escalations and coordinate appropriate internal responses.

You'll participate directly in sensitive customer situations when leadership involvement is needed.

You'll help teams communicate clearly during technical incidents, service interruptions, or other customer-impacting problems.

You'll establish processes for tracking escalations, documenting commitments, and confirming appropriate follow-up.

You'll collaborate with sales and customer success leadership to improve handoffs between the sales process and post-sale customer experience.

You'll work with implementation teams to identify onboarding problems that create unnecessary friction for new customers.

You'll help ensure customers understand what to expect during onboarding and ongoing platform use.

You'll evaluate existing customer service tools, ticketing workflows, and documentation practices.

You'll recommend improvements that help the team manage requests more effectively as the customer base grows.

You'll help create scalable processes that maintain service quality without relying on constant manual intervention.

You'll work with leadership to evaluate staffing needs, team structure, and operational priorities.

You'll participate in hiring and developing customer experience talent as needed.

You'll create training materials and service playbooks that help new team members become effective.

You'll promote strong collaboration between customer success, technical support, engineering, product, and other internal teams.

You'll establish clear escalation boundaries and ensure teams understand when specialist involvement is required.

Bask Health's platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll ensure customer-facing teams understand the platform well enough to provide accurate guidance and recognize their own limits.

Because Bask Health supports healthcare-related businesses, you'll need to maintain clear boundaries between software support and clinical, pharmacy, or compliance responsibilities.

You'll coordinate with authorized specialists when customer issues involve regulated healthcare activities.

You'll ensure customer-facing processes follow appropriate privacy, security, and information-handling requirements.

You'll work directly with company leadership to communicate customer experience performance, emerging problems, and opportunities for improvement.

You'll help leadership understand how customer experience affects adoption, retention, and long-term customer relationships.

You'll be expected to balance customer advocacy with operational efficiency and the realities of running a growing software business.

You'll develop processes that make it easier for teams to deliver consistent support as the platform and customer base evolve.

We're looking for a leader with substantial experience in customer experience, customer success, or support operations, along with proven experience managing teams.

You should understand how merchant-facing SaaS businesses operate and how customer experience influences long-term customer relationships.

You'll need to be comfortable making decisions, building processes, coaching employees, and collaborating across departments.

Success in this role means creating a customer experience that is clear, consistent, responsive, and scalable while helping merchants feel confident using Bask Health.

What You'll Do

  • Lead Bask Health's customer experience strategy and service operations.
  • Evaluate and improve the end-to-end customer journey.
  • Establish consistent customer communication and service standards.
  • Develop scalable customer support and escalation processes.
  • Lead and coach customer-facing teams within the approved organization.
  • Define customer experience performance expectations.

  • Identify recurring customer frustrations and service gaps.

  • Promote accountability and follow-through across customer-facing functions.
  • Ensure appropriate privacy, security, and information-handling practices.
  • Escalate clinical, pharmacy, and compliance matters to authorized teams.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce avoidable customer support requests.
  • Help build a customer experience function that can scale with Bask Health.
  • Take ownership of customer experience quality and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in customer experience, customer success, customer support operations, client services, or a closely related customer-facing function.
  • At least 4 years of experience directly managing customer-facing teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading customer experience or support operations for a SaaS business.
  • Substantive experience working with e-commerce businesses, online merchants, or merchant-facing software.
  • Strong understanding of the customer lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, ongoing support, and retention.
  • Experience developing and executing customer experience strategies.
  • Proven ability to build and improve customer support processes.
  • Experience managing service quality and customer satisfaction initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and evaluate customer-facing employees.
  • Experience defining service standards and operational performance expectations.
  • Strong understanding of customer satisfaction, response time, resolution time, and escalation metrics.
  • Experience using customer feedback and service data to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Ability to develop scalable customer support and escalation procedures.
  • Experience overseeing complex customer escalations.
  • Strong understanding of customer communication and service recovery.
  • Experience collaborating with product and engineering teams on customer-facing issues.
  • Ability to translate customer feedback into operational and product recommendations.
  • Experience improving customer onboarding and support handoffs.
  • Familiarity with customer support platforms, ticketing systems, and reporting tools.
  • Experience building customer service playbooks and training programs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting Shopify merchants or direct-to-consumer brands.
  • Familiarity with Shopify, BigCommerce, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Recharge, or similar commerce platforms.

  • Experience building customer support operations during periods of company growth.

  • Experience implementing customer support quality assurance processes.
  • Experience improving first-contact resolution and reducing repeat support requests.
  • Experience building self-service support resources or customer help centers.
  • Familiarity with Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, or similar tools.
  • Experience developing customer journey maps and service blueprints.
  • Experience designing customer escalation and incident communication processes.
  • Experience improving onboarding and implementation handoffs.
  • Experience creating operational dashboards and performance reporting.
  • Experience leading cross-functional customer experience initiatives.
  • Familiarity with online storefront, checkout, and payment workflows.
  • Experience supporting subscription commerce businesses.
  • Familiarity with healthcare technology or telehealth platforms.
  • Experience collaborating directly with founders and senior company leadership.

Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Malta

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Malta. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

Associate Director, AP Spanish Language and Spanish Literature, Curriculum and Assessment

College Board – AP&I

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: full-time position


About the Team

The AP Curriculum and Assessment Team at College Board (125+ staff) collaborates with colleagues across all aspects of the AP Program to develop, manage, and deliver AP’s 43 courses in a wide variety of subject areas. AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. AP’s course teams comprised of educators and disciplinary experts ensure that course curricula are aligned to higher education expectations and reflect the state of the art in the discipline, contribute to instructional resources and tools for teachers, and develop assessments that allow students in these courses to demonstrate their mastery of course content and skills. AP leads in strategic use of AI to expand student access, strengthen instructional design and professional support, and enhance assessment creation and exam analysis.TheWorld Languages and Arts department, which includes Spanish Language, Italian Language, French Language, German Language, Chinese Language, Japanese Language, Latin, Music Theory, Spanish Literature, and Art and Design is currently comprised of approximately 25 people supporting 12 courses in the AP portfolio.


About the Opportunity

As the Associate Director, AP Spanish Language and AP Spanish Literature you are responsible for sourcing texts and drafting items for use on the AP Spanish Language and AP Spanish Literature. The Associate Director, AP Spanish Language and AP Spanish Literature is the primary point of contact in AP for all stimulus content development and item development for Spanish Language and Spanish Literature collaborating closely with the AP Spanish Language and AP Spanish Literature Course Experts who leads all operational assessment development activities. The Associate Director may provide assessment development support in other related subject areas. You will ethically and effectively integrate AI technologies in assessment creation and review. This includes judiciously using AI assisted tools to support fairness, validity, and innovation in AP assessments. You will train SMEs on assessment development protocols, translate between academics and technical experts (psychometricians), and collaborates to develop formative assessment materials and resources to support AP Spanish Language and AP Spanish Literature.


In this role, you will:


Assessment Development and Scoring (80-90%) 

  • Independently identifies, selects, reviews, and edits both text and audio stimulus material for use in developing assessment items for AP Spanish Language and Spanish Literature, ready for internal and external review.
  • Facilitates the review process (internal and/or external) for all stimulus materials, and adapts future stimulus identification and selection process based on internal and external acceptance criteria for stimulus materials (e.g., permissions, Development Committee review, etc.)
  • Review assessment content (formative, summative, scoring materials), recommending revisions based on established item review criteria.
  • With support from your manager, author assessment content, leveraging generative AI to improve and/or make more efficient assessment processes and outputs.
  • As needed, and in collaboration with AP Course Experts, facilitate multiple face-to-face, weekend meetings, and virtual meetings (during work week, evenings, or weekends) annually with the AP Test Development Committee.
  • In collaboration with AP Course Experts support the successful scoring of student responses for AP Exams at the annual scoring event in person and online—the “AP Reading”—and produce AP Reading publications materials for teacher and student use.

Assessment Quality and Process (10-20%)

  • Contribute to current research and best practices in assessment, and engage regularly with AP Curriculum & Assessment colleagues to align on standards and shared principles guiding AP’s assessment directions
  • Support assessment workstreams within the AP World Languages and Arts department.
  • Contribute to processes for efficient, high-quality assessment development
  • Monitor and improve stimulus quality, reliability, fairness, etc.

About You


You have:

  • A Master’s degree in Spanish Language, Spanish Literature or a directly related discipline, and knowledge of current trends in the discipline (required), although a doctorate in the discipline is strongly preferred
  • Expertise in Spanish Language or Spanish Literature with at least 3 years of experience in standardized assessment development or related work; experience with digital assessment and teaching preferred
  • Experience preparing and processing third-party audio for digital delivery (preferred)
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with solid technical proficiency and a customer-focused mindset
  • Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail, including proofreading
  • Demonstrated ability to implement processes and procedures, manage project plans and schedules, and maintain tracking documentation
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels, and engage in giving and receiving constructive feedback
  • Ability to travel 6-8 times per year, plus up to two additional weeks for the AP Reading; must be eligible to work in the United States

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.


A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $60,000 - $100,000
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

The Advanced Associate, Content Quality Assurance is a production technician role on the Test Materials Development team, supporting the development, production, quality assurance, and maintenance of assessment exam materials for teacher certification programs in the United States. This position performs detailed technical and operational tasks across items, frameworks, practice tests, surveys, data loading, blueprinting, and assessment bank workflows.   • Ability to organize detailed work, track assignments, manage overlapping timelines, and support workload planning.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with internal partners and external review participants.
  • Ability to adapt to new systems, changing program requirements, and special technical assignments.

raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Engineer, New Grad to join Bask Health's engineering team and help build the software that powers our telehealth platform.

This role is designed for recent graduates and early-career engineers who enjoy building applications, solving problems, and learning how real products are developed and maintained.

You'll contribute to features across our platform, including merchant tools, patient experiences, and internal applications. Depending on the project, your work may involve frontend development, backend functionality, APIs, or integrations.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to turn ideas into working software. You'll receive technical guidance and feedback while gradually taking on greater ownership of your work.

We're looking for someone who is curious, proactive, comfortable learning new technologies, and excited to build products that people use.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve product features across Bask's web applications.
  • Develop user-facing interfaces using JavaScript, TypeScript, and React.
  • Contribute to frontend applications built with Next.js.
  • Help implement backend functionality using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Work with APIs to connect frontend applications and backend services.
  • Assist with developing and maintaining reusable UI components.
  • Contribute to merchant-facing and patient-facing product experiences.
  • Help improve application usability, responsiveness, and performance.
  • Work with SQL databases and learn how application data is organized.
  • Implement smaller features and improvements with guidance from experienced engineers.
  • Collaborate with product managers and designers to understand feature requirements.
  • Translate technical specifications into working application functionality.
  • Write clean, readable, and maintainable code.
  • Learn and apply automated testing practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback.
  • Investigate bugs and help troubleshoot application issues.
  • Assist with integrating existing APIs and third-party services.
  • Learn Bask's application architecture and development workflows.
  • Contribute to documentation and technical improvements.
  • Participate in engineering discussions and team planning.
  • Use Git and collaborative development tools.
  • Learn about application security, privacy, and reliability.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools while checking and understanding generated code.
  • Take increasing ownership of features as your technical skills develop.

Requirements

  • Recent graduate or early-career engineer with a background in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Foundational understanding of software development and programming concepts.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Experience building web applications through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional work.
  • Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and modern frontend development.
  • Familiarity with React or another component-based frontend framework.
  • Understanding of how frontend applications communicate with backend services.
  • Basic familiarity with APIs and HTTP requests.
  • Foundational knowledge of databases and data structures.
  • Understanding of common programming concepts, including functions, objects, and asynchronous operations.
  • Familiarity with Git or another version control system.
  • Ability to debug code and approach technical problems systematically.
  • Willingness to learn new frameworks, libraries, and development tools.
  • Ability to read documentation and apply technical guidance.
  • Interest in building user-facing software products.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to improve code quality.
  • Ability to communicate questions, progress, and challenges clearly.
  • Openness to feedback, mentorship, and collaborative development.
  • Ability to work independently on clearly defined tasks.
  • Interest in developing professionally within a remote engineering team.

Nice to Have

  • Internship or previous software development experience.
  • Personal or academic projects using React or Next.js.
  • Experience with Node.js or backend JavaScript development.
  • Familiarity with TypeScript.
  • Experience using SQL databases.
  • Experience building or consuming REST APIs.
  • Familiarity with automated testing frameworks.
  • Experience deploying personal projects or web applications.
  • Exposure to AWS or other cloud platforms.
  • Familiarity with serverless applications.
  • Experience using Prisma, Drizzle ORM, or similar database tools.
  • Experience contributing to open-source projects.
  • Familiarity with UI component libraries or design systems.
  • Interest in SaaS platforms, e-commerce, or merchant tools.
  • Interest in healthcare or telehealth technology.

raw.title: Head of European Partner Engagement and Research
raw.excerpt: WHO WE ARE The Partnership on AI (PAI) is the leading forum addressing the most important and difficult decisions on the future of AI.
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

The Partnership on AI (PAI) is the leading forum addressing the most important and difficult decisions on the future of AI.

We are a nonprofit that invites diverse voices into the process of technical governance, design, and deployment of AI technologies. Our diverse Partners work together across industry, academia, and civil society to form responsible AI solutions so that AI empowers humanity -- contributing to a more just, equitable, and prosperous world.

WHY EUROPE, WHY NOW

Europe is an essential contributor to PAI's mission, home to a number of critical organisations and institutions leading the way on safe and responsible AI. PAI already counts more than 20 partner organisations across the UK and Europe — spanning private sector partners in and outside the tech industry, civil society, media, and academic institutions, alongside close collaboration with policy bodies. Joining our team here means working at the centre of that network.

Candidates should expect to travel to the selected city for monthly in-person meetups.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Head of Europe will join PAI's international department to lead the organization's engagement and research within the European AI ecosystem. Reporting directly to the Managing Director, International this role will set and lead PAI's engagement and research strategy in Europe by deepening relationships with existing partners and stakeholders, identifying and cultivating new partnerships, and leading convenings, meetings, and brainstorms with key stakeholders across industry, civil society, and academia. The role will lead the development of guidance and research outputs that align PAI's global programmatic priorities with issues of direct relevance and resonance in the region.

Beyond its European focus, the role also carries a broader international component. The Head of Europe will partner with the Managing Director, International in implementing PAI's international strategy, including the potential launch of new PAI hubs in new regions and engagement with non-Western stakeholders, including in the Global South.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Stakeholder Engagement & Partnership Development(Est. time: 30%)

  • Serve as PAI’s primary point of contact and relationship-builder in Europe, reinforcing the organization’s role as a bridge between sectors and geographies.
  • Deepen and sustain relationships with PAI’s existing partners and stakeholders across Europe, including industry, civil society, academia, and government, in collaboration with the Programs & Research and Policy teams.
  • Identify new strategic and meaningful partners in Europe, that expands PAI reach and multistakeholder community.
  • In cooperation with the Partnership Development team, identify, cultivate, and engage new strategic partners in Europe who expand PAI’s reach and multistakeholder community and advance its mission in the region.
  • Working with the Director of Development, identify and pursue European funding opportunities (including foundations, philanthropic organizations, corporate partners), and contribute to proposals and strategic fundraising tied to PAI’s European events and initiatives.

Convenings & Coordination(Est. time: 20%)

  • Drive activities to convene and support PAI’s European Steering Committee (including preparation of position papers and agendas).
  • Contribute to other relevant related committees in Europe, such as the Policy Steering Committee, by participating in their convenings and virtual events, and by providing feedback and suggestions on their composition and outputs, ensuring complementarity and cross-pollination.
  • Design, organize, and host convenings, meetings, and brainstorms with key partners and stakeholders.
  • Oversee logistics and substantive content for European events, ensuring they reflect PAI's multi-stakeholder approach and mission.
  • Represent PAI at relevant European conferences, working groups, and policy forums.

Research & Guidance Development(Est. time: 30%)

  • Identify and scope emerging, high-impact, and time-sensitive topics for PAI’s research in Europe.
  • Lead the development of guidance and research outputs aligned with PAI's global programmatic priorities, with direct relevance and resonance for the European region. Work closely with members of the Programs & Research as well as Policy teams to deliver this goal.
  • Working with the Communications team, author and co-author research papers, blogs, and op-eds in collaboration with PAI staff and Partners that build visibility around PAI research and engagement in Europe.
  • Contribute European perspectives and expertise to PAI's global research agenda.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration & Broader International Strategy (Est. time: 20%)

  • Work closely with internal PAI departments to ensure European insights inform global programmatic and research priorities.
  • Partner with the Managing Director, International in implementing PAI's international strategy, including the potential launch of new regional hubs.
  • Support engagement with non-Western stakeholders, including in the Global South, and represent PAI at international convenings.

Other

  • This role requires flexibility to work extended or later hours one to two days per week to accommodate meetings with colleagues in U.S. time zones, ensuring overlap with Eastern and Pacific working hours.
  • The position also involves travel of approximately 20% of the time, both within Europe and internationally, including to North America and Africa.
  • The list of responsibilities set out are not exhaustive It may be necessary to adapt tasks within the scope of the role as needed.

WHO YOU ARE / WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Masters degree or higher in related discipline or equivalent (7-10 years) workexperience required.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across a distributed, international team.
  • A strong team player, who is able to work across the organization, and coordinate between teams when designing/delivering work.
  • Significant professional experience in AI policy, governance, technology partnerships, or a related field, with a demonstrated understanding of the European AI ecosystem.
  • Proven track record of building and managing relationships with senior stakeholders across industry, civil society, academia, and/or government.
  • Experience designing and leading convenings, working groups, or multi-stakeholder initiatives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex, multi-stakeholder input into clear guidance and research outputs.
  • Fluency in English required; additional European languages a plus.
  • Willingness to travel across Europe as needed for convenings and stakeholder meetings

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to navigate a small yet complex institution
  • Willingness to participate constructively on organizational priorities beyond the immediate focus of their work
  • Existing network of relationships with European AI policymakers, civil society organizations, and industry leaders.
  • Familiarity with PAI's mission, programmatic work, and multi-stakeholder model.
  • Experience contributing to or authoring research or guidance documents on AI governance topics.
  • Comfort with institutional change and periods of ambiguity

QUALITIES THAT ARE IMPORTANT TO US:

  • Justice: Notices and addresses inequities, includes diverse perspectives, and acts fairly in decisions and collaboration.
  • Trust: Communicates openly, follows through on commitments, and demonstrates reliability and integrity.
  • Respect: Listens fully, values others’ time and contributions, and collaborates thoughtfully.
  • Compassion: Shows empathy, patience, and care, especially when supporting colleagues or navigating challenges.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. What matters most is your commitment to PAI’s mission and the potential you bring. We are actively interested in building a diverse pool of candidates and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Compensation

PAI’s compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to fairness and equity across our distributed team. Compensation is based on role level, experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity.

The compensation range for this role depends on where you are based:

  • London, UK: £88,166 – £96,985 GBP
  • Brussels, Belgium: €109,574 – €120,534 EUR
  • Amsterdam, Netherlands: €103,764 – €120,333 EUR

In Belgium, the required 13th-month pay and double holiday pay are paid on top of this base salary range. In the Netherlands, the statutory 8% holiday allowance is paid on top of this base salary range.

Benefits

PAI offers a generous paid leave and benefits package. Time off, health, and retirement benefits are tailored to each country, with the aim of being comparable to our US package. Our benefits currently include:

  • Generous paid vacation, local public holidays, three personal reflection days, and sick and family leave in line with or above local requirements
  • Health and retirement benefits tailored to each country
  • Monthly cell phone reimbursement
  • Annual funds to support professional development
  • Monthly allowance for co-working space access
  • Regular team lunches and focused work days
  • Opportunities to attend AI-related conferences and collaborate with our partners across industry, academia, and civil society

Please refer to our careers page for an updated list of benefits.

Location and Work Authorization

  • PAI is a remote-first organization with a global membership base and scope. This role is eligible for remote work in London (UK), Brussels (Belgium), or Amsterdam (Netherlands).
  • Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where they will be based. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Partnership on AI (PAI) is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and supported.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions based on qualifications, skills, experience, and organizational needs, without discrimination. Our commitment to equal opportunity extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, professional development, advancement, compensation, and benefits.

We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive recruitment process. Candidates who require reasonable adjustments or accommodations during the hiring process are encouraged to let us know.

HOW TO APPLY

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. To apply, please submit a cover letter and resume.

Our hiring process typically includes an initial HR screen, one or more interviews with the hiring team, and a final conversation with senior leadership. We aim to keep candidates informed at each stage and will communicate expected timelines at the outset.

raw.description:
Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Denmark

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Denmark. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

Key Responsibilities

Design and maintain secure Kafka-PostgreSQL-S3 data flow architectures to support project initiatives Configure and manage secure access controls for all observability roles across tools and platforms Test and validate OpenTelemetry flows to ensure accurate and secure data collection Coordinate access provisioning and user setup for stakeholders, ensuring adherence to security and compliance requirements Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and security teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines and improve operational efficiency Monitor system health, troubleshoot issues, and maintain high availability and performance of data pipelines Integrate observability solutions (logs, metrics, and traces) to ensure full visibility into hybrid cloud infrastructure Implement security best practices for data in transit and at rest across all integrated systems Document processes, configurations, and security controls to support knowledge sharing and compliance standards Enhance infrastructure and tooling to improve scalability, performance, and security for ongoing and future initiatives Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with Kafka, PostgreSQL, and S3 data flows
  • Awareness of FedRAMP, HIPPAA and SOC2 protocols
  • Proficiency with OpenTelemetry and observability frameworks
  • Proven ability to secure cloud data pipelines and manage role-based access control
  • Experience with containerized deployment and promotion pipelines (Docker/ECR/EKS/Fargate/AKS/GKE)
  • Experience coordinating with cross-functional teams for user setup and secure access
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD tools, infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible), and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
