raw.description:
Mindex is looking for Data Engineers to join a focused migration team moving Informatica pipelines into Maia (Matillion) and Snowflake. You’ll convert, test, and verify pipelines across an estate of roughly 1,500-1,700 pipelines, build reusable components that speed up each conversion, and partner with our client on validation and cutover readiness. The ideal candidate has strong ETL/ELT fundamentals, advanced SQL and Python skills, and communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

We welcome candidates from a variety of locations; however, all candidates should be open to occasional in-person participation for business meetings, team events, or collaboration opportunities. Candidates located within approximately 35 miles of Rochester, NY may be asked to work from the office more frequently based on business or team needs.

Compensation

$90,000 - $140,000

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Convert Informatica pipelines to Maia (Matillion) and Snowflake using the Solution Lead’s factory-style patterns, and build reusable shared jobs, templates, and validation utilities.
  • Speed up conversions by removing bottlenecks and manual steps, verifying AI-generated output, and folding proven improvements into the team’s shared patterns.
  • Design and optimize Snowflake pipelines and downstream objects for performance, reliability, and ease of operation.
  • Build and support ingestion pipelines for on-premises and Azure SQL Server, files, APIs, and MongoDB.
  • Profile source data and investigate legacy behavior to uncover edge cases, using SQL and Python to compare outputs with legacy results and resolve discrepancies.
  • Agree on migration sequencing, testing standards, and sign-off criteria with technical leads and client SMEs.
  • Document migration logic, assumptions, test evidence, and go-live readiness so stakeholders can review and verify decisions.
  • Build an efficient, repeatable workflow and communicate progress and risks early and often to keep the team on track for key project milestones.
  • Demonstrate an AI-first mindset by effectively leveraging AI-assisted tools and technologies to enhance productivity, accelerate problem-solving, improve quality, automate routine tasks, and drive innovation in the delivery of solutions and services.

Requirements

  • BS degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with advanced SQL and Python for data processing and pipeline support.
  • 2+ years designing, building, and supporting ETL/ELT pipelines, including building reusable components and improving existing workflows.
  • 2+ years of Snowflake experience, including dynamic tables, views, performance tuning, and schema design.
  • Experience with data ingestion and replication tools; connector setup, authentication, and integration across diverse sources strongly preferred. Informatica or Maia (Matillion) experience is a plus.
  • Proven ability to profile data from complex source systems, test and verify pipeline outputs directly, and independently resolve data issues.
  • Proactive, curious, and able to work independently, communicate clearly, and ask for help when blocked.
  • Uses AI to augment expertise and decision-making while maintaining ownership, accountability, and professional judgment for final work products and outcomes.
  • Identifies opportunities to use AI to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and increase business value.
  • Maintains awareness of emerging AI capabilities, tools, and best practices and proactively identifies opportunities to apply them in the workplace.
  • Demonstrates sound judgment in the ethical, secure, and compliant use of AI technologies while protecting confidential, customer, and company information.

Why Join Mindex?

For more than 30 years, Mindex has helped organizations solve complex business challenges through custom software, cloud, data, and AI solutions. We combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative culture that empowers our employees to innovate, grow, and make a meaningful impact for our clients.

In our Product division, our teams have built platforms such as SchoolTool, Advanced Analytics, and our Integrations Platform from the ground up, while also supporting solutions like MTSS Edge and ClearTrack that help schools and organizations make smarter, data-driven decisions.

  • Fully Remote Work Environment
  • Flexible Time Off
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Company-Paid Life and Disability Insurance
  • Professional Development Opportunities

Additional Information

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. Mindex is unable to sponsor employment visas at this time.

Physical Requirements/Conditions

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • No heavy lifting is expected. Exertion of up to 10 lbs.

raw.title: On-Chain Researcher (Attribution & Monitoring)
raw.excerpt: Company Overviewhermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm.
raw.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

We are seeking a crypto-native on-chain researcher to join the research team. You will support our senior researchers with real-time monitoring and attribution, helping the team keep continuous coverage of market-moving on-chain activity.

The core of this role is on-chain attribution and monitoring: identifying who is behind wallets, clusters, and flows, and doing it accurately while handling uncertainty. Accurate attribution underpins everything else we build on top of it, including the charts, alerts, and monitoring workflows the team relies on to interpret market-moving activity in real time.

This is an opportunity for a talented on-chain researcher to work in a highly collaborative environment with access to substantial data, technology and trading infrastructure.

Responsibilities

Attribution & Blockchain Analysis

  • Perform entity attribution, wallet clustering, and transaction graph analysis across account-based and UTXO-based blockchains.
  • Investigate unknown wallets and clusters, weighing the evidence and stating confidence honestly before conclusions are shared.
  • Analyze exchange flows, treasury and insider activity, token unlocks, vesting, and cross-venue capital movement.
  • Investigate unfamiliar protocols, entities, and market events quickly and report what the on-chain data does and does not show.

Real-Time Monitoring & Coverage

  • Monitor on-chain activity and market events in real time for potentially tradeable signals, and escalate them to the senior team.
  • Build and maintain monitoring workflows, dashboards, and alerts for themes and entities of interest.
  • Communicate complex blockchain activity clearly and concisely to researchers and traders, including under time pressure in volatile markets.
  • Provide coverage and backup for senior researchers when colleagues are out.

Research Support & Tooling

  • Support senior researchers on exploratory analysis across Bitcoin, EVM ecosystems, and major non-EVM blockchains.
  • Query and analyze blockchain datasets using SQL and APIs, including our internal data platforms, to validate hypotheses quickly.
  • Use modern analytical and AI-assisted tooling to speed up attribution, summarization, and ad hoc research.
  • Collaborate with engineering on datasets, monitoring systems, and research tooling.

Requirements

Must Haves

Experience & Knowledge

  • 2 to 3 years of experience in blockchain analysis, crypto research, or a related field.
  • Demonstrable, hands-on experience with on-chain attribution: wallet clustering, entity analysis, and investigating unknown addresses.
  • Publicly available research or analysis that we can review before interviews (for example, threads, reports, dashboards, or write-ups).
  • Working familiarity with Bitcoin, EVM ecosystems, and at least one major non-EVM blockchain.
  • Understanding of how on-chain activity such as exchange flows, unlocks, and treasury movements relates to market behavior.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Working proficiency in SQL and APIs, with experience querying large blockchain datasets.
  • Experience with blockchain analytics and visualization platforms such as Dune, Flipside, Arkham, Nansen, Etherscan, Solscan, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Bitcoin's UTXO model and associated transaction analysis techniques.
  • Python or a similar language for research and prototyping.
  • Good judgment about what is signal and what is noise in incomplete or fast-moving data.

Operational & Communication Skills

  • Strong attention to detail while tracking several assets and themes at once.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially under time pressure.
  • Ownership, self-direction, and intellectual curiosity.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across research, trading, and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a trading firm, hedge fund, market intelligence firm, or crypto-native research organization.
  • Experience building monitoring dashboards, alerts, or information aggregation workflows.
  • Experience interpreting real-time market events, such as unlocks, governance actions, liquidations, hacks, and bridge movements.
  • Familiarity with derivatives positioning or cross-venue flows.
  • A network within the crypto ecosystem and familiarity with key entities, protocols, and information channels.

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. Phone Interview – A discussion with the Talent Acquisition Partner to better understand your background, career motivations, and overall alignment.
  3. Written follow-up – A few short written questions on your on-chain research process, reviewed by the research team.
  4. First Interview – Interview with our On-chain Research Lead on your experience and general technical knowledge.
  5. Second Interview – A deeper look at your attribution methodology, how you validate on-chain signals, and your public research.
  6. CIO Interview – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm's values.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

raw.description:
About the team

The Corporate Development team at Zillow is a high-impact, entrepreneurial function advancing Zillow's Housing Super App vision through acquisitions and strategic investments, as well as financial and strategic analysis across the business. We have been active on the M&A front, including acquisitions such as Virtual Staging AI, Follow Up Boss, Spruce, Aryeo, and VRX Media in recent years, and partner closely with senior leadership on the company's most consequential strategic and financial decisions.

About the role

As a Senior Manager on the Corporate Development team, you will work directly with senior leadership as part of a lean M&A team, applying your strategic and analytical skills to identifying, evaluating, and advancing growth opportunities, both organic and inorganic, across Zillow Group's lines of business. This is an individual contributor role where you’ll serve as a Corporate Development partner to business leaders, shaping the thesis and business case that inform M&A, alongside supporting transaction execution, with increasing ownership of transactions over time. We are looking for candidates with proven M&A experience and sound strategic judgment.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $157,500.00 - $251,500.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $149,600.00 - $239,000.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • Identify, research, and recommend acquisition opportunities, forming a point of view on where M&A can advance a business's strategy
  • Develop investment theses and business cases that inform build, buy, and partner decisions, and present recommendations to senior leadership
  • Support all transaction phases, including sourcing, due diligence, structuring, negotiation, closing, and integration, with increasing ownership of transactions over time
  • Provide financial and strategic analysis of acquisition targets, including valuation
  • Build detailed, flexible long-term financial models for Zillow Group's overall business in connection with key opportunities and initiatives, including partnerships
  • Serve as a thought partner to business leaders in developing strategies, evaluating business opportunities, and making recommendations based on detailed analysis
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, finance, and legal to enable an integrated perspective on M&A transactions
  • Serve as partner to the Strategy & Partnerships team in connection with the evaluation and execution of new strategies and partnership opportunities

Who You Are:


  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
  • 6+ years of experience, with a foundation in investment banking or private equity (2+ years), followed by meaningful corporate development experience, ideally at a technology company
  • Strategic thinker who forms original insights under ambiguity and can shape the strategy that informs M&A
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to formulate and deliver insights around business problems in a thoughtful and persuasive manner to executives
  • Strong three-statement financial modeling skills and broad financial acumen, including corporate finance principles, financial statement analysis, and valuation methodologies, applied to novel business situations
  • Experience executing M&A transactions through the full process
  • Ability to proactively build relationships with key stakeholders across Zillow’s business to surface opportunities early and scale impact
  • Ownership mentality, questioning assumptions and taking responsibility for conclusions
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to lead several priorities simultaneously
  • Strong initiative and judgment; performing in a fast-paced, dynamic, entrepreneurial environment, leading internal and external stakeholders and working efficiently with cross-functional teams in a remote environment
  • Genuine curiosity about Zillow's businesses and the problems they solve for customers; familiarity with SaaS or software business models is a plus
  • Comfortable leveraging AI tools in day-to-day M&A and analytical work to drive efficiency and sharpen decision making

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. ROLE: Controller

Team: Finance & Accounting

Reports To: Chief Financial Officer

Direct Reports: Accounting Manager; Staff Accountant

Location: Remote*

Compensation: $145,000 - $165,000 base salary*

*Please see Fine Print section below

About Archer

Archer Review is a private equity-backed education technology company supporting medical and nursing students in their professional journeys. Our mission is to equip health care learners, educators and leaders with the knowledge, resources and confidence they need to succeed.

Archer Review has been recognized for four consecutive years by Inc. 5000 and for two years by Deloitte Technology Fast 500 as one of the fastest-growing technology companies in the United States. The company also ranks No. 5 on the 2024 Financial Times list and No. 3 on the Inc. Southwest Regionals list for high growth companies.

We are a team of clinicians, educators, technologists, creatives and operators who truly believe that the work we do has a strong impact on making the world a better place.

About the role

Archer Review is looking for a Controller to lead our accounting operations and keep our financial reporting accurate, timely and well controlled. You will own the month-end close, audit, tax compliance and internal controls, and oversee accounts payable, T&E, payroll, billing and accounts receivable across your team of direct reports. This is a hands-on, remote leadership role. It suits a technically strong accountant who builds scalable processes and develops people.

What you'll do

  • Own the month-end close: review balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries and the close package, and deliver accurate GAAP financial statements on a defined close calendar.
  • Lead the annual financial statement audit, including audit planning, coordinating requested support (PBC) items and managing the auditor relationship.
  • Manage tax compliance with our outside advisors (RSM), including income tax filings, sales and use tax, multi-state apportionment, voluntary disclosure agreement (VDA) tracking and other filings.
  • Design, document and maintain internal controls, including the approval matrix, segregation of duties, vendor master change reviews and payment release controls.
  • Review customer contracts and oversee revenue recognition (ASC 606), deferred revenue, and allowance and bad debt reserves.
  • Oversee AP, T&E, payroll, billing and collections. Serve as Ramp administrator and provide final review of payroll in Rippling.
  • Prepare quarterly reporting letters and confidential accruals such as executive bonuses, and review sales compensation plans independently.
  • Lead accounting integration for acquisitions, including systems, policies and bringing acquired entities into the close.
  • Lead and develop the accounting team, and keep the responsibility matrix current with documented primary and backup coverage.
  • Drive process automation and system improvements across NetSuite/Rillet, Ramp, Rippling and the HubSpot billing integration.

What we need from you

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting. Active CPA license preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 3-5+ years as a Controller or Assistant Controller. Public accounting (Big 4 or national firm) experience a plus.
  • Expert knowledge of US GAAP, including ASC 606 revenue recognition for subscription or digital products and deferred revenue.
  • Proven track record of running a fast, accurate monthly close and leading clean external audits.
  • Experience with multi-state sales and use tax, payroll tax and income tax compliance, working with outside tax advisors.
  • Strong understanding of internal controls and segregation of duties. Experience with private equity-backed or audit-ready (SOX-style) environments preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with a cloud ERP, spend management, HRIS and payroll and CRM-to-billing integrations, plus advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience leading and developing remote accounting teams, with strong communication skills and a customer-service approach to working with other departments.
  • M&A integration experience a plus.

What success looks like

  • Timely and accurate reporting: monthly financial statements are delivered on the close calendar with no material post-close adjustments, and annual audits are clean.
  • Deadlines met 100% of the time across the close, payroll, tax filings, 1099s, and audit deliverables.
  • Strong partnerships with Sales, People Operations, Marketing, and Operations, built on clear processes for approvals, billing, contracts, and spend.
  • Strong team development: a trained, cross-trained accounting team with documented procedures and primary and backup coverage for every responsibility.

Our benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance for employees and their families
  • Flexible & encouraged PTO
  • Company HSA contribution for eligible plans
  • Company-paid life insurance and disability coverage
  • 401(k) with company match (100% match on first 3%, 50% match on the next 2%)

What to expect from our hiring process

  • Application review: A human reviews every application that meets our location criteria.
  • Initial Conversation: Logistics and light background overview with People Operations.
  • Hiring manager interview: Learn about our company, discuss the role, and review your experience.
  • Team interview: Meet some of your peers and/or direct reports and learn how the team works together.
  • Leadership interview: Meet with a cross-functional leader, or our VP of People, for a final conversation.
  • Offer: Congrats - you made it! We'll call to give you the news and go over the details.

The fine print (PLEASE READ!)

  • *Geographical requirements: At this time, we are not able to consider candidates who will work remotely in, or be based out of, Alaska, California, Hawaii, New York, Washington DC, or Washington state. Additionally, we are unable to consider candidates who are located outside of the United States, and/or candidates who require Visa sponsorship.
  • *Pay decisions: Compensation is typically targeted near the midpoint of the posted salary range, with individual offers determined by experience, qualifications, role requirements, and business needs. The Archer team will align with candidates on salary requests in our first conversations, in order to ensure we have mutual transparency.
  • Remote first: All interviews are virtual Zoom meetings, and require strong internet with cameras on. If you need reasonable accommodations for interviews, please reach out to .
  • Our 'No Ghosting' commitment: We’ll keep you updated and ensure all candidates receive timely communication, regardless of the news.

Archer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe great ideas come from everywhere, and we are committed to building a team that reflects a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, experiences and skills. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status.

Receptionist (Construction)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for a confident, organized, and customer-focused Remote Receptionist to support a construction business focused on roofing and custom home services.

This is a highly phone-based role combining inbound lead response, outbound follow-up, cold calling, appointment booking, and call tracking. You’ll be one of the first points of contact for potential customers, helping turn inquiries into booked consultations while ensuring every interaction is properly documented.

What You’ll Own

Inbound Lead Response

  • Receive and handle calls from leads who have submitted forms through the company website.
  • Qualify their interest and understand their needs.
  • Move qualified leads toward a booked appointment with the appropriate team member.

Outbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Proactively call prospects who have expressed interest but have not yet converted.
  • Keep the pipeline warm through consistent follow-up.
  • Reduce drop-off between initial inquiry and consultation.

Cold Calling

  • Conduct structured outbound cold calling campaigns.
  • Generate new interest in roofing and custom home services.
  • Follow established scripts while adapting naturally to live conversations.

Appointment Booking

  • Schedule consultations and site visits accurately.
  • Coordinate availability with the appropriate team members.
  • Avoid double-bookings and missed opportunities.

Call Tracking & Notes

  • Log every call, outcome, and follow-up action clearly.
  • Keep lead records accurate and up to date.
  • Ensure the team always has a current view of where each lead stands.

Professional Brand Representation

  • Serve as the first voice many customers hear.
  • Communicate warmly, clearly, and professionally.
  • Speak confidently about the company's roofing and custom home offerings.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in a receptionist, call center, customer service, or inside sales role with a significant phone-based component.
  • Experience handling both inbound and outbound calls confidently.
  • Ability to conduct cold calls without heavy supervision.
  • Strong spoken and written English fluency.
  • Clear pronunciation and strong active listening skills.
  • Ability to keep callers engaged and conversations on track.
  • Comfortable using scheduling or CRM tools to log calls and manage appointments.
  • Specific platform experience is a plus.
  • Reliable home office setup with stable internet, a quality headset, and a quiet calling environment.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You remain calm and professional when calls become challenging.
  • You are comfortable handling rejection and staying consistent during cold calling.
  • You take ownership of lead follow-up rather than waiting to be reminded.
  • You proactively flag unusual or important customer situations to the internal team.
  • You are organized and consistently document every interaction.
  • You can work independently while maintaining close communication with the team.

What Success Looks Like

  • New website leads are contacted promptly and professionally.
  • Qualified prospects are effectively moved toward booked appointments.
  • Follow-up leads remain warm and receive consistent outreach.
  • Cold calling generates new conversations and interest.
  • Appointments are scheduled accurately without double-bookings or missed opportunities.
  • Every call and follow-up action is properly documented.
  • The team has a clear, up-to-date view of the lead pipeline.
  • Customers receive a professional and positive first impression of the company.

Typical Day

Your day revolves around the phone. You’ll start by reviewing new form submissions and prioritizing callback attempts for fresh leads.

As calls come in, you’ll qualify callers, answer basic questions about roofing projects and custom home builds, and schedule appointments on the calendar.

Between inbound calls, you’ll run outbound sessions, following up with leads that have gone cold and working through cold calling lists to open new conversations.

You’ll log every interaction as you go, ensuring the team has a live picture of the pipeline.

The role is largely independent, but you’ll stay in close communication with the internal team to flag hot leads, reschedule appointments, and surface anything that requires their attention.

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Final Selection

Director of Business Development | Remote, USA Panoramic Science | Powered by Panoramic Health About Panoramic Science Panoramic Science is the clinical research division of Panoramic Health, a leading, physician-led kidney care platform focused on improving patient outcomes through innovative care models and clinical research. Our growing, multi-site research network partners with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and contract research organizations (CROs) to advance clinical development and expand access to industry-sponsored clinical trials. We are committed to building a high-performing research network that combines strong site-level execution, meaningful sponsor partnerships, and data-driven decision-making to deliver impactful results. Position Overview Panoramic Science is seeking a strategic, metrics-driven Director of Business Development to lead commercial growth across our multi-site clinical research network, with a focus on cardiovascular, renal, and metabolic (CVRM) clinical trials. This senior leadership role will own the end-to-end business development strategy, driving growth in study awards, sponsor relationships, and long-term commercial partnerships. The Director will work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to strengthen our market position, improve study award conversion, and build a scalable business development function that supports the organization's long-term growth objectives. The ideal candidate brings a strong track record of generating revenue through industry-sponsored clinical research, established relationships with biopharma, pharmaceutical, and CRO partners, and a highly analytical approach to pipeline management, forecasting, and performance optimization. Key Responsibilities Commercial Strategy & Revenue Growth

Develop and execute a comprehensive business development strategy aligned with organizational growth objectives and long-term value creation. Drive growth in industry-sponsored clinical trials, study awards, and repeat business across the research site network. Identify and prioritize sponsors, CROs, therapeutic programs, and partnership opportunities based on revenue potential, strategic alignment, and operational feasibility. Build and strengthen senior-level relationships with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and CRO partners to secure repeat study awards and long-term, multi-study partnerships. Represent Panoramic Science in strategic sponsor meetings, scientific conferences, and industry forums to expand market presence and generate new business opportunities. Business Development Operations & Analytics Lead the implementation and consistent use of a CRM platform, such as Salesforce, to manage sponsor relationships, pipeline activity, pre-award processes, and study outcomes. Establish standardized business development processes, tools, templates, and playbooks to support consistency, efficiency, and scalability across the network. Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including pipeline value, study award rates, sales cycle times, sponsor concentration, and revenue forecasts. Use data analytics and performance insights to evaluate commercial effectiveness, improve conversion rates, and optimize business development strategies. Develop clear, executive-level reporting to communicate pipeline performance, growth trends, and commercial results.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Network Development

Partner with executive leadership on budgeting, forecasting, and strategic growth planning. Collaborate with operations, feasibility, finance, regulatory affairs, and site leadership to align commercial opportunities with site capabilities, patient populations, and execution readiness. Translate sponsor and CRO feedback into actionable improvements that strengthen site performance, enhance competitiveness, and support future study awards. Develop data-backed presentations, performance narratives, and marketing materials that demonstrate the network's capabilities and value to prospective and existing partners. Establish a disciplined business development operating cadence that promotes accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. 7+ years of business development experience within industry-sponsored clinical research. Prior experience with a clinical research site network or comparable multi-site research organization. Demonstrated success driving study awards, revenue growth, and repeat business with biopharmaceutical companies, large pharmaceutical sponsors, and CROs. Established industry relationships and an understanding of sponsor and CRO decision-making processes. Strong familiarity with cardiovascular, renal, and metabolic (CVRM) clinical trials and related therapeutic development. Experience implementing and managing CRM platforms, such as Salesforce, with expertise in pipeline management, forecasting, and performance analytics. A highly analytical, data-driven approach to commercial strategy, with the ability to translate metrics into actionable business decisions. Strong executive communication, relationship management, negotiation, and presentation skills. Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders across commercial, operational, and executive teams. Experience developing standardized processes and scalable business development infrastructure in a growth-oriented organization.

Why Join Panoramic Science?

Make a measurable impact: Lead commercial strategy and directly influence the growth of a growing clinical research network. Build strategic partnerships: Develop meaningful relationships with leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and CRO organizations. Shape the future of clinical research: Help expand access to innovative clinical trials across cardiovascular, renal, and metabolic therapeutic areas. Collaborate with executive leadership: Play a key role in strategic planning, commercial performance, and organizational growth. Build for scale: Establish the processes, analytics, and partnerships needed to support long-term success across a multi-site research network.

Join Panoramic Science and help advance clinical research through strong partnerships, disciplined commercial execution, and a commitment to better patient outcomes.

About us

Action1 is an autonomous patch management platform trusted by many Fortune 500 companies. Cloud-native, infinitely scalable, highly secure, and configurable in 5 minutes, it just works and is always free for the first 200 endpoints, with no functional limits. By pioneering autonomous OS and third-party application patching, Action1 helps organizations eliminate routine work, reduce ransomware and security risks, and protect the digital employee experience. It provides real-time vulnerability assessment and remediation across remote and on-site endpoints without requiring a VPN, while peer-to-peer patch distribution reduces bandwidth use on local networks.

In 2026, Action1 was recognized as the fastest-growing founder-led cybersecurity company in America on the Inc. 5000. Action1 is led by industry veterans Alex Vovk and Mike Walters, American entrepreneurs who founded Netwrix, which has grown into an industry-leading, multibillion-dollar cybersecurity company.

The Role

  • Location: United States · Remote
  • Working hours: U.S. Central Time (CT) business hours, starting at 8 or 9 a.m. CT, with after-hours support for critical incidents as needed.

We are hiring a Senior IT Engineer to strengthen our corporate IT systems and security. You will work directly with the Head of IT, share daily operations with our EU-based Systems Administrator, and take primary ownership of security operations and technical security controls across the organization.

In this small IT team, your ideas and technical judgment will help shape how we work. You will turn recurring problems into lasting improvements, build automation that the team relies on, and work with peers to share knowledge and learn from one another. You will own implementation, with the Head of IT providing direction and retaining program governance, policy approval, risk acceptance, and major incident oversight.

What you’ll do

  • Manage Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and business applications, providing U.S. hours support and coordinating handoffs with our EU-based Systems Administrator.
  • Resolve device compliance issues, restore employee access, and strengthen identity and endpoint security through hardening, access controls, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Own infrastructure and security projects, turning recurring problems into lasting improvements.
  • Build reliable automation and API integrations using Git and approved AI tools, with testing and independent validation.
  • Triage security alerts, investigate and document incidents, and coordinate response and recovery with the Head of IT.
  • Assess new and existing vendors and technology changes, review access requirements, and recommend safeguards for the Head of IT’s approval.
  • Implement practical compliance controls, maintain audit evidence in Vanta, and resolve failed checks and technical findings.
  • Maintain incident playbooks, test recovery procedures, and share knowledge across the IT team.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in systems administration, IT engineering, infrastructure, or a related role, with demonstrated ownership of complex technical work.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and Windows endpoints, supported by sound networking, DNS, and VPN fundamentals.
  • Experience in a security operations center, either in-house or with a managed security provider.
  • Experience building and maintaining IT automation with tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Ansible, including API integrations.
  • Experience using Git, branching, and pull requests to maintain scripts and automation.
  • Hands-on security operations experience, including alert triage, incident investigation, and response, using Microsoft Defender or comparable tools.
  • Experience implementing security controls and supporting audits or evidence collection, with working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC 2, or a comparable framework.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills: gather evidence, test assumptions, identify root causes, weigh security and operational trade-offs, and verify results.
  • Ability to balance employee support, incidents, and projects; communicate clearly; document decisions; and recognize when to escalate or seek approval.

  • Infrastructure as code experience with Terraform.
  • Experience with Vanta (or other GRC platforms), Microsoft Purview, and Datadog or Arctic Wolf (or SIEM tools.)
  • AWS experience, particularly with VPN or backup services.
  • Familiarity with GovRAMP or FedRAMP (NIST SP 800-53), CIS Benchmarks, and technical data protection requirements.

Benefits

  • Fully remote work with flexibility to support your work-life balance.
  • A collaborative environment that empowers you to own your domain and implement best practices.
  • Stable income, benefits, flexible working hours, and opportunities for career advancement.
  • Friendly, professional colleagues who are eager to support you and help you grow.
  • Engaging challenges and opportunities to make a meaningful impact.
